Describe.301010231: The PM-R Type Armored Rig is a high-quality, lightweight armored rig produced by Gorod Industrial for rapid response units. Being lightweight and having excellent bulletproof capabilities are the core highlights of this armored rig. During the Northern Front's counteroffensive, Fred was hired by the First Corps to take part in the Siege of Onotos. Due to his previous experience, he was assigned as a member of the Woodland Warfare. He then went on to display his talents in the battle, where he relied on his superb sniper skills and mountain and forest guerilla tactics to claim many victories, and ended up being called the Woodland Wraith by soldiers on both sides.

Describe.408090010: A workman's diary with the logo of Kamona Petroleum. The author is a man named Desmond. The first half records the events of the conflict in Guoyapos. The words within might be silent, but you can almost hear the gunfire and the weeping echoing off the page. The latter half of the book is just as heart-wrenching, but the content becomes touching and sentimental. The diary ends with the following sentence: "What is the world outside Kamona like? I'd like to take a look." Not long ago, the author went to the Department Store to get a gift for his friend's kid and never returned to Twilight Apartment.
Describe.408090004: Strange writings and graphs in an unmarked folder. It's in English, but you barely understand any of it. The word "Gungnir" appears multiple times. First found in the farm.
Describe.408990019: A crumpled and wrinkled booklet, the cover badly damaged, its design long faded away. Flipping through the pages reveals names, most struck through with a thick line. The names, meticulously recorded and crossed out, seem to reveal the tragic end of those who once dared abandon their family's honor.
Describe.408090016: An old book. Its cover shows the passage of time but you can still make out its title. The densely packed annotations and dog-eared pages inside may never see the light of day again.
Describe.408980008: An old book of unknown language, full of disdainful graffiti.
Describe.498080019: A necklace with several massive aquamarine gems as its centerpieces, accented by a multitude of crushed diamonds. The main gems are a translucent aquamarine hue, almost entirely free of impurities, while the tightly encircled diamonds create a layered halo effect. Legend has it that the aquamarine pieces came from a giant uncut gemstone, named "Mercury," that was unearthed in a Kamona mine and of a quality previously unseen in the region. A wealthy local merchant funded its cutting and polishing and commissioned a renowned jeweler to craft this necklace. Naming it the "Star of Kamona," the merchant intended it to be a symbol of home. However, ever since its creation, every one of its owners has been drawn into conflict and each time it changed hands, it was accompanied by struggle and ruin.
Describe.408080023: An obnoxious chain made of Onotos gold; local artisans make it to reflect the owner's wealth and ability.

Describe.301010229: Manufactured by Gorod, this PM-series heavy armored rig was originally specially produced for troops, but following several iterations, the G type was launched commercially. Offering comprehensive protection, the PM-G provides a large-capacity rig, which can meet various mounting needs. Porrero took advantage of the chaos caused by the fierce fighting between the northern and southern fronts in the Onotos region and seized control of the mines. However, the jail guards were defeated, which meant that the prisoners lost their biggest enemy, so Porrero was soon betrayed by his men and had to flee in shame. After escaping from the mines and faced with Doss' proposal, he took over this heavy armored rig and swore allegiance to the family. Now part of the family, he sometimes imagines a day where he could return to the mines and take back the position that belongs to him.

Desc.1106: This small agricultural region has a flat terrain. The Motel and the Stables are the two important supply locations.
Desc.401: Northridge is located in the Onotos Mountains north of Onotos downtown. The mountain area has a magnificent view and lush vegetation. Visitors can see the snow-capped mountain in the distance and look over the small town at the foot of the mountain. The magnificent Northridge Hotel was built next to the reservoir in the mountains and is now occupied by Fred's team.
Desc.1701: As the natural deep-water harbor on the eastern coast of Guoyapos was an important import and export channel for northern Kamona, the entire Port was constructed and developed around it. During the time it was controlled by the Northern Front, the Tevilans dispatched military support to provide Kamona the help needed to build a naval port and shipyard for repairs nearby.
Desc.1601: Kamona TV Station is located in the Guoyapos region. It was the largest TV station in Kamona. During the North-South Conflict, this place was used by the Northern Front as a frontline command center. When the Dark Zone was established, it was commandeered by Sumek Committee for an unknown reason. Most of it was destroyed in the war. Only the cramped interior was left intact.
Desc.1602: Kamona TV Station is located in the Guoyapos region. It was the largest TV station in Kamona. During the North-South Conflict, this place was used by the Northern Front as a frontline command center. When the Dark Zone was established, it was commandeered by the Sumek Committee for an unknown reason. Most of it was destroyed in the war. Only the cramped interior was left intact.
Desc.1102: Located just outside Marulos, the Arbor Farm was once an important food production center in Kamona. The Grain Trade Center was set up to facilitate the transport of grain. A rail link between northern and southern Kamona used to cross through the farm, which contributed to its prosperity. The farm was devastated during the civil war, and the rail line was destroyed. After the war ended, Ajax led the occupation of the area under orders from Renoir.

Desc.701: The Valley by the Floranpino Beach is a great tourist attraction with excellent scenery. People used to come to the beach during vacations. Villas, yachts, and cruise ships were scattered along the coastline. After several wars, it is no longer prosperous. Strange rumors have recently been circulating in Kamona that two completely different natural landscapes have appeared in the Valley.
Desc.1401: This military armory was once controlled by the Northern Front. It was stocked with weapons and protected by heavy fortifications. During the North-South Conflict, Ajax held the ground here for months until Renoir came. Now, this place is controlled by Renoir's men and heavily armed guards are scattered across the choke points of the armory to defend it from outsiders.
Desc.1101: One of the main places where the red and blue sides fight one another during Training Simulation. An agricultural production facility.
Desc.1501: One of the main places where the red and blue sides practice against another during Training Simulation. In a scenic mountainous area.
Desc.9701: The Guoyapos International Airport, located in southern Guoyapos, is a modern aviation hub. Initially, the airport mainly served tourists from abroad, but during the early stages of the North-South Conflict, it served the important role of evacuating expats. As the war progressed, it was used by both sides as a provisional frontline command center and was militarized accordingly.

disp_detail.4010719: A 3x scope will allow you to see further, and pairing one with a weapon with a strong effective range will give you a considerable advantage when fighting at mid-range. You can also equip a weaker scope to support close-quarters combat. They're essentially made for an environment like the Farm.
disp_detail.4010720: A 5.56x45 caliber suppressor will basically suppress the sound of any weapon of the same caliber. Equip the suppressor and fire from long range, and the enemy will find it very difficult to determine where the shot came from. Don't forget to attack parts of the enemy that are unprotected by armor.
disp_detail.4010742: The 7.62x39 caliber suppressor can be paired with many kinds of weapons, and is excellent at suppressing the sound of a gun. When you equip the suppressor to track prey in Northridge, you'll be able to cover your tracks well.
disp_detail.5040301: Extract from Extraction Point G3 within 8 minutes.
disp_detail.4010726: The ACE31 Assault Rifle has a very balanced performance once properly modified, and can be used in almost any situation. However, if you want to unleash its full potential, you need to be familiar with how to use it in different situations. Don't act rashly.
disp_detail.4010734: The AEK Assault Rifle is an excellent weapon with high performance in a variety of areas. A high rate of fire accompanied by powerful ammo will give you explosive power at close range. So long as you modify your weapon with care, you'll be equipped to deal with most combat environments.
disp_detail.4010312: There's a reason why classic automatic rifles like the AKM still get used a lot, even today. When it comes to attack, stability, and modding potential, it is an outstanding weapon. Most importantly, it won't cost you an arm and a leg to get one.
disp_detail.4010149: The AR-30 has outstanding performance, and it's a favorite among snipers. When fighting in the Valley Lockdown Zone, you'll have a lot of space to use this weapon to its full potential. But remember, it's not exactly quiet there. I need you to head there with this weapon and take out a few enemies. After you've shot them, remember to move fast.
disp_detail.4010336: The AUG is a bullpup-style assault rifle that is suitable for indoor combat and features excellent overall performance. That said, I personally can't get used to reloading such weapons. If you can, it might end up serving you well.
disp_detail.4010739: The F57 may be a pistol, but it has a lot of firepower. It'll yield brilliant results in certain assault missions, so long as it's used properly. After all, compared to larger guns, the F57 is much more agile. That said, it's undeniable that only an excellent shot has what it takes to handle this weapon.
disp_detail.4010217: The FAL Automatic Rifle is a dependable weapon, with better effective range and accuracy than other assault rifles. Its rate of fire is a bit mediocre, but it is absolutely formidable if you take advantage of its range in the right environments.
disp_detail.4010234: The M4A1 is an outstanding weapon, whether you're talking about its rate of fire, its stability, or its modding potential. Even if you only equip it with a simple scope, it's still suitable for all kinds of combat situations. You must try it when you get the chance.
disp_detail.4010732: The Mini14 carbine is perfect for modifications. After some thorough improvements, attach a suppressor while continuing to hit enemies at mid to long range with precision. This way, even if you fail to eliminate the target in one hit, it's still unlikely that you'll reveal your location.
disp_detail.4010744: The RPK-16 Light Machine Gun has a rate of fire and an effective range to match even an assault rifle. A standard drum can also give you sustained firepower, allowing you to effectively suppress the enemy. However, it also creates a huge amount of noise, easily attracting enemies from all around. Best to equip a suppressor, if you can.
disp_detail.4010716: The RPK-16 Light Machine Gun has a rate of fire and an effective range to match even an assault rifle. A standard drum can also give you sustained firepower, allowing you to effectively suppress the enemy. When facing spray from an opponent head on, overwhelming them with firepower is the right way to use this weapon.
disp_detail.4010153: The SJ16 is obviously a powerful weapon. It's fairly loud, but still a favorite among snipers. When fighting outside the Armory, you'll have a lot of space to use this weapon to its maximum potential, but you'll struggle to use it well inside.
disp_detail.4010737: The VSS could be described as a kind of marksman rifle, but long-range combat clearly isn't its strong suit. Better to use this weapon to spray at mid to close range, and remember to attach a good laser sight!
disp_detail.9401508: The "cargo" is packed and ready! Now for a critical mission—I need you to personally haul the sample safe all the way to the TV Station. Given the current situation, the enemy shouldn't suspect you. Just keep a low profile, and don't go anywhere you shouldn't. And don't worry, we'll be watching your six.
disp_detail.9271205: The "door's" influence is spreading. An organization known as Blackgold Universal is hiring operators to travel to Night City. I need to get to a place known as Northridge. Could you find me a road that I can use to drive there?
disp_detail.9341409: ...I know what happened. I believe you did your best. Comms are down, and we've lost contact with the White Wolf Squad trapped in the Warehouse. For now, we can only hope that Blackgold is short-handed and our soldiers will fight valiantly. My Flag Squad will arrive at the Airport in two hours. In the meantime, your mission is to send all remaining personnel to the stronghold—including White Wolves and operators—and prepare for battle. Await the order to counterattack.
disp_detail.4010329: A good helmet can save your life in a pinch, but anything that can stop a bullet greatly increases your chance of successfully extracting. If you find a helmet in the Dark Zone, remember to bring it out with you. You'll definitely find a use for it.
disp_detail.9341416: We took back the Airport in a single day! You were outstanding, operator. Having someone like you in the Dark Zone is a miracle in and of itself. Our mission here is almost complete, but your performance has left a lasting impression on me. You're professional, experienced, and kind to others. But all good things must come to an end, and this is no exception. I must return to Tevila to face punishment for a past mission. I also want to show everyone back home that heroes don't run from their responsibilities—that our flag still flies high over Tevila!
disp_detail.4010702: Some recruits start blasting away the second they get their hands on an assault rifle. But the thing is, if you fire and miss your target, you expose your position. Go to the Valley and show them how it's done!
disp_detail.4010202: Some recruits start blasting away the second they get their hands on an assault rifle. But the thing is, if you fire and miss your target, you expose your position. Why don't you show them how a real expert does it?
disp_detail.4010445: Some militants are hoarding flammable items in the Valley. It's too dangerous to leave them in their hands. If you run into the militants, bring a bunch of those flammables back. I don't know their exact location, so you might have to look around.
disp_detail.9041202: A great war is about to break out, and I need some materials urgently to help the locals strengthen their fortress. See if you can find some building materials from the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010127: There's been regular activity from an unknown group near the Villa in the Valley. They've been making too many waves and attracting trouble. Frankly, it's giving me a headache. I need your squad to head over and help me solve the problem.
disp_detail.5030310: An elite squad appeared in Northridge not too long ago. Go to where they stopped and see if they've left any information behind.
disp_detail.5030318: An elite squad appeared in Northridge not too long ago. Go to where they stopped and see if they've left any information behind.
disp_detail.5030328: An elite squad appeared in Northridge not too long ago. Go to where they stopped and see if they've left any information behind.
disp_detail.5030338: An elite squad appeared in Northridge not too long ago. Go to where they stopped and see if they've left any information behind.
disp_detail.4010212: Under normal circumstances, I don't suggest you confront Dark Zone bosses head-on. But if you have the right weapon, like a carefully modified shotgun with powerful ammo... You might just be able to pull it off.
disp_detail.9011504: Three investigations have turned up nothing. On the surface, everything in the Valley seems normal. Yet the more rumors I hear, the more I sense there's another unseen side to that place. My rational mind tells me to stop—but... Operator, make one more run for me: tell all our people in the Valley to pull out.
disp_detail.9341603: The cargo you activated the locators for has safely reached Guoyapos. The plan worked. Next, I need you to head to the Farm and activate the remaining coordinate locators. Also, the recon squad has a new report: Team Annihilation movements have changed. It seems they suspect the true motives of the White Wolf squad. We know for a fact that at least one group of operators hired by Team Annihilation is conducting a counter-investigation in Marulos. You need to stay on high alert while activating those locators. If they spot you, don't hesitate—eliminate them immediately. Leave no loose ends.
disp_detail.9261310: Colonel said in his letter to tell you to help us bolster the Farm's defenses. We also need to clear out any sleepers the Westerners left behind. You might be surprised to hear it, but everything that happened recently wasn't new for us. The Southerners have never really left the Dark Zone—remnants of their numbers, supported by the Westerners, crop up from time to time, making trouble in Marulos. We may have won this battle, but believe you me—the Southerners are already preparing for the next.
disp_detail.9261311: The combat plan you brought back last time was a bit strange. Apparently, the plan wasn't to wreak havoc on the Guard Corps, but rather to find an ex-Southern Army demolitions expert. Luckily, I've heard of this guy—had a little tango with him at the Armory years back. He used directional charges to destroy a bunch of the weapon nests I'd set up in the Underground Mine. I'd reckon he knows the place like the back of his hand, so he could make a lot of trouble for the colonel. I can't let him roam free. Operator, head to that Stronghold and have a good look around.
disp_detail.1050102: Not much came of what you brought me last time. I think there was an accident at the Hotel. My people are all out on other errands, so could you go to Camp Services and see if it can be turned into a temporary base? Take care of those militants while you're at it. We haven't had control of Northridge in a while, and I'd like to put some of my own people there. I have to know what's going on there at all times.
disp_detail.9271202: I owe you for the other day. I heard biotechnological meds and prosthesis have started to spread over here. I need to find that guy and figure things out ASAP! Maybe try those guys that wander the wild. I think you call them militants here? I'm sure they'll have some clues.
disp_detail.9051112: We still haven't figured out the last one, yet there's a new job at the Farm. They require some humanitarian assistance over there. As messengers of peace, we cannot allow such an opportunity to slip from our grasp. So, my friend, transport some medical supplies to the Farm. Direct assistance is the only way to make them accept and acknowledge you.
disp_detail.1050902: That thing from before still isn't over yet, but there's a new job at the Farm. They require some humanitarian assistance over there. As messengers of peace, we cannot allow such an opportunity to slip from our grasp. So, we sent over some medical supplies to the Farm. Direct assistance is the only way to make them accept and acknowledge you. Now that it's coming to an end, I need you to retrieve the remaining medical supplies. After all, they are extremely valuable in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.1010805: You did well in the last battle, so if you're looking for something similar, then I've got a load here for you. A few days ago, a group of unidentified individuals appeared at the Farm, running amok. The client is wanting you to go over there and teach them a lesson. They need to be taught that the Dark Zone is no place for running wild. Of course, a successful extraction is the top priority, and it's not mandatory that you involve yourself in such things.
disp_detail.1040004: Good job last time. Some people just need to be taught a lesson now and then, or they forget their place. This feedback came just in time. Visit the wooden bridge in the Valley and the top floor of the Supply Camp Outpost. Someone left me two boxes of files that I need you to bring me.
disp_detail.9051405: They struck fast. This doesn't look like the Forest Man's handiwork—it looks like our "friend" from the North has gotten involved too. If he's the opposition, the original plan is likely a no-go. A new plan is already in the works. In the meantime, friend, I need you to head over to the Farm. A militant there has something I need. He's hoping to trade it for a ticket out of the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010230: Different situations call for different weapons. It would be foolhardy to fight a submachine gun at close range with a marksman rifle. You'd better keep your distance from the target.
disp_detail.9271208: Kamona and Night City will be in trouble if the "door" isn't fully closed. Seize the opportunity before the "door" in Northridge is fully open. A friend of mine just sent me a technical manual, but you'll need to be the one to do it.
disp_detail.4011008: Not all supplies need to be sold at the Market. Many low-price items can be sold directly to Deke Vinson to free up storage space. Many rare collectibles can also be sold to him, and for good money.

disp_detail.4010436: I don't know why, but the militants at the Farm have been more active lately. I'm not sure what they're planning, but if we don't put a little pressure on them, they'll only get more aggressive.
disp_detail.4010454: I don't know why, but the militants at the Farm have been more active lately. I'm not sure what they're planning, but if we don't put a little pressure on them, they'll only get more aggressive.
disp_detail.4010418: I don't know why, but the militants in the Valley have been more active lately. I'm not sure what they're planning, but if we don't put a little pressure on them, they'll only get more aggressive.
disp_detail.4010472: I don't know why, but the militants in the Valley have been more active lately. I'm not sure what they're planning, but if we don't put a little pressure on them, they'll only get more aggressive.
disp_detail.9051117: Our enemies have begun to unite. Someone must be supporting them in secret, but we don't have the time to figure that out. Show them that resistance is futile. Head to the Farm and shut them up! I'm sure I don't have to teach you how. After all, you're the expert in that department.
disp_detail.9431615: Expert, have you ever considered the following questions: What is humanity's ultimate fate in this Sumek Comet Crisis? To be saved, or to simply go extinct? After this operation, I hope you'll formally join Team Annihilation and become part of my squad. This is the only place you can find a ticket to the new world. Whether it's Colom or Tevila, or the politicians spouting their rhetoric in the Sumek Committee, they all cry "salvation" and offer hypocritical "aid". But look closely—who have they actually saved? At least Toland is taking action. Their methods might not be clean, but they're definitely searching for a solution. True, the experiments may lack humanity. But if nothing is done, this disaster will swallow us all. The great powers care only about profit, while Toland is the only one who cares whether enough people survive. Believe it or not, this is the company's stance.
disp_detail.9431606: Expert, do you remember that friend you met at the Observation Deck? It looks like the idiot exposed themselves. A complete waste of my previous cover. However, one should always try to make use of everything, so I think I'll bring them over to Northridge. Knowing Talia, she'll probably leave an opening for that idiot to escape, then use the opportunity to track them. I plan to play right into her hands. I'll lead their trackers right to the Viper, and then look for a chance to... plant a deeper, smarter nail.
disp_detail.9431612: Are you in position, Expert? Good. Team Annihilation has already torn a few holes in the Airport's outer defenses. I need you to cut in from the north. The White Wolves have all their attention on the south right now, so you can deal a heavy blow from behind while their guard is down.
disp_detail.9431613: Expert, there's something I haven't told you. Talia and I... we used to be really good friends. Back at the Tevila Military Academy, she was the type of person who excelled at everything. Training, tactics, command—she had no weaknesses, except that she was slightly inferior to me in special parachute jumps. I envied her back then, and even looked up to her as a role model... I suppose she might have seen me the same way. But when I had nowhere left to turn, and she was the only one who could help me, she just vanished without a trace and abandoned me! Even after all these years, I've never forgotten that past!
disp_detail.9431616: Expert, things are just about done at the Airport now. We've drawn in enough White Wolves for backup. Intel control has ceased, so they should have received the message that the Major General's special flight was diverted to the capital's Airport. We'll leave the rest of the combat to Blackgold so that they can continue to harass them. Follow the Apostle's squad and prepare for an orderly extraction. By the way, the mole just sent word—Talia's convoy has departed, and our preparations at Pier 7 are complete. After all these years apart, I hope she won't be too surprised to see me.
disp_detail.9431614: Expert, Tevila's reinforcements are here, and they're faster than expected. Talia is moving quickly over there—it seems she still has her skills. I need you to intercept them. You don't have to wipe them out completely; just delay them. Buy some time for the Apostle's operation in the Control Tower. But don't push too hard; I'll deploy a squad from Team Annihilation to coordinate with your actions.
disp_detail.9041209: Derwin and his gang betrayed our faction to keep a warship from Tevila. But he's been staying in line all these years, and to ensure he keeps doing that, I need you at the TV Station to check if anything out of the ordinary is happening at the Port.
disp_detail.5010501: There are more and more infected bodies in the Main Warehouse. The client wants them gone from this world. Destroy all of their spawn.
disp_detail.1020703: I asked around about the truck with the license plate you found, and they said that it headed toward Northridge. I wonder if my father was with them? I need to get a message to my people. Will you place this letter at the Farm's unloading area? Oh, and the medical station at Northridge left a package for me on the road to the Tunnel. Please bring that back for me as well.
disp_detail.5030317: There used to be a group of scientists active in Northridge, and they left behind some rather valuable precision equipment. I need you to find it.
disp_detail.5030327: There used to be a group of scientists active in Northridge, and they left behind some rather valuable precision equipment. I need you to find it.
disp_detail.5030337: There used to be a group of scientists active in Northridge, and they left behind some rather valuable precision equipment. I need you to find it.
disp_detail.9031207: The previous incident made Porrero suspicious. He is blocking off the Mine and restricting the movement of people and transactions. He also said he wanted a huge batch of goods. I have to ask a merchant in the Valley for help. Quick, deliver the shopping list now. Otherwise, it'll be too late.
disp_detail.9431605: The Crows pulled out just in time, and the White Wolves caught nothing but air. Just thinking about Talia's meticulously prepared airlift plan being vetoed by those incompetent Tevila superiors... it makes me laugh. Still, it seems the company is incredibly resourceful to be able to influence decisions at that level. All right, back to the mission. Talia is now left with only maritime transport options. Currently, there aren't many suitable docks for mooring in Guoyapos. I need you to keep making some noise at the Airport to confuse them. And I need to... prepare for our upcoming meeting.
disp_detail.9261314: Well, that's all there is to that. There wasn't anyone acting behind the scenes. To be honest with you, I find it hard to empathize with them. Even now, I really don't know what "honor" actually means. My father traded me to the army when I was 14 for half a case of suds. By 20, I'd buttered the officers up enough to make captain. They put me in command of the weaklings in the guard battalion. I wanted a promotion, so I worked hard, trained them into elite soldiers... Nobody cared. The second war broke out, we were thrown aside like last week's news. More than that, the brass even faked intel, hoping that the Southern Army would wipe us out. I'll never forget how they betrayed us—or how the colonel showed up to rescue us.
disp_detail.9031308: Sure enough, the Westerners had a hand in it. They just can't help themselves. They're always recklessly stirring up trouble and causing pain in Kamona, and they drive Kamonans against each other just to fight over certain interests with the Northerners. I dare say those Southerners must be planning something horrible, destructive, and unfavorable to Kamona right now. I need you to locate those Southerners in Northridge, then my guys will deal with the rest.
disp_detail.9341608: I'll provide funds and basic supplies for the decoy op at Pier 5, but you'll need to source the required weapons and gear yourself. The Guard Corps has received lots of military aid from Tevila, including basic weapons and supplies, and I trust you've got your own way to get your hands on whatever else you'll need.
disp_detail.3041429: Fertilizer is the best thing for crops. I gotta help my little ones. Bring some fertilizer over. We'll do the trade somewhere else this time.
disp_detail.9401504: What?! You found traces of a suspected command squad at the Armory? That's an unexpected windfall—excellent work. Don't let them slip away! I've already contacted the local White Wolves; they'll provide you with the necessary supplies and equipment. Make sure you intercept them before they leave the Armory! I've got a strong feeling we're close to securing some critical intel.
disp_detail.4990102: Successfully extract from a raid in any mode 1 time.
disp_detail.4990702: Successfully extract from a raid in any mode 1 time.
disp_detail.9031305: It would be great if they're willing to live out their lives in Northridge. At least the people over there won't be so hostile toward them. But we have a new problem. If they're leaving the Valley for Northridge, they must return to Marulos, and when considering a relatively safer route, passing through the Farm will be their most likely choice. Considering the tense relationship they had, I'm worried conflict will break out between them again. I'll have to leave it in your hands again, my friend. Please clear out a relatively safe path through the Farm.
disp_detail.1010001: Greetings from the humanitarian doctors! I hope you're not too tired out from Joel's training. I think we'll be seeing a lot of each other, so I recommend getting familiar with local prices and markets. Of course, first you'll have to go out and find some stuff worth selling.
disp_detail.9351403: The ambush was a resounding success, thanks in no small part to your special elimination squad. I'm sure we'll have the chance to meet soon. Now, I need you to go to the Armory and eliminate a hidden threat for me. I'm sure you remember how Renoir's name was dragged through the mud in the international press after that incident. Some of his soldiers still hold a grudge and are trying to clear his name. It seems they've forgotten that a soldier's only role is to follow orders. This will end in disaster.
disp_detail.1050802: Buddy, listen to me. First thing tomorrow morning, my convoy will set off to the hotel to escort several key figures out. All the arrangements are in place, so this is a simple mission. However, time is of the essence, so you need to get over to Northridge immediately and get rid of all the troublemakers who might get in the way of my plan. Get out of there as soon as you're done, so you don't accidentally get caught up in the action and injured.
disp_detail.4010848: It's not impossible to take care of a squad of targets in Covert Ops. If you have a weapon with strong effective range, consider attacking from a distance. That way, even if your enemy fights back, you won't be caught on your back foot.
disp_detail.4010820: It's not always necessary to maintain a low profile in Covert Ops. If in the course of your raid, you happen upon some good equipment and supplies, don't shy away from confronting the enemy head-on.

Aim for their vitals before pulling the trigger, and try to keep a safe distance, so that you can easily retreat should you fail.

disp_detail.4010337: Prioritize high-value supplies in Covert Ops. There are lots of safes in the Dark Zone, and they might contain valuable items. Remember to search them when you come across them. You might find something worth your time.
disp_detail.4010313: Prioritize high-value supplies in Covert Ops. Some residents left in a hurry, and didn't have time to take their luggage with them. When you come across a suitcase, search it. You may find something nice inside.

disp_detail.9021003: Maybe, as a doctor, I don't understand the situation as well as you, but these cold-blooded attacks suggest that every one of us will probably draw the short end of the stick. And as the person in charge, it's my responsibility to learn why these attacks are happening. Please go investigate the scene of the crime and see if you can find any clues on the reasons for these attacks.
disp_detail.9341609: It's almost time for the op. Most of the Team Annihilation strongholds in Guoyapos and Marulos have either been driven out or suppressed, so now's our best transport window. A disguised Tevila merchant ship is heading for Kamona, and I need you and your operators to execute the decoy op at Pier 5. I'll also send a squad of White Wolves to assist with the defense. Remember that you're decoys, not martyrs—if things go south, just hold your ground and wait for our reinforcements.
disp_detail.1060101: You did well last time with a team. Your next mission is very simple. Take a team to the Farm and eliminate some enemies at certain key locations. Make sure you bring some extra people. My client wants to attract plenty of attention. You should know some good people for this job, right?
disp_detail.9041107: I've double-checked the information you brought back, and there were no clues about where the generator went or the people that launched the attack. I can't allow things that happen in the Dark Zone to be out of my control. This must have something to do with Ajax. Seems he's forgotten his loyalties after becoming Renoir's second-in-command. He won't get away with this. Visit the Farm Stables and Motel to collect clues. While you're there, give them a little warning. I'm sure you know what I mean.
disp_detail.1040104: I've double-checked the information you brought back, and there were no clues about where the generator went or the people that launched the attack. I can't allow things that happen in the Dark Zone to be out of my control. This must have something to do with Ajax. Seems he's forgotten his loyalties after becoming Renoir's second-in-command. He won't get away with this. Visit the Farm Stables and Motel to collect clues. While you're there, give them a little warning. I'm sure you know what I mean.
disp_detail.9021015: Those clues you brought back from the Radio Station have led to developments in the search for my father. My informants found some pieces of a burnt white lab coat at the RV Camp in the Valley. This is quite likely to be my father's coat, so we need to move fast—because with each passing day, the clues fade and the danger grows.
disp_detail.9271206: A local family seems to be in touch with the guy I'm looking for. I think they're trying to strike a business deal with Night City. Their brains from the Stone Age simply can't comprehend the consequences of that. I sent them a message, but I guess a verbal warning isn't enough.
disp_detail.9421508: You've done an excellent job. It's safe to say Team Annihilation will be fully drawn in by this carefully designed "escape route." However, even with a complete chain of physical evidence, the story lacks credibility without an eyewitness to back it up. I'm sure you already have a good idea of how to create a convincing "eyewitness."
disp_detail.9020102: Well done, it looks like they're still occupying the Lobby of the TV Station, which is good news indeed. Speaking of missions, a piece of confidential information was placed on my desk recently, the content of which was a bit... well, shocking. Because of this, I sent Kurt's elite squad to the TV Station, and as agreed, they blocked the signal there shortly after gaining entry. However, this alerted members of the White Wolf Squad outside, so in order to avoid being attacked from both sides, Kurt sent some of his people to blow up the entrances to the TV Station, causing their supplies to be interrupted. There's now constant gunfire coming from inside there, so I need you to help me smuggle a delivery of supplies and military equipment in, and leave them in the Warehouse on the first floor and the Interview Room, respectively. This is an emergency! Go now!
disp_detail.5020429: Go defend the Village. The locals want to take it back. We can't let that happen.
disp_detail.4010184: When you and your team are operating in the Armory, make good use of the terrain there to hide your tracks and avoid being attacked. If you end up engaging with other operators, your best bet is to end the fight as quickly as possible.
disp_detail.4010198: When carrying out an operation at the Armory with your squad, be careful of the occupying force. They're not to be messed with. When a fight is inevitable, it's best to finish it up quickly. Capture the high ground as fast as you can and take out anyone drawn to the noise.
disp_detail.4010190: When carrying out an operation at the Armory with your squad, be careful of the occupiers. They're not to be messed with. When a fight is inevitable, it's best to deal with them quickly to avoid getting trapped by enemies coming from the rear.
disp_detail.9041208: Your work at the Armory has drawn the attention of some people, and I don't want them finding me. So, I need you to go there a few more times and conduct a few more operations to keep them guessing.
disp_detail.9041222: The operation you pulled off in Northridge lit a fire under me. As agreed, I'll be delivering a fresh batch of supplies to Renoir. He'll need them to fulfill his duties.
disp_detail.9261313: Good work running defense on the periphery. We were able to easily get hold of our target. Too bad we weren't able to get the answers we wanted from him. I know what methods the guard battalion uses. Unless he's some kind of superhuman, he really was here just because of that nonsense he spouted. I don't give a rat's ass about any of it, to be honest. I didn't become a soldier because of honor or justice—I became a soldier because I'm good at it, that's all.
disp_detail.9021001: Hello, operator. I am Evita, the representative for Doctors Without Borders. You probably already know about what we're doing in Kamona. And we will be offering an expert such as yourself the customary payment, of course. We are in urgent need of certain medical supplies, and we've heard usable ones can be found at the Farm's Recycling Station. Please make a trip there.
disp_detail.9271201: Oh, it's a new face. I'm sure you've noticed I'm from Night City. Though I just got here, your reputation precedes you. I'm looking for someone over here, but I've got to keep it on the down-low. I need a place to lie low, preferably somewhere that serves drinks. I'm sure you know this place like the back of your hand, right?
disp_detail.9411509: The new intel you brought back confirms my suspicions. As I suspected, this was a carefully fabricated trail. I am now certain that the Blast Squad never crossed the frontline. Move out. Notify all members of Team Annihilation in every sector to abandon their current approach and redeploy for coordinated sector-wide sweep.
disp_detail.1020401: That videotape was of my father a few months ago. It looks like the intelligence officers were telling the truth. Could you take this package to the Valley Village? It contains some supplies they need. There's trouble out there, so be careful. Good luck.
disp_detail.1020301: You probably know that a while ago the Valley was in turmoil. Violence broke out after someone allegedly attempted to sabotage an important deal for Doss. Now, his power in the Valley has been compromised. By the way, those clues you brought back from the Radio Station have led to developments in the search for my father. My informant found some pieces of a burnt white lab coat at the RV Camp in the Valley. This is quite likely to be my father's coat, so I need you to go and help me investigate. I'd be ever so grateful!
disp_detail.9051202: I'm sure you realize that freedom doesn't come for free, and capital is indispensable to achieve my goal. Search Northridge and bring me some valuables. Oh, and don't draw any attention to yourself.
disp_detail.4010139: When you encounter a heavily armed enemy, you can't always be sure that you'll have a strong enough weapon to fend them off. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. I hope you'll keep that in mind the next time you go to Northridge Hotel.
disp_detail.4010115: When you encounter a heavily armed enemy, you can't always be sure that you'll have a strong enough weapon to fend them off. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. I hope you and your teammates will keep that in mind the next time you go to Northridge.
disp_detail.4010157: When you encounter a heavily armed enemy, you can't always be sure that you'll have a strong enough weapon to fend them off. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. I hope you and your squad will keep that in mind the next time you go to the Armory.
disp_detail.9031316: You're a hero to these three factions now, you know that? Kamona will remember everything you've done here. What you've seen play out lately is basically a miniature version of Kamona's entire history—we're always at the heart of the conflict between the superpowers to the north and west. Their deceit and destruction runs along the history of Kamona like a scar. It's almost like they're playing a game of chess, moving pieces, taking pieces, marking their territory—but Kamona is not a chessboard! This is our home! I will do everything in my power to wrest Kamona out from between them. Kamonans will one day lead true lives, lives of freedom and dignity.
disp_detail.9231201: Got a minute? We need you now. My guys got ambushed the moment they arrived in Northridge. No casualties, but this was no accident. It was a message. We'll hit them head-on soon. I just need you to cut off their retreat. No survivors.

disp_detail.9421506: Your work was clean and efficient. I knew I picked the right person. However, a disguise that's too perfect might arouse the Apostle's suspicion. So, I need you to make another trip to the Armory. Add a few "flaws" to what you've already set up, things that look like they were left behind in a hurry. We'll use these subtle imperfections to sell the illusion of a real escape.
disp_detail.9231211: Your report was very helpful for the raid, except it lacked intel on the inside of the Armory. That place is a powder keg waiting to blow. Get inside the Armory, scout it out, and give the rats in there something to squeal about.
disp_detail.9251306: Your performance is bringing all kinds of new support to the Guard Corps behind the scenes. There's no question in my mind now that we're going to become a more important player in the Dark Zone's future. I've also got more say now in how the Guard Corps operates. I've developed a deep appreciation for your skills, so I'm going to get real with you for a minute. I'm not sure how you feel about authority, but to me, authority means power—the power to lift someone up, or bring them to their knees. That's why I came down here from up north to begin with. I want that power, more than anything. And I'm only going to get stronger from here. You've earned my respect, so I'd like to invite you on this journey with me.
disp_detail.9041211: Your supplies were a great help, but I'm still short on energy. After all, without gasoline, even the toughest tank won't run.
disp_detail.9341606: Your investigation was effective—the traitor finally made a mistake, and I've narrowed the suspects down to just five people. He's hiding deep, but if we keep the pressure on, I'm afraid he might do something desperate, and I don't want to risk too much damage. The traitor likely knows we're onto him, so he's looking for a way out. At this point, I think it's better to guide his path than to block it. I'll leave a gap for his escape at the TV Station, and once he steps into the trap, Maxim will track him, leading us straight to his handlers.
disp_detail.9401510: See? I told you! Despite a few bumps along the way, you and the cargo made it to the TV Station safe and sound. Alright, the Warrant Officer is in charge now. I guess it's time for me to head back to the Airport and resume my post as "temporary commander." Catch you later, my friend!
disp_detail.9031208: I'm sure you've heard about the new guest in the Farm. She doesn't seem to be getting along very well with Ajax. I need you to visit the Farm and gather more information on them, and if possible, it's best if you manage to get on friendly terms with her.
disp_detail.4060101: As you may know, some people have entrusted me to get them out of a sticky situation. I could use your help with that. The mission is simple: Go to the Farm and make a little noise, then eliminate the enemies there and take their weapons. After that, you can consider the job done. My people will take care of the rest.
disp_detail.4060102: As you may know, some people have entrusted me to get them out of a sticky situation. I could use your help with that. disp_detail.1990005: You've gained my trust and respect. Now that you've arrived at the Naval Port, I can give you some important tasks. I've had a business partner for many years here, and I've always been able to rely on their cooperation. However, a lot has happened in Guoyapos recently, especially at the TV Station. Many lost their lives. I'm worried that what happened there will affect business at the Naval Port, so I'd like you to visit a few places to help me drop off some stuff and set up traps, just in case. I can't use my people there. People might misunderstand, you know? That's why I'm entrusting this matter to you.
disp_detail.1010102: Remember the Convoy Wreckage by the road at the Farm just under the bridge? It's rumored that what got bombed was part of the Gungnir project. I've been commissioned to find someone to investigate the wreckage and see if there's anything valuable in there.
disp_detail.1020713: Why would they leave in such a hurry but park the vehicle at the Plant? Shouldn't they have been trying to escape Northridge? Why did they stop at the Plant? Maybe there's something I don't know. Could you go down to the Sewage Plant again and check inside? The plot thickens...
disp_detail.9341510: The Apostle has retreated. Operator, congratulations—we've won. Yuri would be proud of me, and I'm proud of Maxim. Next, we'll safely transport these important goods back to Tevila. Thank you for your exceptional effort and steadfast support throughout this operation.
disp_detail.5120401: Keep Doss safe until he extracts.
disp_detail.5020403: Stay on the move. You don't want to hang around one place too long. Somebody will spot you.
disp_detail.1000099: Do safes and keychains count toward equipment value?
disp_detail.9411604: Well done. Renoir is in a rage and preparing to lock down the Armory altogether, but the Crows won't be caught in such a crude net. I'll lead the Crows out, soldier. I want you to take this opportunity to leave some "gifts" for those fools. Once you finish placing them, rendezvous at the safehouse to the south. The Crows will be waiting.
disp_detail.9261315: Good work. You've helped the colonel deal with all sorts of trouble. I've got a reward for you—and this one's from me, personally. While we're talking, you wouldn't have any interest in joining the Guard Corps, would you? By that, I mean helping the colonel on a more long-term basis. I left a letter for you on the second floor of the Motel. In it, you'll find the reward I promised you, and a personal note from me. Pick it up when you get the chance.
disp_detail.9431603: Beautifully done, you really do live up to the Crows' recommendation. Next, Expert, I'll need you to take a trip to the Observation Deck. A friend will be heading there to give me an answer. Oh, and by the way—if they don't leave behind any intel on those guys at the TV Station, just do me a favor and take them out. I don't need a friend who remains loyal to Tevila.
disp_detail.9011601: After the ceasefire agreement was signed, the former battle zone became a military Hostile Sector. We currently have no intel from the inside, so I need you to go in and figure out what's going on.

You'll transfer there and travel by water to the southeastern coast of Guoyapos, where local contacts will rendezvous with you at a designated spot. You are the third team being deployed; the first two have already established a forward operating base south of the Airport. Once you arrive, command will be transferred to Hecate. You'll take your orders from her and provide assistance. Before the flotilla arrives, my friend, I need you to lead a squad and secure the Port. Ensure the gathering teams can board without incident.
disp_detail.4010242: A powerful weapon like the S12K needs to be used up close, if you hope to get the most out of it. However, using special ammunition can increase its effective radius, allowing you to engage from greater distances.

disp_detail.5030312: I need your help retrieving some stuff I lost. I don't want anyone to know about my dealings with Fred.
disp_detail.5030322: I need your help retrieving some stuff I lost. I don't want anyone to know about my dealings with Fred.
disp_detail.5030332: I need your help retrieving some stuff I lost. I don't want anyone to know about my dealings with Fred.
disp_detail.5030306: Friend, those damn elite militants have taken over the Sewage Plant. The pollution in Northridge is getting out of hand. Go take them out for me.
disp_detail.5020301: Don't leave the Villa just yet. Someone's coming. Defend this place.
disp_detail.5020316: The battle in the Valley is significantly impacting the daily lives of the locals. Someone asked me to eliminate the threat of cannon shells in the flower field, and I think you're perfect for the job.
disp_detail.5020322: The battle in the Valley is significantly impacting the daily lives of the locals. Someone asked me to eliminate the threat of cannon shells in the flower field, and I think you're perfect for the job.
disp_detail.5020328: The battle in the Valley is significantly impacting the daily lives of the locals. Someone asked me to eliminate the threat of cannon shells in the flower field, and I think you're perfect for the job.
disp_detail.5010313: My men were attacked by an unknown group! I've marked their extraction route for you. Follow it and look for clues. Find out who they are!
disp_detail.5020308: According to our intel, a militant is carrying a Warehouse key around the Villa. Subdue him at all costs. I need that key!
disp_detail.4010725: People usually keep their distance from heavily armed enemies. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. The Vector 45 might not come with armor-piercing ammo, but its extremely high rate of fire will surely make them weak at the knees, and in more ways than one.
disp_detail.9031307: I've got a good grasp of the situation now. It's clear to me that the Southerners started it deliberately, and at the same time, a few unfamiliar faces popped up in the Valley. I still don't know why they did it, but it reeks of that familiar smell of a conspiracy. Those Southerners aren't the most meticulous guys, so if they were really involved, I doubt they could have erased all the traces. I need you back there again to uncover any abnormalities or a link between them.
disp_detail.3041425: Writing is my biggest hobby, but I'm running out of hardcover books at home. Courier, please bring me some.
disp_detail.4010180: The operational environment at the Port can be complex, so I'd like to make sure you're familiar with it. It is also common to run into other operators there. Ending encounters quickly is a skill you must learn.
disp_detail.4010181: The operational environment at the Port can be complex, so I'd like to make sure you're familiar with it. You can save yourself a lot of trouble if you can defeat the enemy with a single shot fired at long range. I hope you have good shooters on your team.
disp_detail.4010470: The previous residents of the Farm left behind a lot of household supplies that can be a pain to find in other parts of the Dark Zone. If you want to collect some, you should be able to find them easily enough by rummaging through drawers you come across in rooms.
disp_detail.4010419: The Warehouse Area at the Farm not only has lots of food, but also lots of building materials. It's hard to get your hands on building materials in the Dark Zone. If you happen to be in the area, see if you can find anything useful there.
disp_detail.4010910: The Warehouse Area at the Farm not only has lots of food, but also lots of building materials. It's hard to get your hands on building materials in the Dark Zone. If you happen to be in the area, see if you can find anything useful there.
disp_detail.4010178: You should be pretty familiar with the Farm by now, so you should also be pretty clued up on where other operators appear from. Trust me, launching a surprise attack will definitely get you good results, but that'll mean working well with your teammates.
disp_detail.4010192: You should be pretty familiar with the Farm by now, so you should also be pretty clued up on where the militants and operators appear from. Trust me, launching a surprise attack will definitely get you good results, but that'll mean working well with your squad.
disp_detail.9041406: There's a situation at the Farm. The guard battalion lost a document with information on their defensive positions. Ajax has locked down the Farm and is searching the settlements of militants. This is probably the work of the Westerners, and you know they'll cover their tracks, so the guard battalion's investigation is unlikely to yield results. Soldier, I need you to deliver a shipment of gear to the Farm and reinforce their defenses immediately. We can't let Ajax become a weak point for the Southern Army to exploit.
disp_detail.1010103: A helicopter has crashed at the unloading area in the north of the Farm. A client wants to know what's going on, and maybe stir up a little trouble so that anyone with malicious intentions makes themselves known. Make sure you get back quickly to complete the mission though, because that area is already a huge mess.

Make sure you get back quickly to complete the mission though, because that area is already a huge mess.
disp_detail.4010426: Most of the militants at the Farm have poor equipment. Many of them don't even have body armor! If you come across any, be sure to pick it up. It's better than nothing, and certainly cheaper than if you buy it.
disp_detail.9051412: There's been a new development in the strange business at the Farm. Kayla's found some clues... It seems a "ghost" who should have been forgotten is about to reappear. The clues are all from the recent hunt at the TV Station. What on earth is Toland trying to do with Team Annihilation... I'm afraid I have to ask you to go to the Farm again, friend. I need you to carefully reexamine all of the clues left at the scene for me.
disp_detail.4010191: There have been a lot of operators at the Farm recently, and there's been some activity from nearby militants. The situation there has grown pretty complicated. I hate it, so I need you to head to the Farm and teach those guys a lesson.
disp_detail.4010179: A lot of operators with excellent equipment have appeared on the Farm. You might have the same target, but don't think you can avoid conflict. If you want to survive in the Dark Zone, mercy isn't an option, so work with your teammates to take out anyone in your way.
disp_detail.1010602: The Basement of the Farm Motel is used to store fuel for the kitchen. No one ever goes down there. I need some flammables. Go get a few more for me. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your time.
disp_detail.9291203: The Farm's been overrun by Ajax's thugs. They're chewing through my supply lines like hyenas. Operator, I need you to teach them a lesson.
disp_detail.9041117: The counterattack at the Farm isn't looking good. A northern lookout dropped some intel in the combat zone. The North needs to see it, and I need more information as well. I need you to retrieve the intel from the Farm.
disp_detail.4010968: Something strange is going on at the Farm. Take this opportunity to infiltrate, blend in among the militants, and see what good things you can grab. But remember to move quickly. You don't want to attract any unnecessary trouble.
disp_detail.9241312: Our Stronghold at the Farm was discovered. The guard battalion managed to drag off a few of us, but thankfully they don't know much about our plans, so the guard battalion won't be able to get much intel out of them. Maybe you haven't heard, but we got a demolitions expert in Northridge to cook up a set of high-powered explosives for us. We're going to use them to take out targets on the periphery of the Armory's east side, after which our squad there will retreat. We're hoping they'll lead the Guard Corps on a wild goose chase, giving us a chance to send in an elite team to the west. They'll look for a chance to take out Renoir.
disp_detail.1010601: Food production on the Farm has ground to a halt. People have become reliant on imports, causing prices to skyrocket. Go look for food in the kitchen of the Motel, will you? But be careful, because it's occupied by some folks from the Armory.
disp_detail.3041422: How could the Farm's maintenance master be anything but classy? Accessorizing with wire-rimmed glasses is a great idea. I'll be waiting for you by the Pond!
disp_detail.1010202: You know the little hut by the Wheatfield on the Farm? I left my favorite lighter there. Will you look for it for me?
disp_detail.4010423: There aren't many resources to be found on the Farm, but if you pass by the Grain Trade Center, it's worth poking around to look for some. You'll find food, computer parts, household goods, and more there. If you're really lucky, you might even find something rare.
disp_detail.4010925: There aren't many resources to be found on the Farm, but if you pass by the Grain Trade Center, it's worth poking around to look for some. You'll find food, computer parts, household goods, and more there. If you're really lucky, you might even find something rare.
disp_detail.4010831: The Farm may not be particularly large, but the supplies strewn throughout it are tempting to some folks. You know the drill by now: first eliminate these threats before collecting the supplies.
disp_detail.4010843: The Farm may not be particularly large, but the supplies strewn throughout it are tempting to some folks. Occupy the supply storage point and take care of whoever shows up. Let them know who's the boss in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010807: The Farm may not be particularly large, but the supplies strewn throughout it are tempting to some folks. If you can clear out those areas, the resources within are yours. Won't be easy, though.

disp_detail.4010822: While the Farm Loading Area is not large by any means, there are still some supplies to be found. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.

However, you may come across interesting stuff in a couple of places, like the Motel and the Grain Trade Center. Don't skip these places if you want to make some quick money.

disp_detail.4010437: If there's anything you should be able to find at the Farm, it's food. There ought to be lots of food stored at the Motel, the Warehouses, and the Grain Trade Center. When you're short on food, take a look around those areas and stock up.
disp_detail.4010328: Strange things have been happening at the Farm lately. A mysterious group has been making secret plans... Go there and see if you can find any intel about it. Patrol along the route. Check everywhere.
disp_detail.4010458: There are lots of houses at the Farm. Their previous residents and the workers nearby left behind lots of clothes when they fled. I suggest searching the pockets for keys to locked rooms.
disp_detail.4010245: Tear gas is increasingly common in fights at the Farm these days. Wearing a gas mask can be an effective way to fight in such environments. However, wearing a mask will affect your vision somewhat, so there is a trade-off.
disp_detail.4010936: The Farm isn't big, but there are a lot of supplies stored there. Find some teammates and move out! After all, there's strength in numbers.
disp_detail.4010440: After the Farm was captured by the militants, a lot of residents left in a hurry and didn't have time to take their luggage with them. When you come across a suitcase, search it. You may find something nice inside.
disp_detail.4010213: Submachine guns are great for suppressing targets at close to mid range, but firing aimlessly isn't the most effective way to deal damage. The more dangerous a situation is, the calmer you should be when aiming.
disp_detail.4010236: Submachine guns can be brutally effective at close range, but to deal with the bosses who have entrenched themselves in the Dark Zone, you'll need to use ammo with strong armor-piercing capabilities. You'll also want to enlist teammates to help you.
disp_detail.9401507: The Warrant Officer agrees with my assessment. She plans to join forces with the Guard Corps to intercept that "Apostle" squad. Packing up the "cargo" will take some time, so I need you to take a squad and intercept any members of Team Annihilation that might be heading back to the Farm. Do your best to hold them off and buy us more time!
disp_detail.9401604: New orders from the Warrant Officer: head to the TV Station and stand by. It's a total mess—seems like there's a traitor among the White Wolves. The Warrant Officer has narrowed down the suspect list, but hasn't caught the rat yet. You know her style—she's not one to spook a rat away. She's left an escape route open so the traitor can "safely" flee the TV Station. Our job is to tail him, confirm his identity, and he'll lead us right to his handlers.
disp_detail.9021011: It's been a while, soldier. Some things have been happening here that I need your help with. If you've got time, can you go check out the area around the Motel? There are some supplies hidden there—if you find anything unusual, bring it back here. Also, a new clue has been uncovered in the search for my father. My friend told me a convoy recently made a pit stop in Northridge before leaving. It's not clear what's going on right now, so I'm afraid I'll need to ask for your help again soon.
disp_detail.9411507: A new situation has developed. The Crows have picked up the trail of the Blast Squad in the south. All signs indicate they departed via the Airport and are moving south through Marulos. I need you to go to the Farm at once to investigate and verify this intel. The Crows will be conducting their own confirmation as well.
disp_detail.9010104: I've just been in contact with the White Wolf Squad, so I suspect that the folks at Blackgold have restored the communications network. The White Wolf Squad told me things aren't looking too good for them at the moment, as Blackgold have started attacking in earnest and they're struggling to hold them back. However, our members on the outskirts of the TV Station are on the lookout for Blackgold reinforcements that may arrive at any time, so they can't spare any manpower to clear the entrance. Would you sneak into the TV Station and go support them? Even one less Blackgold member will ease the pressure on them. There's no cap on the payment for this mission, if you know what I mean.
disp_detail.5040308: I just received word that there is a squad transporting supplies from the Gas Station to the Repair Facility. That cargo cannot reach its destination. Be quick about it, and don't let anyone know about my involvement.
disp_detail.5020309: The people set up in the Villa have been getting more brazen by the day. It's time to teach them a lesson.
disp_detail.9401509: Don't worry! What happened at the Farm was a complete accident—I swear I wasn't using you as bait! On the bright side, we really hammered Team Annihilation's main force, didn't we? You've probably guessed the next step—yep, we're setting another trap at the Armory to intercept any Team Annihilation squads that might be on your tail. You just focus on the delivery and leave the rest to us!

disp_detail.9041403: The Westerners caused quite a commotion at the Farm a few days ago. The guard battalion quickly stopped them, but not before they destroyed a lot of supplies. We've just learned that the commander of a Southern Army frontline unit will be leading a group of young officers to patrol the perimeter of the Valley. It's time for payback. Your mission: Set up an ambush on the outskirts of the Valley and eliminate this squad. It will be retaliation for the Westerners' actions and deliver a crippling blow to the Southern Army's frontline command.
