disp_detail.9041407: We received a message from the Valley the other day. It claims that Doss's attacks on the Southern Army's supply lines were a feint, and that he's actually pulling back his forces to preserve his strength. I need you to go to the Valley, soldier, and verify this information. If it's accurate, you're to use your ammo and remind Doss just who he has to thank for his survival in the Dark Zone! If Tevila can help the Antonio Family establish a foothold in the Valley, we can just as easily make the name "Antonio" disappear from it forever!
disp_detail.9051114: We recently stopped the counterattack of that group at the Farm, and it resulted in fierce conflict at the Armory. But we managed to resolve it in the end and took a step forward in our efforts to bring peace to the Dark Zone. Now, we should play safe and reinforce the current situation. Thus, I need you to eliminate all unstable elements in the Farm and Valley.
disp_detail.9041201: I've been busy dealing with the chaos at the Armory and the Farm lately, so I haven't had time to update the setup in Northridge. I need you to go there and install a new hidden radio.
disp_detail.4010156: The inside of the Armory is easy to defend, but difficult to attack. Once someone gets in first, it's easy for latecomers on the offensive to find themselves at a disadvantage. Better to take advantage of the time before the Armory opens to find suitable opponents and settle the score with them as quickly as possible.
disp_detail.4010154: The inside of the Armory is highly complex, and you'll be fighting at a very close range. In a combat environment like this, a small and convenient weapon like a submachine gun will serve you well. Just remember to check that there's no one tailing you before you go inside, or you might find yourself getting attacked from both sides.
disp_detail.4010159: Fighting inside and outside the Armory couldn't be more different. An all-round weapon like an assault rifle can be effective in various different combat environments. When carrying out an operation with your squad at the Armory, consider using a weapon like that. Of course, things change fast, so as soon as you enter a firefight, it's best to resolve it quickly.
disp_detail.9041116: The Armory is a key location in the north of Marulos, and it's definitely the Southern Army Ranks' next target. Our superiors don't want to lose control of it, so we've been authorized to assist Renoir. I need you to take some equipment and supplies to the Armory, and settle in there. You'll also be tasked with observing the situation there.
disp_detail.4010185: There are plenty of supplies up for grabs in the Armory, though most of the operators operating there are highly skilled and can be tough to deal with. The only way to extract the Armory is to completely eliminate the threat they pose to you.
disp_detail.4010189: There are a lot of supplies at the Armory. Of course, the people guarding them aren't exactly soft, but if you're really interested, I'd recommend bringing some skilled people along with you to take out the people in your way and eliminate any potential threats.
disp_detail.4010197: There are a lot of supplies at the Armory. Of course, the people guarding them aren't exactly soft, but if you're really interested, I'd recommend bringing some teammates along with you to take out the people in your way and eliminate any potential threats.
disp_detail.4010177: There are enough supplies at the Armory for you and your squad to come back with a full load. But if you want to extract safely, you'll need to get rid of any obstacles that are in your way. Otherwise, it'll all be for nothing.
disp_detail.4010160: There are enough supplies at the Armory for your whole squad to load up before heading back, just so long as you can make a safe extraction. As long as you make sure the Extraction Point is safe, you'll be able to bring supplies back with you. To do this, you'll need to eliminate any dangerous elements, so conflict between your squad and other operators is unavoidable.
disp_detail.4010158: If you look around, you'll find a lot of resources at the Armory, even outside it. So, if you don't feel like fighting other operators head-on, roaming the outside looking for supplies is a perfectly good strategy, and you can use a quiet weapon to eliminate your targets one by one. I recommend a Mosin-Nagant bolt-action rifle equipped with a suppressor.
disp_detail.9281203: Those guys at the Armory seem to have gotten their hands on some new toys, and it's making a mess of the war. I have a feeling it's linked to that thing from before. Let's start by investigating the matter.
disp_detail.4010738: After installing a modern stock, the superior performance of the M24 will make you unbeatable in the Valley. I need you to head there with this weapon and take out a few enemies. After you've shot them, remember to move fast.
disp_detail.9031309: My guys were stopped by unidentified forces while moving in to surround N. Village, and that gave those Southerners an opportunity to just swagger off right under my nose! Obviously, they're getting help from someone. I've sent my people to investigate their whereabouts. My friend, I need you to carefully investigate their Stronghold in N. Village for any traces they left behind there. I'm sure the Southerners couldn't have had enough time to destroy everything before they left.
disp_detail.9271209: The destruction of the "door" at Northridge was a warning to many. The guy I'm looking for has probably returned to Night City. So, there's no reason for me to stay any longer. Remember where we first met? Help me clear up. I think it's time I head home.
disp_detail.9241305: Northridge really is a nice place. When I was growing up in Zuate, I saw an ad for a tourist spot in Onotos. Tall mountains, rushing rivers—the most beautiful scenery imaginable. After Northridge Hotel was built, I had planned to take my family there for a few days. But the price... I just couldn't believe it. And even at such ridiculous rates, it was almost impossible to get a room there. I remember thinking, "Wow, Kamona really is the land of the rich." Now, Northridge Hotel is just a shadow of its former glory, and I... well, I'm even worse off! I wonder what we'll get in the end, for all our troubles. Defeat? Injury? Perhaps... judgment?
disp_detail.9411503: The outskirts of Northridge have been cleared—up to standard. Next target: the Hotel interior. I've heard of the man running the place. Never thought we'd end up on opposite sides, but times change, and so do allegiances. Let's hope he understands the situation and refrains from any meaningless resistance.
disp_detail.4010967: You can often find electronics in various indoor spaces in Northridge. In Covert Ops, remember to pay attention and grab some electronics to take back.
disp_detail.4010991: You can often find computer parts in various indoor spaces in Northridge. In Covert Ops, remember to pay attention to all the computers around and grab some computer parts to bring back.
disp_detail.1020802: After the Northridge Assault, I realized that all these factions were looking for my father and the other doctors. I know you must have a lot of questions. To be honest, I'm also pretty confused. Although I had suspected that my father was involved in some strange things, I never expected it to be so complicated. Fortunately, I've got a lead on where to find my father again, so I'm hopeful that this will all be resolved soon. Thank you for all your help with this. By the way, I had a look around the Small Factory and couldn't find any traces of my dad, but my people found some other clues elsewhere in the Valley. Could you bring these to me? They left the clues at the Radio Station.
disp_detail.9021014: After the Northridge Assault, I realized that all these factions were fighting over my father and the other doctors. I know you must have a lot of questions. To be honest, I'm also pretty confused. Although I had suspected that my father was involved in some strange things, I never expected it to be so complicated. Fortunately, I've got another lead on where my father is, so I'm hopeful that this will all be resolved soon. Thank you for all your help with this. By the way, I had a look around the Small Factory and couldn't find any sign of my dad, but my people found some other clues elsewhere in the Valley. Could you bring these to me? They left the clues at the Radio Station.
disp_detail.4010703: People usually keep their distance from those heavily armed enemies in Northridge. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. Armed with a shotgun, you shouldn't need telling what to do.
disp_detail.1050101: Have you been to the Hotel in Northridge? You might have heard that some medical experts were attacked when they stayed there a few months ago. Some of them are still missing. The reality is that this sort of thing happens here every day. We have to do something about it. I sent some informants down there to investigate, and I think they found something. They've left an important letter in the Hotel Parking Lot. Please bring it back to me—and don't ask any questions.
disp_detail.9041605: That Team Annihilation group in Northridge is tougher than expected. Their tactics are entirely different from before—they're more professional, ruthless, and decisive. I suspect there's been a change in their command. Keep an eye on Northridge. Don't rush in; figure out their patterns first. I'll get Espinos' intelligence officers to look into who's entered Kamona recently. I've got a feeling we'll dig something up. Stay safe out there in Northridge; these guys aren't easy to deal with.
disp_detail.9051102: Have you been to the Hotel in Northridge? You might have heard that some medical experts from the committee were attacked when they stayed there a few months ago. Some of them are still missing. The reality is that this sort of thing happens in the Dark Zone every day, and what really needs to be changed is the overall situation in the Dark Zone. Still, I've sent some informants there for investigations, and I think they've found something. They've left an important letter in the Hotel Parking Lot. Please bring it back to me—and don't ask any questions.
disp_detail.4010924: Northridge has abundant supplies and is attracting a lot of operators. At times like this, it would be better to find some teammates to do the operation with. After all, there's strength in numbers.
disp_detail.4010218: Northridge has abundant supplies and attracts a lot of operators, so sometimes it takes extreme measures to collect supplies in peace. It's better to do it in a group, as that increases your chance of getting out alive.
disp_detail.4010142: There's been a bit too much activity at Northridge Hotel lately. You can either join in the fun directly, or watch from afar. I'd suggest the latter to avoid a direct conflict. Wait at a distance with your squad, then strike hard at the right time and reap the benefits.
disp_detail.5030307: The people at Northridge Hotel have taken a bunch of my supplies! Find the key to that place before they transport the supplies elsewhere!
disp_detail.9401606: Northridge? Bit of a surprise. I thought the Vipers and Forest Men were still at each other's throats up there. For Team Annihilation to have a secret stronghold in that area... I'm afraid that means they might have ties with the Abyss. You stay up in Northridge, pal, and continue investigating. I'll head back to the TV Station and meet with the Warrant Officer to plan our next move.
disp_detail.9031202: Northridge has always been popular with tourists, and lots of their stuff still remains there. Help me look around the area and see if there's anything worth taking.
disp_detail.4010131: Something's appeared in Northridge that's attracting a lot of operators to come and investigate. You'll need to be extra careful on your Covert Ops. That said, if you run into anyone left alone, it'd be a shame to miss the chance to strike.
disp_detail.4010802: The abundance of supplies at Northridge has attracted quite a fair number of troublesome miscreants. However, if you can clean up the area, the resources are yours. I know, I know—easier said than done.
disp_detail.4010805: The abundance of supplies at Northridge has attracted quite a fair number of troublesome individuals. Find a way to eliminate everyone else nearby if you want to get at those resources.
disp_detail.4010117: Northridge's terrain is complex and dangerous, but a powerful weapon can help you to fend off disaster. The MDR's bullpup design allows you to fight with greater agility in tight spaces, while still offering stable mid- and long-range performance. If you're going there to search for supplies, you definitely want this with you.
disp_detail.4010841: The abundance of supplies around the open expanse of Northridge has attracted a bunch of greedy fellas. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010838: The abundance of supplies around the open expanse of Northridge has attracted quite a fair number of troublesome individuals. Occupy the supply storage point and take care of whoever shows up. Let them know who's the boss in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010814: The abundance of supplies around the open expanse of Northridge has attracted quite a fair number of troublesome individuals. If you can clear out those areas, the resources within are yours. Won't be easy, though.
disp_detail.4010817: The abundance of supplies around the open expanse of Northridge has attracted a bunch of greedy fellas. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010826: The abundance of supplies around the open expanse of Northridge has attracted quite a fair number of troublesome individuals. You'll only be able to collect the supplies when the area is clear of threats. Catch my drift?
disp_detail.4010911: Northridge is a wide-open area covered in supplies. There are some risky areas you can go if you really want to strike it rich: the Northridge Hotel, Sewage Plant, Cable Car Station, and N. and S. Villages.
disp_detail.4010709: There's a lot of open terrain up in Northridge. When you spot a hostile from far away, you may find it advantageous to engage them using a weapon with a long effective range. As long as you keep your distance and keep your target's location locked, you can really put pressure on them. That's the most effective way to fight in a place like that.
disp_detail.4010136: Northridge has been quiet for too long. It's almost as if somebody's there, plotting in the shadows. I need a few warriors to make some noise. Take your squad, gather up some shotguns with good firepower, and head to Northridge. Your operation should be quick, precise, and ruthless.
disp_detail.4010424: Northridge is a very open place, rich in supplies, especially at the Northridge Hotel, Sewage Plant, Cable Car Station, and N. and S. Villages. Those are good places to strike it rich.
disp_detail.4010935: Northridge is a very open place, rich in supplies, especially at the Northridge Hotel, Sewage Plant, Cable Car Station, and N. and S. Villages. Those are good places to strike it rich.
disp_detail.4010917: Northridge is a very open place, and is rich with supplies. There's good stuff all over, so search carefully. So long as you put the effort in, you're sure to find something good.
disp_detail.4010241: There is a lot of open terrain up in Northridge. When you spot a hostile from far away, you may find it advantageous to engage them with a long-ranged weapon. As long as you keep your distance, you can really put pressure on them.
disp_detail.4010459: N. Village in Northridge has a lot of goods and supplies, which have naturally drawn the attention of the militants nearby. If you can take out those militants, be sure to have a look around for anything useful.
disp_detail.4010956: Something strange is going on in Northridge. Take this opportunity to infiltrate it, blend in among the militants, and see what good things you can grab. But remember to move quickly. You don't want to attract any unnecessary trouble.
disp_detail.4010992: Something strange is going on in Northridge. Take this opportunity to infiltrate it, blend in among the militants, and see what good things you can grab. But remember to move quickly. You don't want to attract any unnecessary trouble.
disp_detail.4010133: The Northridge Cable Car Station used to be a nice tourist spot, but then the militants came. They did, however, stock up a pretty pile of supplies. If you and your team head in there and take them out, I'm sure what you get will be worth it.
disp_detail.4010441: The Northridge Cable Car Station used to be a nice tourist spot before the militants showed up. They did bring a bunch of supplies, though. If you head in there and take them out, I'm sure you'll find something useful.
disp_detail.4010941: The Northridge Cable Car Station used to be a nice tourist spot before the militants showed up. They did bring a bunch of supplies, though. If you head in there and take them out, I'm sure you'll find something useful.
disp_detail.4010417: Northridge is relatively rich in resources, so you'll be able to fill your backpack in no time. I suggest switching to a larger backpack, so that you can bring back more supplies with each extraction.

disp_detail.4010304: Strange things have been happening in Northridge lately. A mysterious group has been making secret plans... Go there and see if you can find any intel about it. Patrol along the route, and check everywhere.
disp_detail.1020501: Medical supplies are a rarity here. People here fight over them. There are people getting hurt every day, and my medical stations at the Farm have run out of various med kits. Deliver some for me to the second floor of the central and eastern Outposts. Make it quick!
disp_detail.1020303: Thank you so much for your help at the Port before. My people noticed that the ship waiting at the Port has left, but a group of people who obviously aren't with Doss have started appearing in the Valley. Their equipment makes it look like they come from the north. I don't know what they're doing here, but they're gathering at the Small Factory. Time's running out, I need you to head over there now and help me find out what's going on.
disp_detail.9021017: Thank you so much for your help at the Port before. My people noticed that the ship waiting at the Port has left, but a group of people who obviously aren't with Doss have started appearing in the Valley. Their equipment makes it look like they come from the north. I don't know what they're doing here, but they're gathering at the Small Factory. Time's running out, I need you to head over there now and help me find out what's going on.
disp_detail.9031310: I've figured out who's helping them. They're getting help from Westerners and your fellow operators, including many who once worked for me. But they've taken the wrong side this time. Working for those shameless and wicked Westerners never bodes well. The traces we found at N. Village have been verified to be remnants from manufacturing explosives. Considering their past, those Southerners are very likely to be targeting a member of the Guard Corps. I will absolutely not allow those lackeys of the Westerners to destroy the hard-earned balance we've finally achieved in the Dark Zone! I need you to take action immediately and deal with them!
disp_detail.4990707: Bring out loot worth over 1,500,000 in a single raid.
disp_detail.4990303: Bring out loot worth over 500,000 in a single raid.
disp_detail.4010235: While fighting alone, you'll probably want to reduce your exposure to avoid trouble. Putting a suppressor on your weapon can help you keep a low profile when firefights break out.
disp_detail.9031301: I'm sure you've heard of the North-South Conflict. Back then, they came here with the army while hoping to achieve great things, but they ended up suffering a major defeat instead. Even their army was ruined by the Second Clan, and they were eventually forced to become militants to survive. Ever since their identity as Southerners was exposed, the guard battalion has been trying its best to cause trouble for them and provoke a counterattack. Although the conflict remains under control for now, no one knows when those guys might take desperate action. I need you to deliver some emergency supplies and keep them away from conflict with the guard battalion for now.
disp_detail.9010102: After the North-South Conflict ended, someone entered and took control of the TV Station in the name of the Committee. According to the findings from your investigation, I have reason to believe that it's a team from Blackgold, but I still need more information at this stage. According to our previous agreement, the White Wolf Squad should leave clues at the TV Station. I'll need you to go back there and help me by bringing the intel out.
disp_detail.9241307: The North-South Conflict was a disaster, through and through, and it's because of the Conflict that the Dark Zone exists today. Back then, after we'd taken control of Marulos, our main force split up and marched toward Guoyapos and Onotos. We were ordered to remain behind and prepare to take out the last remaining obstacle in Marulos—the Armory. We knew it was going to be a rough fight, but we were blinded by our many victories—we had no idea the nightmare we were about to dive headfirst into. It was a cacophony of metal and flesh, a deadlock that trapped us like quicksand. In the end, it consumed us all.
disp_detail.9041404: Since crossing the ceasefire line, the Southern Army has aggressively blockaded the perimeter of the Valley. Facing this pressure, the Antonio Family wants to abandon most of their trade routes on land rather than risk a conflict. This situation runs completely counter to Tevila's interests. Tevila has no need for the Antonio Family if they're just going to cower south of the frontline! Since Doss has accepted Tevila's aid and protection, he must fulfill his obligations. Relay this order to him immediately: The Antonio Family must attack the Southern Army's supply lines soon.
disp_detail.9041115: The offensive against Marulos calmed down after the Southern Army took the Farm. I reckon they're planning something big. We expect Renoir to seek help soon. Now, I need you to investigate the Farm and verify the situation there.
disp_detail.5010504: A few members of that horde in the S. Loading Area dragged my men inside with their own hands. They were human before the outbreak, and became something else afterwards, but they still have the same faces. I don't care what they are now. Go over there and clear out the S. Loading Area.
disp_detail.1040001: Have you ever been to the south of the Valley? Right now, it's in chaos. Militants have occupied multiple key locations. I need you to visit and ascertain what's going on, then report back to me.
disp_detail.5020405: Porrero's going to make his escape through the RV Camp. Go there and stop his men.
disp_detail.9041213: Porrero isn't responding to me. Maybe he's hesitating, or he's just trying to pretend that he didn't receive it. Well, it doesn't matter. Once I detain his people and supplies, it should make him get his butt off that sofa!
disp_detail.4010708: Carbines may have a slower rate of fire than assault rifles, but they're also more accurate. Close quarters combat isn't one of their strong points, so aiming for the weak points of targets at mid-to-long range is the proper way to use them... Of course, aiming through a scope is essential.
disp_detail.4010308: Carbines may have a slower rate of fire than assault rifles, but they are more accurate. Close quarters combat is not one of their strong points. The proper way to use them is by aiming at your target's weak points from medium-to-long range.
disp_detail.4010728: Carbines have high accuracy and are good at shooting a target's weak spot from mid-range. Just keep your distance from the enemy to unleash considerable firepower. Speaking of which, I have an urgent mission for you. I need you to head out as soon as possible and create some ruckus in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010144: Carbines have high accuracy and are good at shooting a target's weak spot from mid range. Just keep your distance from the enemy to unleash considerable firepower. Speaking of, I have an urgent mission for you. I need you to get to Northridge Hotel as quickly as possible and create some ruckus outside.
disp_detail.9041114: The simple defenses set up by the Kamona Guard Corps in the south of Marulos were crushed with ease by the aerial forces of the West. I heard Renoir is about to pull in their line of defense and Ajax might retreat to the Armory. I need you to go around the areas controlled by the South and deliver these letters to Doss.
disp_detail.9041219: The Cemetery in Kamona turned me away, but I've already booked a few plots there for the Blackgold scum. Join the hunt, soldier. Let's send those bastards on their way.
disp_detail.9031314: The bigwigs in the Guard Corps were very impressed with the samples you brought back. They're ready to establish a trade relationship with Northridge—weapons for high-quality ore. But we're running into issues with logistics. The Committee's blockade of the waters around Kamona makes transport by sea impossible. Road transport is also not a viable option. The Guard Corps needs a stable route to move this ore; otherwise, this new partnership will be nearly impossible to maintain. Thankfully, my buddy in the Valley has a secret waterway he uses for business with other countries. I'm certain he'll be willing to facilitate the trade—if the price is right.
disp_detail.4010721: Even from close range, hitting a target that's sprinting at full speed isn't easy. Thankfully, you should have a pretty good idea of how to slow their legs down a bit...
disp_detail.4010906: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that the price of blue gunpowder has skyrocketed. It's pretty surprising. Hoarding that stuff can be pretty dangerous.
disp_detail.4010918: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that the price of currycombs for horses has skyrocketed. That doesn't make any sense to me. Has someone opened a ranch nearby?
disp_detail.4010446: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, but I can't even get my hands on any screws! Is it even possible to build a bomb without screws?
disp_detail.4010428: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, but there has been a shortage of rectifiers recently, and I can't fathom why. Someone must be recharging a hell of a lot of batteries!
disp_detail.4010938: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that the price of safety cords has skyrocketed. That doesn't make any sense to me. Are there really that many mountain climbers in the Dark Zone?
disp_detail.4010410: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I recently heard that the price of toothpaste has skyrocketed. That doesn't make any sense to me. Who cares about luxuries like that in a place like this?
disp_detail.4010982: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that there was a shortage of acrylic glass. That doesn't make any sense to me. Aren't they really easy to find in Covert Ops?

disp_detail.4010942: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that the price of fuses has skyrocketed. That doesn't make any sense to me. Have high-powered devices become really popular or something?
disp_detail.4010914: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, but lately, there's been a shortage of common goods, like D batteries. This is beyond me. There's no telling when there'll be a stable supply again.
disp_detail.4010464: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, but lately, there's been a shortage of common goods, such as batteries. There's no telling when they'll come back in stock.
disp_detail.4010930: I didn't think the Dark Zone had any surprises left in store for me, until I heard that the price of hydrogen peroxide has skyrocketed. That doesn't make any sense to me. When there's a shortage of medical supplies, then we're in real trouble.
disp_detail.5020428: Go to the RV Camp and bring back some containers. Don't ask why. You'll have to swallow your curiosity on this one.
disp_detail.3000331: Take part in Team Deathmatch and eliminate any enemy x10.
disp_detail.3000332: Take part in Team Deathmatch and eliminate any enemy x20.
disp_detail.3000319: Take part in Secure Ops raids and extract successfully x1.
disp_detail.3000320: Take part in Secure Ops raids and extract successfully x3.
disp_detail.3000337: Take part in Team Elimination and eliminate any enemy x10.
disp_detail.3000338: Take part in Team Elimination and eliminate any enemy x20.
disp_detail.9051201: Another round of noise and commotion finally came to a messy end. We must do better for the sake of the people's peace and freedom. But I still haven't received a detailed plan. Head to the Abandoned Shack and get me the latest recon report.
disp_detail.1010803: Only by bringing better equipment will you be able to easily handle those enemies. But this kind of gear doesn't come for free, you'll have to pay for it with real Koen. In the Dark Zone, you can exchange things for Koen everywhere, but most of the stuff is pretty ordinary. For things of real value, you'll need to find safes. There's one at the Trading Post, for example.
disp_detail.4011618: Getting an armful of loot in the Dark Zone is useless if you can't extract with the stuff. Remember, greedy eaters dig their graves with their teeth. The most important thing is to extract at the right moment.
disp_detail.4011632: Getting an armful of loot in the Dark Zone is useless if you can't extract with the stuff. Remember, greedy eaters dig their graves with their teeth. The most important thing is to extract at the right moment.
disp_detail.4010473: As long as your equipment's up-to-snuff and you've got enough supplies, you can go toe-to-toe with your opponents without needing to constantly duck and cover—even on your own. When you're ready, head over to the Farm and show those militants who's the boss.

disp_detail.9031205: Bit out of the blue—Vladlen just put in an order with me, destined for Renoir. I need you to run the contract over so they can prep for delivery. And yes, you're right—I helped mediate the deal. For an honest and dependable merchant like me, chaos in the Dark Zone is bad for business.
disp_detail.1010204: Your top priority should be food, because you can't work on an empty stomach. The Convenience Store by the Grain Trade Center should still have some supplies. Also, bring more provisions from the Farm. The more food you have, the less nervous you'll be. After all, we're no strangers to shortages here...
disp_detail.4010476: A true sniper can eliminate their opponent with a single shot, but few pass the test in real combat. If you want to hone your sniper skills, head on over to the Farm and practice on those militants.
disp_detail.4010482: Qualified snipers are trained to land a hit and kill their opponents with just one shot, but few can do it in actual combat. Go to the Farm and hone your sniper skills on those Militants.

disp_detail.3041410: Listen to me, a batch of very interesting games has entered the Dark Zone recently. I really want to play them. I know you have connections. Please get me a few.
disp_detail.1019091: Look, recruit, everyone has to prove themselves in the Dark Zone. Here, I've got a commission. It's not too difficult—just eliminate two militants, and deliver some weapons as proof. I think it'll be good practice for you. Are you up for it?
disp_detail.4060201: Listen up. This isn't going to be an easy task, which is why I think you're the only one who can handle it. Go to the Farm and deal with some of the enemies there. That's the easy part. The more difficult bit is that I need you to do is use regulation equipment while you're doing it. That should leave a lasting impression on them. And don't worry, I think you'll be quite pleased with your compensation.

disp_detail.5020401: I've heard that Porrero's going to move a case of gold bars through the Port. Go there and have a look around.
disp_detail.5010509: I heard many researchers fled to the Wheatfield Farmhouse after the outbreak began. You should go examine it closely. Once you've finished, the Farmhouse extraction point will activate.
disp_detail.9281201: I heard some outsiders recently arrived at the Farm, and they brought along some strange stuff that makes them go absolutely insane. Could you investigate them for me? It's already crazy enough over here.
disp_detail.9041203: I hear Deke Vinson is looking for me. The information is hidden somewhere on the Farm. I need you to investigate and report back to me.
disp_detail.4010227: It isn't easy hitting a target that's sprinting at full speed, but there are ways to slow your target down. You get the idea.
disp_detail.9271210: Time spent with a legend always flies by. Yup, I'm talking about you, my friend. Though you're still alive, a name that will never visit the Afterlife again has definitely earned its place on the menu. The device is getting weaker. I've got to go! Once I'm gone, I hope you'll make sure the last "door" is closed as well.
disp_detail.9061102: Ahem, this is Randall. Anyway, I've more or less figured out those people we were investigating. My people tell me that they're searching vehicles and tents. They're not giving up easy. My men are all running missions at the moment, so you'll have to go down there and erase some traces for me. Don't ask why—just do what I say and you'll get paid.
disp_detail.1060206: Ahem, this is Randall. Anyway, I've more or less figured out those people we were investigating. My people tell me that they're searching vehicles and tents. They're not giving up easy. My men are all running missions at the moment, so you'll have to go down there and erase some traces for me. Don't ask why—just do what I say and you'll get paid.
disp_detail.1060207: Ahem, this is Randall. I had no idea they were still holding on to what happened at Northridge Hotel... It was my worst mission to date. There are many things that I don't want them to know. Go to the second floor of the Communication Station and destroy a few things for me. Remember, don't leave any witnesses.
disp_detail.9061103: Ahem, this is Randall. I had no idea they were still holding on to what happened at Northridge Hotel... It was my worst mission to date, and I nearly died there! Nonetheless, there are many things that I don't want them to know. Go to the second floor of the Communication Station and destroy a few things, and also everyone there, for me. Don't leave any witnesses.
disp_detail.1050002: Hey, buddy. The information you brought back last time was very useful. I completely understand the water source problems at Northridge now. This used to be a hot spot for tourists, so they built a Sewage Plant for the Hotel and the Village. Both the Dam and Water Tower are critical infrastructure for the area, so please head down there and see if they're still in good condition. I'd like to help the locals out, if possible. Bring them a little peace.
disp_detail.1030701: Mate, long story short, I have a job here. The pay's good, but it's urgent. I'm relying on you to get this done. It's like this: Someone wants to cause a commotion at the Northridge Hotel, and this is gonna be started at the Cable Car Station. Therefore, your mission is to get the Guard Change Schedule for the Cable Car Station. As long as you've got that, they can easily handle things on their end, but time's running out, you've gotta get going now.
disp_detail.5020421: Hey, your coordinates have been exposed. Get out of there, fast!
disp_detail.9431601: Hi, Expert. Let me formally introduce myself—I'm White Rose. My squad and I really need an experienced hand like you to help us out. The rules here are simple: I pay, you work. The price is clear, and the compensation is more than enough.
disp_detail.1020201: I need your help again, soldier. You know about the Recycling Station at one of the intersections at the Farm, right? I left a premium surgical kit at the office there, can you please get it for me? The door to the office is usually locked, but you can look for the key at the Outpost. Thanks!
disp_detail.1040402: Hey, how are you doing? Damn, you can down five canned stews in one sitting? You must spend a fortune on food. Anyway, one of my partners needs gunpowder. Think you can get some for me? I think you can find them in the basement of the Farm Motel.
disp_detail.9031001: Hey, how are you doing? Damn, you can down five canned stews in one sitting? You must spend a fortune on food. Anyway, one of my partners needs gunpowder. Think you can get some for me? I think you can find them in the basement of the Farm Motel.
disp_detail.1060205: It's Randall. I ran into some trouble in Northridge earlier. Everything's more or less been taken care of, but I can't let this slide. Go to Northridge and eliminate anyone still causing trouble. If they like this place so much, let's make sure they never leave.
disp_detail.9061105: It's Randall. I ran into some trouble in Northridge earlier. Everything's more or less been taken care of, but I can't let this slide. Go to Northridge and get rid of any operators who are still causing trouble. Since they like this place so much, let's make sure they never leave.
disp_detail.1060301: Yeah, it's Randall. I got something for you. I need you to infiltrate the Valley, inspect the vehicles in the Garage, and extract. You'll be assuming a false identity, so don't draw attention to yourself. I can't help you if your cover is blown.
disp_detail.9061003: Yeah, it's Randall. I got something for you. I need you to infiltrate the Valley, inspect the vehicles in the Garage, and extract. You'll be assuming a false identity, so don't draw attention to yourself. I can't help you if your cover is blown.
disp_detail.9051403: Hey, friend. There's a message from Abyss—Hecate is thinking of you again. Something's happened in Northridge: Lately, the Forest Man has been constantly harassing Abyss's operations. Taking advantage of their familiarity with the terrain, they've managed to slip through our nets before we can close in, time and time again. Abyss is in desperate need of a guide who knows Northridge just as well and is an outstanding fighter, to help track down the Forest Man's squad. You're Hecate's first choice, my friend. Don't let her down.
disp_detail.1050001: Hey there, you know Northridge? It used to be a pretty scenic place, but now it's been taken over by militants. I've got a partner who wants to see if he can make the place usable again. Could you scout the Bus Terminal, the Village, and the Testing Station?
disp_detail.1060302: Hey, listen up. I've got a buddy on a mission in the Valley. He needs to get out of there, but he's stuck in the Villa right now. It's urgent, so go there now and cause some chaos so he can escape.
disp_detail.9061004: Hey, listen up. I've got a buddy on a mission in the Valley. He needs to get out of there, but he's stuck in the Villa right now. It's urgent, so go there now and cause some chaos so he can escape.
disp_detail.9401501: Hey, friend! We meet again! You guys really sold it last time, posing as a breakout squad—I almost called in fire support! Seriously, what if I had a word with the Warrant Officer and got you posted here too? Nah, forget it. I know you like your freedom... *Ahem*, let's get down to business. I'm planning to retake the strongholds one by one from the perimeter and drive those raincoat-wearing bastards back! I need you to watch my six—and make sure no other operators interfere with my plan.
disp_detail.9401601: Hey, pal! I've got a job for you. Remember that cargo I stashed in Marulos? Well, it's time to move it northward. That whole area is Guard Corps territory, as you know. Sure, we're partnered with them, but at the end of the day, we're still outsiders. All that is to say: this cargo isn't for their eyes to see. I need you to slip into the Armory and activate a set of coordinate locators—without being detected.
disp_detail.9021013: Hey, operator. Remember when I asked you before to help me get to the Valley to support my team there? Well, they found out some news when they were rescuing locals at the Floranpino aid station. A local told them that a car with the Sumek Committee logo was seen in the Valley not long ago. I worked out the dates and it happened to be around the time of the Northridge Hotel attack. My sixth sense is telling me that my father has been taken to the Valley. I might not know much about the factions in the Dark Zone, but I do know that Doss runs the Valley. No matter whether Doss did it or not, I don't think he'd have the gall to be holding someone at his Villa. People are trying to find these people, after all. There aren't many places left where they could be hidden. Doss' Small Factory has a complicated layout and is heavily guarded, so it would be a good place to hide someone. Could you help me clear the surrounding area before my people go in and have a look? I hope we can find my father this time.
disp_detail.9421501: Hey, operator. You know exactly what I need from you. Toland's squad is still tracking Kurt and his team, and Revan's successor is proving tougher than we expected. The situation is clear: if we don't interfere, they’ll soon pinpoint Kurt's route. I need you to go to Marulos immediately. Create a "smokescreen" to lure Team Annihilation into dedicating more manpower to investigate the area.

disp_detail.4010176: Most of the operators that are active near the Armory are battle-hardened fighters. Make sure to deal with them quickly, and don't drag your feet! Oh, and don't forget to call your teammates to help. Don't get yourself killed for nothing by going in there alone.
disp_detail.4010745: When fighting indoors in Northridge, you won't always have time to carefully aim before shooting. In the heat of battle, a weapon equipped with a laser sight will hit an enemy's weak spot easier. Of course, you have to be careful as well. Don't let it reveal your location.
disp_detail.4010135: More and more people are searching for supplies in Northridge, meaning there are even more chances to get rich. A Covert Op will allow you to more easily enter dangerous places, locate important supplies, and bring back as many as possible.
disp_detail.4010129: There's been a sudden increase in people searching for supplies in Northridge. When you and your squad take action there, you'll need to be extra careful. Better to take out the enemy from afar. Avoid close conflict where possible.
disp_detail.4010138: When fighting in Northridge Hotel, you won't be able to avoid engaging with the enemy at close range, and dropping your guard for even a moment can spell the difference between victory and defeat. It's too dangerous to fight alone, so promise you'll call your squad to go with you.

disp_detail.9341403: During the North-South Conflict, Guoyapos Airport was used as a temporary frontline command center by both sides. Though it's now abandoned, many signs of its former use by militaries remain. We've contacted a local connection of ours there, who will clear a safe path for you around the perimeter of the Fuel Storage on the Airport's northern side. Once you're in, your first objective is to set up a forward operating base around the Fuel Storage. From there, you will perform a preliminary sweep of the Airport's northern area.
disp_detail.4010916: There's no time to search slowly in a place as dangerous as the Dark Zone. The best and safest way is to just eliminate the hostile targets nearby, then collect the supplies and extract. Time waits for no one, so you need to be fast to get out safely.
disp_detail.3041416: After building relationships with the guys in the Hotel, I've been allowed to stay. But some necessities are missing here. Can you send me some toilet paper?

disp_detail.4010403: Thank your lucky stars that you've been able to survive in the Dark Zone for this long, because basic household necessities are hard to come by. Some people pay top dollar for these items. If you happen to have some extra, consider this offer.
disp_detail.4011003: Thank your lucky stars that you've been able to survive in the Dark Zone for this long, because basic household necessities are hard to come by. Some people pay top dollar for these items. If you happen to have some extra, consider this offer.
disp_detail.4010466: It's not easy maintaining the infrastructure required to train new recruits in the Dark Zone. There is stuff that needs repairing all over the place. In Covert Ops, remember to look for building materials. If you find any, bring them back with you.
disp_detail.4010402: It's not easy maintaining the infrastructure required to train new recruits in the Dark Zone, because there's stuff that needs repair all over the place. If you find any building materials, remember to bring them back with you. When supplies are short, even if you've got the cash, you won't be able to find any.
disp_detail.4010223: When you're in the Dark Zone, you'll inevitably clash with other operators. Work with your teammates to take them down. Make sure they know better than to mess with you.
disp_detail.4010247: When you're in the Dark Zone, you'll inevitably clash with other operators. Work with your teammates to take them down. Make sure they know better than to mess with you.
disp_detail.4011617: In the Dark Zone, you can get whatever your heart desires on the battlefield. It's time to prove yourself, so pick up that weapon and move!
disp_detail.4011631: In the Dark Zone, you can get whatever your heart desires on the battlefield. It's time to prove yourself, so pick up that weapon and move!
disp_detail.1010802: In the Dark Zone, good equipment can make all the difference. You do know that, right? It just so happens that I have a mission here. The client wants some militants at the Farm to be dealt with. And I want you to bring back one of their helmets. I believe that only by seeing something seriously damaged in battle with your own eyes will you understand its importance.
disp_detail.2990109: Complete a raid in Extraction Mode at the Airport.
disp_detail.1020103: It's your job to find stuff of value in the midst of battle. You can only get rich if you're flexible and know where you might find valuable items that no one has noticed. I hope you're not pinning your hopes on some nails or paper towels!
disp_detail.2990108: Complete a raid in extraction mode at the TV Station.
disp_detail.9041220: I finally saw their true colors in the Mine, but the Abyss intercepted us. We almost succeeded! Trust me, I will make them pay for this, and the work starts from Northridge. Hence, go to Northridge to control the situation and prevent the Abyss from expanding its range of control there.
disp_detail.4990701: Complete a raid in any mode while in a team.
disp_detail.4990902: Complete a raid in any mode while in a team.
disp_detail.4010306: When you suddenly encounter an opponent at close range, you won't have time to raise your gun and aim. When this happens, you'll be in good shape if you have a laser sight equipped. With it, you can shoot from the hip more accurately.
disp_detail.4010707: When you come up against an opponent at close range, you won't have the time to carefully aim through your scope, so spraying them with a submachine gun is the right way to go. If you equip a suppressor, you can also avoid letting nearby enemies know your location.
disp_detail.3041413: What a genius I am, coming to Northridge at a time like this. Please bring me a rain tarp. I need to get my living arrangements sorted.
disp_detail.9411521: Disrupting our showdown at a time like this... Renoir, as shortsighted as ever. No wonder he was played by the Westerners back then. "Rose" has already punched a hole through the southern line for us. Go coordinate a synchronized assault with the captain. The Crows will rendezvous with you at the right moment.
disp_detail.9241314: Bad news. We just got word the Guard Corps is shoring up their defenses. Time is now our number one enemy—the higher-ups are telling me we have to move out sooner than we've planned. They've also given me a deadline to finish this up. Listen, everyone: we've taken their supplies, yes. But you only get one life—your first responsibility is to yourself. So, if any of you want to back out, now's your chance. If you're choosing to stay, get ready to execute our combat plan... Friend, I need you to come back once you finish delivering the supplies. I'll be waiting for you in the Valley.
disp_detail.9341604: You can stop following the coordinate locator for now. Maxim will take over on that. Instead, I need you to head to the Airport immediately and await orders. Not long ago, Officer Vladlen's ground transport plan was rejected by high command as "unreliable", so now, my air transport plan is competing with a sea transport option. To be honest, I agree with Vladlen—ground transport is the safest bet for this op. High command's reasoning was vague but insistent, so I smell a plot. Our top priority for now is to shore up the Airport's defenses and ensure the airlift goes off without a hitch.
disp_detail.9231212: You may have heard about the crash site. Now, we need to travel to the Armory again and make sure it's safe. It's important for both of us. Of course, it might be a chance for you to see if those hazards are crying with regret for their mistakes.
disp_detail.1020304: Soldier, my informant up north just brought me some new intel. That gang have struck a deal with Doss and Renoir, and my father seems to have been used as a bargaining chip. Now, it looks like he's being transferred to the Farm, where he'll get picked up by the northerners. Ajax controls the Farm and it's tricky for my people to get close. I want you to go to the Farm and find out where my father is.
disp_detail.9021018: Soldier, my informant up north just brought me some new intel. That gang have struck a deal with Doss and Renoir, and my father seems to have been used as a bargaining chip. Now, it looks like he's being transferred to the Farm, where he'll get picked up by the northerners. Ajax controls the Farm and it's tricky for my people to get close. I want you to go to the Farm and find out where my father is.
disp_detail.9021020: Soldier, we finally located my father, but we just missed him: He's already been moved from the Farm to Tevila. I had a brief moment of hope but now it's all gone. I guess that's where we should leave things—it's time for me to leave this horrible place. But before I do, I want to say a quick goodbye, if that's alright with you. I'll be waiting for you at the Farm's cemetery. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, soldier.
disp_detail.9021019: Soldier, my people are at the Farm trying to get my father back. However, his location is being heavily guarded. My team has launched several sorties, but they've all failed. My dad is right in front of me! I can't let him slip away from me again. I want you to come to the Farm and create some chaos that my team can take advantage of. I'm desperate to be reunited with my father, so I'm hoping I can count on your help again.
disp_detail.1020305: Soldier, my people are at the Farm trying to get my father back. However, his location is being heavily guarded by Ajax's guys. My team has launched several sorties, but they've all failed. My dad is right in front of me! I can't let him slip away from me again. I want you to come to the Farm and create some chaos that my team can take advantage of. I'm desperate to be reunited with my father, so I'm hoping I can count on your help again.
disp_detail.1020306: Soldier, I understand that my father is now in your hands and you intend to hand him over. I'm disappointed but I can't blame you; this is the Dark Zone and everyone has to protect their interests. It's just that, you know that I came to Kamona to find my missing father. I once had some hope because of you, but now all I have is despair. No matter how this all ends, I still want to see my dad one last time. If you'll agree, I will wait for you in the Cemetery at the Farm. You have my heartfelt thanks, dear soldier.
disp_detail.9041604: Soldier, the clues you found have paid off. We've tracked those squads to Northridge. After pulling out of the Valley, they headed straight there. I need you to go to Northridge and continue the investigation to figure out what Team Annihilation is after. Also, if you get the chance, grab a few alive. They're worth more alive; we can make them talk. You know how this works, so I won't say any more.
disp_detail.1040602: Soldier, the intel you brought back has been very valuable. A team from Blackgold suddenly attacked the TV Station and blew up the entrance. Currently, it's unclear what's going on inside, and I've not received an order to get support. Reckless action can escalate fighting, so all I can do is continue to observe. My informant will keep an eye on the situation to see which way things are going, but I need you to take two signal receivers to the Port and place one in the Post Office and the other on the second floor of the Construction Site. Things are bubbling under the surface at the Port, so don't go getting into any fights. Remember, your mission is deliver the signal receivers.
disp_detail.1040107: Soldier, you're pretty familiar with the Farm, right? I heard that the westerners have been visiting it frequently. Not much has happened since the explosion, but I think the disappearance of the Gungnir generator has some relation to them. Go create a distraction at the destroyed convoy, then investigate each of the Farm's intersections. I want to know where the generator went!
disp_detail.9041601: Soldier, I need you to make another trip. Head to the Valley and protect Doss. Team Annihilation has had their eyes on him lately, and the White Wolves guarding him have been taking casualties. I sent another squad of White Wolves as backup, but their convoy was ambushed en route. We're still not sure if Team Annihilation's real target is the White Wolves or Doss, but either way, we can't let the Dark Zone fall into chaos. Stick to Doss and keep him safe. While you're at it, keep an eye on Team Annihilation and see what they're plotting.
disp_detail.9041412: Soldier, a mission where you can make a name for yourself is here. Assemble your squad immediately, head to the designated area outside the TV Station, and await orders! We're taking back the Airport for good! Edelweiss will lead the Flag Squad and attack the Airport with you. I'll be at the Command Center providing intel and support during the entire operation.
disp_detail.5020317: I need to reassess the impact of the previous battle. Take a look around the battlefield and determine if any new fortifications are needed.
disp_detail.5020323: I need to reassess the impact of the previous battle. Take a look around the battlefield and determine if any new fortifications are needed.
disp_detail.5020329: I need to reassess the impact of the previous battle. Take a look around the battlefield and determine if any new fortifications are needed.
disp_detail.9041405: Urgent mission, soldier—you need to move out now. One of the Forest Man's squads has fallen into Viper's hands, and an intel leak is inevitable. Fortunately, most squads have already changed their hideouts and contact code words, but there's one team we couldn't notify in time. The Forest Man has requested our help in getting this squad out of danger. I've assessed the risk of an armed rescue, and it's far too high. So we'll handle this the "Tevila way." Your mission: Get to the squad's hideout immediately and deal with things before Viper finds them.
disp_detail.1040601: Soldier, are you familiar with Guoyapos? The Kamona TV Station there was an important stronghold during the conflict and my people fought bravely there. Later on, someone turned their back on us, and that area was declared a buffer zone, so we were forced to extract. Now, a gang of rebel navy folk has occupied the Port, and I'm hearing that people from the Committee are also up to no good at the TV Station. A while ago, we sent some people over to try and figure out what was going on, and they ended up fighting with an unknown gang... We still can't get in touch with them. My informant is having trouble too. In short, things aren't going well. I need you to go to Vincent's Variety Store at the Port and bring back intel from my informant. Watch out for those rebel navy folk, though, no one knows which side they're on anymore.
disp_detail.9041401: You've probably heard about the incident at the TV Station, soldier. An unidentified squad is disrupting the balance of the Dark Zone. Like an undercurrent, they're stirring up trouble and clouding everyone's judgment. We sent a team to investigate, but they came back empty-handed and we lost a few good people. My superiors have denied my request to pursue this further and have given me new orders. Now, I need you to go to the Farm, observe the Southern Army, and report back on their current situation.
disp_detail.1990002: Outsider, I've got an errand for you. You know I have a lot of business over in the Valley. Deke helps me out with a lot of it, but he's been busy with other things recently, and I don't want to bother him with such a trivial matter. There are two beautiful beaches in the Valley, one called Palm Cove and the other called Lagora Beach. Two of my packages were left there. Your mission is simple, just change into local clothes and quietly collect the packages.
disp_detail.1990001: Outsider, this may be your first time helping me, but don't be nervous. You'll have noticed that I no longer trade supplies here. My business has grown and I don't have the time for such small transactions. But I still maintain relationships with some of my old customers. An old friend at the Farm needs a batch of goods. My people will drop them at the Farm. I just need you to help deliver the goods to the Radio Station. It's a simple mission, but it has to be completed on time or the goods won't be fresh.
disp_detail.1030602: Thanks to your previous investigation into the TV Station, my people were able to get in without a hitch. According to my local informant, there was fierce fighting raging inside and the Central Control Area was full of Blackgold guys. He didn't dare get deep inside, so he just observed from the corridor, and then quickly got the hell out of there. Hehe, so I still have to come back to you in the end. I'm still totally in the dark about that second floor of the TV Station, and I need to know more about that area. This mission is dangerous, so you need to be fully prepared. We're gonna have some big business for you going forward, so I don't want you to stumble here.
disp_detail.9031317: The puppet government Tevila installed eventually gained legitimacy. Colom instigated a rebellion in the South. Manipulated by foreign influences, the North and South went head to head, spreading meaningless, endless conflict across Kamona. You know, I actually studied in Colom in my younger years. Threw myself into studying business and law. Once I realized how Kamona had been badly treated, I decided I would work on saving Kamona from within. Then, the North-South Conflict came and shattered the fantasy world I'd been living in. Politics won't save Kamona. I returned home during the Conflict and worked on building resources until the Dark Zone was formed. I will unite the Dark Zone one day, and use it as a springboard to cover the north and south as well. I will bring Kamona back to the Kamonans.
disp_detail.5020302: Doss's belongings are critical to the mission. Don't let anyone get away with them!
disp_detail.5120403: Doss's location has been exposed. Get rid of him before he extracts.
disp_detail.9051407: Doss—what a pain he is. His betrayal in the past completely messed up our plans in the South, letting the Northern Front take advantage of the situation. We had no choice but to prop up a joke of a leader to fight them, and, well, you can see the results for yourself. Not long ago, the Antonio Family attacked the Southern Army's supply lines, and while there were no real casualties, it seriously impacted transport efficiency. The Northern Front must be behind this. Doss probably doesn't want to have direct conflict with the Southern Army. I need you to go to the Valley, friend, and stir up some well-timed trouble—give him a reason to pull back.
disp_detail.3000518: A series of recordings, each abruptly cutting off mid-sentence. It's as if some mysterious force was preventing the reporter from recording his scoop, and he can be heard cursing loudly.
disp_detail.3000529: A series of recordings, each abruptly cutting off mid-sentence. It's as if some mysterious force was preventing the reporter from recording his scoop, and he can be heard cursing loudly.
disp_detail.4010713: Most marksman rifles have a fairly high accuracy and decent range. Close quarters combat isn't one of their strong points, so aiming for the target's weak point from a mid-to-long range is the proper way to use them.
disp_detail.4010404: Fighting militants and operators day after day will use up your weapons real quick. If you're short on them, consider poking around Northridge. There are lots of weapon containers there.
disp_detail.9411519: The alpha is on the move. She's joined forces with the Guard Corps, and we're now facing a pincer attack from both the Wolves and the Guard Corps. We're outnumbered. The Crows can no longer operate as a single unit. I'll personally lead a main squad to draw their fire. You can either follow me and fight head-on, or extract separately with the other squads.
disp_detail.9411520: The alpha's position has been locked. Her escort force is too small to withstand a decisive strike. I know full well this is likely a trap. Revan would have waited. But I'm not him. I choose to face it head-on. This is the continuation of that unfinished showdown. And Raven... will reap it all in the end.
disp_detail.4010408: Equipment such as helmets can save your life. When you're up against an enemy with superior marksmanship, having a helmet can give you some peace of mind—no pun intended. Pick up some helmets while you're in the Valley, just in case.
disp_detail.9011502: The strange rumors haven't stopped; in fact, they're multiplying. I've even received a formal commission for a local investigation. It looks like a deeper look is necessary. I need you to go to the Valley and conduct a thorough field investigation to verify whether these rumors are true.
disp_detail.3000506: A woman receives an old photograph of her husband, who has been missing for months. The postcard's sender explains that he suffers from amnesia and, having only this photograph as a clue, sent the postcard to the address shown.
disp_detail.3000509: The woman receives the rose he sent and reminisces about their past together. After consulting a friend, she confirms his location is near the Eastern Farm and plans to go find him in the coming days.
disp_detail.1020901: Long time no see! It's me, Evita. How have you been? Thanks to you, the hospital has been getting supplies again. Anyway, there's a patient who keeps pleading with us to look for his missing father in the N. Woods at the Farm. He will give you the key to the Stable Warehouse as a reward. Hold on, let me finish. His father is most likely dead, having gone missing in THAT area, so just bring back something that proves his identity. You can keep the rest. This patient has really been through a lot. Will you help?
disp_detail.1040501: Long time no see, operator. A batch of equipment was sent out a few days ago, and it will arrive at the Valley Port soon. You know the Valley pretty well. Go scout a few places that would work for my people to retrieve the equipment later. This kind of mission should be a piece of cake for you. No problem, right?
disp_detail.1040702: Long time no see, operator. A batch of equipment was sent out a few days ago, and it will arrive at Guoyapos soon. You know the Dark Zone pretty well, so I need you to scout out the routes that would work for my people to retrieve the equipment later. This kind of mission should be a piece of cake for you. No problem, right?
disp_detail.9041101: Long time no see, operator. A batch of equipment was sent out a few days ago, and it will arrive at the Valley Port soon. You know the Valley pretty well. Go scout a few places that would work for my people to retrieve the equipment later. This kind of mission should be a piece of cake for you. No problem, right?
disp_detail.9031201: It's been a while since I've chatted with you over tea. I've been facing a lot of trouble recently. The plane incident has come to an end. However, some insensible Blackgold informants are still hanging around, and this has affected my business there. Send them away for me, and maybe Porrero will be grateful to you too.
disp_detail.9401503: Good news! Renoir just sent word—they intercepted some comms chatter at the Armory. An unknown squad calling themselves "Team Annihilation" is active there. This is a rare opportunity! I'm organizing two squads: you'll take one to the Armory to do some recon, and I'll lead the other to the Farm to investigate. We'll advance on two fronts and find out exactly what they're up to!
disp_detail.4010246: A good helmet can provide effective protection for your noggin in battle. It may impact your vision somewhat, but that's small potatoes compared to saving your life.
disp_detail.4010226: A good helmet can provide effective protection for your noggin in battle. It may impact your vision somewhat, but that's small potatoes compared to saving your life.
disp_detail.4010815: A good helmet can save your life in a pinch, but anything that can stop a bullet greatly increases your chance of successfully extracting. I happen to know a pretty good model you might want to check out.
disp_detail.4010842: A good helmet can save your life in a pinch, but anything that can stop a bullet greatly increases your chance of successfully extracting. I happen to know a pretty good model you might want to check out.
disp_detail.4010715: Good body armor will ensure your safety, especially if you don't have enough firepower. Speaking of which, I just had a brilliant idea! When you're wearing body armor, you can even face an opponent with a superior weapon. Try it!
disp_detail.1030502: We're in luck! My friends were quite pleased with your work and are eager to give you more. The Valley hasn't been safe since they returned to Floranpino, and they need to pacify it. There are two outposts crucial to the task—the RV Camp and the Supply Camp. If you can scout the locations and report back, it'll help them plan their next move.
disp_detail.9031003: We're in luck! My friends were quite pleased with your work and are eager to give you more. If you can scout the locations and report back, it'll help them plan their next move.
disp_detail.4020101: The hospital's on the verge of shutting down. Their supplies can't keep up with the demand, and the number of injured coming in grows every day. I need you to help me look for some common medical supplies. I'll make it worth your while. Please!

disp_detail.9020103: The fighting in the TV Station has descended into a head-to-head confrontation now. The White Wolf Squad have securely occupied the second floor, and having analyzed the information you brought back for me, it's not surprising that the area the White Wolves are guarding is the topic of this intel. Fortunately, their formation isn't particularly tight, so we will be able to suppress them. But once they've found what they're looking for, things are gonna get tough. Your next mission is to tell Kurt to turn off the signal jammer, and then find out what's going on on the second floor. I need comms restored and for you to act quickly and get this mission done.
disp_detail.9411514: Just as I predicted, the Wolves have left their den. The alpha plans to reinforce the Airport, completely blind to her predicament. With the TV Station now lightly defended, this is the perfect opportunity for you to infiltrate. Go activate the locators we planted earlier and deploy more comms interception devices.
disp_detail.4010326: If your weapon has longer range than your opponent's, make sure to use that range to your advantage. Maintain a distance between you and your opponent, so that their weapons cannot be a threat to you.
disp_detail.4010132: If you're familiar with Northridge, then you should know where other operators usually appear. Launching a surprise attack will usually get good results, but that'll mean working well with your squad.
disp_detail.4010120: If you're familiar with Northridge, then you should know where other operators usually appear. Launching a surprise attack will usually get results, but that requires good teamwork with your squad.
disp_detail.4010210: If you spot your enemy before they spot you, make sure to hit them where it hurts the most. By doing so, you can eliminate them with just one shot. A good scope will help your aim, so make sure to equip one.
disp_detail.9411602: You chose to stay, just as Raven predicted. Truly a soldier after my own heart. We've got a new mission. Target: the Armory. A convoy escorted by the White Wolves is set to arrive at the Armory in three days to deliver combat supplies to the Guard Corps. We need to ambush the convoy, create chaos, and degrade the White Wolves' intel capabilities.
disp_detail.9011402: There's been a follow-up to the commission: This time, you need to infiltrate the TV Station and plant hidden cameras. Our client suspects that Team Annihilation members may appear disguised as people from Blackgold or the White Wolves during the operation. If you encounter them, no need to make a report—eliminate them on sight.
disp_detail.9031315: The Antonio Family is happy with the samples. As long as we can nail down a good handling fee, they'll be glad to facilitate the trades. A pretty successful endeavor, all in all—everybody's happy, and we've got three of the biggest factions in the Dark Zone working together. I can't take all the credit, though. You were a huge part of making this happen. More than that, you've affirmed my belief that the Dark Zone might just come together one day. This place is a source of both great pain and unending hope for Kamona—here, Kamonans finally have a chance to decide their own destiny. I'll do my part to keep a handle on everything. Kamonans must stand together once more! For now, could you let the factions know the good news?

disp_detail.9011403: The client sent a message: A few hours ago, the Flag Squad and a sizable contingent of White Wolves left the TV Station. It's lightly defended right now. He wants you to take this opportunity to infiltrate the core area of the TV Station and carry out two tasks: conduct a deep investigation, and hide a prepared classified file somewhere in a corner of the Vault.
disp_detail.9011404: The client has been very satisfied with your past operations. He said he had no doubt you would succeed, as you're an expert in this business—skilled, experienced, and efficient. It sounds like he not only knows you well, but has me figured out, too. Interesting... There are only a handful of people who know us both so intimately but aren't in the Dark Zone themselves.
disp_detail.1030301: Oh by the way, that gunpowder you got me sold as soon as it hit the shelves. I've sent it to the Valley, and it's selling like hotcakes in Kamona now. Could you run down there to do inventory before the sale? If the quantity is correct, I can notify the client to come pick it up, and they'll take care of the rest.
disp_detail.9031002: Oh by the way, that gunpowder you got me sold as soon as it hit the shelves. I've sent it to the Valley, and it's selling like hotcakes in Kamona now. disp_detail.4010248: Assault rifles are the most effective weapons to use against bosses in the Dark Zone, as they perform well in many different environments. Even when you're using the right weapon, however, it is critical to work with teammates. It is too dangerous to go it alone.
disp_detail.9341415: The enemy commander panicked and triggered the alarm in the Control Tower's core area by mistake, throwing the defending Blackgold squad into chaos. Maxim seized the opportunity, leading a disguised squad to infiltrate the Control Tower amidst the confusion. He will carry out sabotage from the inside and disable the lockdown system in the core area. Once he succeeds, the central elevator in the Control Tower will be activated—that's our signal for a full-scale assault. All we have to do now is finish our preparations on the perimeter and await the final showdown.
disp_detail.4010155: Compared with the twisted inside, the outside of the Armory is nice and spacious and good for sniper battles at mid- to long-range. When fighting here with your teammates, make sure to prepare weapons with very good range and try to eliminate your enemies with one hit.
disp_detail.9281206: The research on those things has uncovered a lot of information. It seems they first appeared in the Valley. I need you to verify this information for me.
disp_detail.9041207: The missile strike should never have happened, and someone should never have left the North all those years ago. Everything we're facing now is the result of choices made in the past. Deliver this letter to the Armory. I want to give that person some advice before my patience runs out.
disp_detail.4010114: The Lockdown Zone is no place for rookies. If you want to go there, you'll need to be fully prepared. Good armor is essential. Always make sure of your own safety before thinking about other people.
disp_detail.4010126: The Lockdown Zone is extremely dangerous, but a strong weapon will always help you out in a pinch. I'm sure you're used to handling an Mk14 by now. It's got a fair number of improvements over the old M14—perfect for a complex and changing battlefield like the Valley.
disp_detail.4010945: There are a lot of storage cases in the Lockdown Zone that are filled with supplies. You can find some valuable things inside sometimes. If you don't know where they are, check the map. I've marked them there.
disp_detail.9241320: The boat is busted. Well, that's it for our last hope. Friend... All I ever wanted was a better life. Is that so wrong? In the beginning, all we had to do was deliver a message, investigate a location—never anything too dangerous. And with the resources we got, we were able to create more comfortable lives for ourselves. But I guess the jobs we did lit a fire in my brothers' hearts. Some of them got it into their heads that we should get back at the Guard Corps for what they did to us back then, even if it came at the cost of their own lives. Somehow, I was pushed front and center as the leader. Seems like amid all the praise and respect they showered me with, I forgot what a coward I truly am. My hubris, my delusions of grandeur... that's what led us here.
