disp_detail.9041402: Frankly, the guard battalion's defenses in southern Marulos are quite strong. They should be more than strong enough to repel an attack from the Southern Army. Your next mission is to continue infiltrating south into the Floranpino area. You're to scout and report on the Southern Army troops along the path to Marulos. If you're exposed, retreat immediately to our safehouse in the Valley. It's stocked with enough emergency supplies for you to survive in the short term.
disp_detail.9281209: What happened with the scientists is happening again! The key information on the "door" has been transferred away. Luckily, I found a new clue. Help me find out if it's those guys who took the scientists.
disp_detail.5030309: Someone had the audacity to pillage our supplies at the Dam. Help me take them out, my friend. They're being supported by the people at the Sewage Plant, so you'll need to get there before they do.
disp_detail.1020711: You couldn't find anything? I thought for sure that Sumek would have left some records behind while they were in Northridge. I bet someone wiped the place clean... Someone on the inside. But I bet they forget that Sumek was also stationed in another location. Go to the Cable Car Station and see what you can find!
disp_detail.4010167: An unknown force in the Valley has attracted a lot of operators that are armed to the teeth. You might have the same target, but don't think you can avoid conflict. Work with your squad to wipe out anyone that gets in your way. If you want to survive in the Dark Zone, mercy isn't an option.
disp_detail.4010165: The unknown force that's appeared in the Valley has made it even more treacherous, but a powerful weapon will always help you to fend off disaster. The F2000's bullpup design allows you to fight with greater agility in tight spaces, so if you're going to the Villa in the Valley to look for supplies, taking an F2000 with you would be a good choice.
disp_detail.4010148: Something strange is going on at the Valley Villa, like it's been infiltrated by multiple different forces in disguise. Take this opportunity to infiltrate it yourself, blend in among the militants, and see what good things you can grab. And of course, if you see any other operators, remember to show no mercy. After all, who knows what they're there for?
disp_detail.4010152: Something strange is going on at the Valley Villa, like it's been infiltrated by multiple different forces in disguise. Take this opportunity to infiltrate it yourself, blend in among the militants, and see if you can grab anything good. But remember to move quickly. You don't want to attract any unnecessary trouble.
disp_detail.4010813: The Valley is a dangerous place. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. If you want those supplies, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010825: While the Valley is teeming with danger, the supplies that can be found all over have attracted a bunch of greedy fellas. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010823: While the Valley is teeming with danger, the supplies that can be found all over have attracted a bunch of greedy fellas. You probably don't want to share the supplies with them.
disp_detail.4010150: The Valley Lockdown Zone is a complex and ever-changing combat environment. Try your best to avoid getting caught up fighting any one enemy, or you'll end up attracting more, especially in the Villa. As soon as you encounter an enemy, make sure to defeat them quickly.
disp_detail.4010151: There's been chaos in the Valley recently, with multiple factions vying with each other for power. That gives you an opportunity to make some cash. A Covert Op will allow you to more easily enter those dangerous places, locate important supplies, and bring back as many as possible.
disp_detail.4010162: An unknown force in the Valley has attracted a large number of well-equipped operators. If you want to go there, you'll need to be fully prepared. Good armor is essential. Always make sure of your own safety before thinking about others.
disp_detail.4010909: The Valley is full of supplies, but there aren't that many enemies around. There are a lot of supplies waiting for in all sorts of places, so take a look around, and don't miss out on anything valuable.
disp_detail.5020412: The situation in the Valley is a bit chaotic right now. If you go, keep a low profile. You don't want to draw Porrero's attention.
disp_detail.9010203: The Valley deal came to an end with pretty good results. Truly no less than I expected from a soldier I hold in such high regard. A few days ago, I reached an agreement with Renoir, so I now need you to go to the Farm to get the lay of the land and prepare for the handover later. You still won't have any official role in this mission, so make sure you take care of yourself.
disp_detail.1040000: I have a good grip on the situation in the Valley now. I did not expect to find militants there too. Eliminate them! I don't want to be shot at when I go down into the Valley to investigate.
disp_detail.4010980: Something strange is going on in the Valley. Take this opportunity to infiltrate, blend in among the militants, and see what good things you can grab. But remember to move quickly. You don't want to attract any unnecessary trouble.
disp_detail.4010163: The unknown force in the Valley is well hidden, and the operators it's attracted are armed to the teeth. If you and your squad don't have enough firepower, try your best to avoid fighting them head-on. But if you can't avoid a battle, then their exposed legs are your best bet.
disp_detail.9041205: I don't feel safe in the Valley. I need you to clean up the weaponry there and ensure that they are not used by others.
disp_detail.9041603: Our informants in the Valley just sent word—several recon squads suspected to be from Team Annihilation recently pulled out of the Valley, their destination unknown. I want you to follow this intel and scour the Valley. Find their stronghold and see if they left anything behind. Clues, traces, anything they couldn't pack in time—find whatever you can.
disp_detail.4010729: In a place like the Valley, it's pretty common to engage enemies in shooting matches at a mid to long range, so an appropriate scope will give your shots that bit of extra precision. Even a submachine gun like an MPX can handle a few mid-range battles once you have a scope equipped.
disp_detail.4010414: Considering how sparsely populated the Valley is, there sure are a lot of supplies there. Whether at the Villa, the Small Factory, the RV Camp, or the Village, there are lots of materials just waiting to be looted. Don't skip these places if you want to make some quick money.

disp_detail.9041602: Things in the Valley are slowly stabilizing. More White Wolves are coming down from the north as backup. But before they arrive, I need you to make another run. Take this batch of medicine and supplies to the injured White Wolf brothers. They're still waiting in the Valley, and things aren't looking good. I need you to verify their condition for me.
disp_detail.4010128: An unknown group has infiltrated the militants in the Valley. I don't know what they're planning, but we need you and your operators to perform a Covert Op and find out what they're up to, and sort it out while you're at it.
disp_detail.4010811: The Valley is a dangerous place. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. If you can clear out those areas, the resources within are yours. Won't be easy, though.
disp_detail.4010847: The Valley is full of hidden dangers. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. Occupy the supply storage point and take care of whoever shows up. Let them know who's the boss in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.4010835: The Valley is full of hidden dangers. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. You'll only be able to collect the supplies when the area is clear of threats. Catch my drift?
disp_detail.4010801: The Valley is full of hidden dangers. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010837: The Valley is full of hidden dangers. The supplies scattered there have attracted a bunch of greedy folks. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.4010979: The Valley's got all kinds of supplies, including meds. They are scattered around, however, so you'll have to search around. In Covert Ops, remember to look around for scattered first-aid cases and bring some medical items back with you.
disp_detail.4010455: The Valley's got all kinds of supplies, including medical items. They're kind of scattered all over the place, though, so you'll have to look around to find them. If you ask me, the Eastern Farm is probably a good place to look.
disp_detail.4010922: The Valley's got all kinds of supplies, including medical items. They're kind of scattered all over the place, though, so you'll have to look around to find them. If you ask me, the Eastern Farm is probably a good place to look.
disp_detail.9421510: I've made contact with Kurt's squad. They urgently need fresh supplies to stay operational. However, due to Toland's continued infiltration of upper command, I can't use the CDIS logistics network to provide any official support to a squad that's been declared "eliminated." That's why I need you to go to Northridge one more time. Deliver these critical supplies to Kurt's squad at their temporary stronghold to help them out of this jam.
disp_detail.4010467: Instruments have been popular on the market lately, though I personally don't know why anyone would want to collect measurements and data in the Dark Zone. If you find any instruments, bring them back with you. You might make yourself a tidy profit.
disp_detail.4011031: Instruments have been popular on the market lately, though I personally don't know why anyone would want to collect measurements and data in the Dark Zone. If you find any instruments, bring them back with you. You might make yourself a tidy profit.
disp_detail.4010409: Instruments have been popular on the market lately, though I personally don't know why anyone would want to collect measurements and data in the Dark Zone. If you find any instruments, bring them back with you. You might make yourself a tidy profit.
disp_detail.9021008: The truck carrying my father ultimately stopped at the Northridge Sewage Plant, but where those people went after getting out of the vehicle is another question. Luckily, there are people in Northridge who I've treated before and they want to help me search for my father. They should have put some clues into a box and hidden it beside the road between the Farm and Northridge.
disp_detail.1020908: Help out with some daily missions at the Farm. Describe receiving intel that states the trail at Northridge Hotel has warmed up again. A convoy left Northridge a few days ago.
disp_detail.1020907: Help out with a mission in the Farm. The increase in militants has slowed down the traffic to Northridge. Describe the situation at Northridge and that the trail goes cold at Northridge Hotel, and express concern.
disp_detail.9401502: You're a lifesaver, friend! We've beaten back their offensive, and the White Wolves are retaking control of the outer strongholds. That should give the Warrant Officer a bit of breathing room. Now that the crisis at the Airport is temporarily resolved, heh heh... it's time to settle the score with these guys. According to our intel, this crew has shown up in several locations across the Dark Zone, apparently searching for something. I'm putting together two squads to go pay them a "visit"—and hopefully snag some intel while we're at it.
disp_detail.9251302: Good work. You remind me of the soldiers in Ajax's guard battalion. They're warriors, just like you. In the past, the army was run by vermin. Their shoddy leadership sent countless heroes to their demise—all up until the North-South Conflict broke out. The frontline crumbled like a house of cards, and the moment finally came for true warriors to prove their mettle. The guard battalion was abandoned back then by the scumbags who used to lead us. To cover up their mistakes, they marked the whole company down to die, even as they were fighting for survival. The reprobates even tried to keep support troops from getting to the Armory, hoping to delay them until it was too late. But Ajax's guard battalion didn't fall—in fact, they're still right where they were back then, holding the Armory.
disp_detail.9411512: Impressive work. You've certainly earned your reputation. Even the guard battalion fears you. The primary mission is complete. And now... it is time to settle some old scores. I need you to challenge the Wolves. Break their bared fangs, force them back into their den, and make them too scared to leave it again.
disp_detail.1040102: Hey kid, you know Northridge? There was an attack there, and a team that went there to investigate was also attacked. It's strange... My information indicates that those teams weren't supposed to be there. But I guess nothing is strange in the Dark Zone. I'd like you to check out the area, since it's been outside of our control for a while now, particularly the Cable Car Station. We know nothing about the place. Go and take care of a few difficulties for me, and bring back some intel from the file cabinet while you're at it.
disp_detail.9041104: Hey kid, you know Northridge? A team of scientists that went there for investigations was attacked. It's strange... My information indicates that the Sumek Committee wasn't supposed to be there. But I guess nothing is strange in the Dark Zone. Moreover, the committee never moves as one. Still, I'd like you to check out the area since it's been outside of our control for a while now, particularly the Observation Deck. We know nothing about the place now. Go and take care of a few difficulties for me, and bring back some intel from the file cabinet while you're at it.
disp_detail.1990004: Youngster, unlike you outsiders, I have lived on Kamona Island for more than fifty years. I have witnessed how it has changed since it was founded, and the people here basically see me as a local. It's a shame that some outsiders allow their greed to keep them from following the rules. They almost ruined that big Navy deal before. They are like flies, swarming to whatever smell they find in the Dark Zone. When you complete this mission, I will take you to the Port where I grew up.
disp_detail.1040105: Let me tell you a thing or two about Northridge, youngster. In those chaotic times, our people had already occupied Onotos, and were ready to continue marching south. But the Second Clan Officer abandoned us after occupying Marulos, which led to our ultimate defeat. Later, this whole area became the Dark Zone. Anyway, I'll tell you more about this later. One of my sources left me some data in Northridge. I want you to retrieve them from the third floor of the Communication Station there. While you're there, shut those Northridge goons up!
disp_detail.9041105: Let me tell you a thing or two about Northridge, youngster. During the Civil War, both armies had already occupied Onotos, and they were ready to march southward. However, the officers in charge of the two armies launched a mutiny after they'd occupied Marulos. They then became warlords and this led to the failure of the southern expedition. With the Sumek Committee's intervention, this whole area became the Dark Zone. Anyway, I'll tell you more about this later. One of my sources left me some data in Northridge. I want you to retrieve them from the third floor of the Communication Station there. While you're there, shut those Northridge goons up!
disp_detail.1040703: Operator, my guys had just arrived to retrieve the equipment when another group ambushed them. This incident caused them quite a bit of trouble and ultimately affected the retrieval's progress. I hate unexpected issues like this. So, to ensure that the equipment can be retrieved smoothly, I need you to go back to the Valley and teach them a lesson on my behalf. Act fast and strike hard!
disp_detail.1040502: Operator, my people traveled to the location you scouted. But another group suddenly showed up and started causing trouble. I'm furious! To ensure that the equipment can be collected smoothly, I need you to go back to the Valley and teach them a lesson on my behalf. Act fast and strike hard! Of course, I do realize that this is no easy task. Once completed, I will make this batch of special equipment available to you. This stuff is quite precious, and extremely useful to people such as yourself.
disp_detail.9411612: The young wolves found a small path and bypassed the blockade we set up. They've rushed to build a defensive line inside the Terminal. These young wolves are growing fast; the Crows can't push through their defenses quickly. Soldier, I need you to lead a Vanguard squad into the Control Tower and destroy their command center. Remember—you don't need to capture it, you just need to destroy as much equipment as you can.
disp_detail.9411610: The young White Wolves have potential, but they lack experience—they're nowhere near the level of a seasoned commander. Soldier, we have now achieved our objective. Prepare to withdraw. This operation went unusually smoothly, and the intel we gathered was incredibly accurate. I'm only just now realizing that the mole has been in among the White Wolves all along. Perhaps that maniac had everything planned out before she even arrived in Kamona. It's a good thing she's our captain now.
disp_detail.1020902: Introduction: Evita is seeking a personal favor via Joel.
disp_detail.9351402: Vladlen plans to ambush a Southern Army squad in the Valley. His main force has already arrived and is setting up on the perimeter. Just now, we learned that the Southern Army has dispatched an additional escort unit. They plan to enter from the eastern side of the Valley to provide cover for their squad. To ensure the main ambush is successful, I need you to assemble a special elimination squad. Head to the eastern side of the Valley to establish a blockade and intercept this escort unit. You must prevent them from meeting up with the main squad.
disp_detail.9231203: Vladlen. That northern bastard—and the local merchants in on it with him. I've got the green light to deal with them however I see fit. But these people... even you could handle them. Unless, of course, you have your own agenda.
disp_detail.9051104: Floranpino was a strategic point occupied by different factions during the civil war, but no one expected the local gang to be the final victor. They usually hang out in the Valley. My informant there left me something important at the Factory. Will you go there and bring it back for me? I'm sure you're aware that friendship and hostility never last forever, but profit does. The faction in the Valley is one that we have to ally ourselves with—or at least we cannot openly be enemies. We still have a lot of work to do in Kamona, so we're going to need support from the locals.

disp_detail.4010170: When you take out bosses in the Lockdown Zone, remember to take their Tokens back with you as proof of victory. There are some people who will pay good money to add these trinkets to their collections.
disp_detail.9231209: The situation has changed beyond my expectations, and the battle in Kamona will continue. Go and check out other places for me. The Abyss needs to expand the depth of its activities.

If you plan on doing this, I suggest bringing a larger pack, so that you can carry more things at once in case you don't bring out enough supplies to buy more ammo.

disp_detail.4010748: Many snipers think that you can give up your helmet to move more freely, but I don't agree. When caught in a firefight, a good helmet is extremely important, so don't take any chances! Once you're out, you're out, and you leave with nothing, so there's no harm in being careful.
disp_detail.1030702: Great, the schedule you got last time was really detailed, which saved the guys a whole load of hassle. However, I'm hoping you'll do me another favor. When the action starts, they'll head out from the Cable Car Station, then follow several roads to the Northridge Hotel. I'm hoping you can get near these roads and get any unrelated people out of the way so everything can go ahead smoothly. Head back once your job is done and let them handle any trouble after that. Act quickly and don't alarm the people at the hotel.
disp_detail.1040002: Very good. You may have heard of the Valley, bordered by mountains to the north and ocean to the south. It's currently occupied by an unruly mob with outdated equipment and no fighting power. Go check out what they're up to, but stay away from the Beach Villa. The people in there are a lot more dangerous.
disp_detail.1020302: Sorry to be bothering you again so soon, but this situation is really urgent. Things are tightening up at the Valley Port and it seems like Doss is about to make a move. As you know, all sides are now searching for my father, following the scent to the Valley, so I have reason to believe that what Doss is planning has something to do with my dad. Could you get yourself to the Port immediately and cause some trouble to stop them from sending my father elsewhere?
disp_detail.9021016: Sorry to be bothering you again so soon, but this situation is really urgent. Things are tightening up at the Valley Port and it seems like Doss is about to make a move. As you know, all sides are now searching for my father, following the scent to the Valley, so I have reason to believe that what Doss is planning has something to do with my dad. Could you get yourself to the Port immediately and cause some trouble to stop them from sending my father elsewhere?
disp_detail.5020411: Go defend the Village. My men are out right now. Don't let Porrero get away.
disp_detail.9261312: Just as I was afraid of, I've received confirmation the target is hiding near the Armory, for reasons unknown. The colonel is aware as well. He's increased the number of daily patrols and sent them out over a larger area, but they haven't found a trace of the target so far. From my experience with him in the past, I'd put money on him being in the Underground Mine. Plenty of places for someone to hide in all the snaking tunnels down there. I'm putting together a squad of guard battalion soldiers familiar with the Mine to investigate. You're pretty sharp, so I'd like you to go with them to the Armory.
disp_detail.9231204: Someone finally realized who's the best to collaborate with. A merchant that's willing to help placed some secret intel at a certain location. I've paid for it, so just retrieve it for me.
disp_detail.9341406: We've assessed the situation, and confirmed the enemy is our old rival: Blackgold Universal. Their numbers and intentions are currently unknown. In light of the escalation, I'm taking command of the field. I'll be taking the Flag Squad to the Airport shortly. It's far from the southern front and their supplies are limited, so I expect Blackgold's squad won't be very large. Before the Flag Squad arrives, I need you to work with the White Wolf Squad. Maintain a defensive position and hold the line. If necessary, you can fall back and secure the stronghold.
disp_detail.5010310: One of my intelligence officers left me some important evidence in a secret location, but the key was taken by someone from the Motel. Can you get it back for me?
disp_detail.9051204: Intel work is getting busier, and some basic resources are at risk of being in short supply. Please help me find something suitable so that I can continue this work.
disp_detail.9051203: Though our intelligence work has been disrupted, it's both unfair and unwise to respond with force without any prior warnings. I need a better grasp of the situation to submit a report to the higher-ups. Take these newly-developed hidden cameras and deliver them to the informant at N. Village.
disp_detail.9231408: The intel was correct: White Wolves reinforcements have arrived at the Airport. They're well-equipped and have a lot of firepower—the best of the best. They easily breached our weapon nests in the north, but fortunately, the main Blackgold force had already moved south, as planned. While the intensified assault led to significant casualties on our side, the wolf cubs in the Warehouse suffered even greater losses. We don't expect them to be able to fight for control of the Airport in the near future—so we've secured a crucial window of opportunity. Feel proud, operator. Your outstanding performance is what gave us this undeniable advantage.
disp_detail.5070303: Intel confirms an Antonio Family courier is temporarily holed up at the Airport with supplies. The message they're carrying could jeopardize the situation in the Valley. You are to intercept the target and eliminate the threat immediately.
disp_detail.9431617: With the intel control lifted, Vladlen is bound to reinvestigate the reliability of the entire network. Expert, I want you to head to the TV Station as soon as possible and destroy the intel transceiver equipment there to slow down their transmission efficiency. The intelligence officer whom the company bribed will use this window to withdraw from Kamona, cutting off their investigation at the source.
disp_detail.4011002: If you want to take a lot of supplies out of the Farm at once, you'll need to equip a bigger backpack, and you'll need to go somewhere with a lot of supplies. The Motel and the Grain Trade Center are your best bet. Don't miss them.

disp_detail.4010415: If you want to thoroughly search an area, you'll need to eliminate any nearby threats. That's what the other operators do. Work together with your teammates, and use force to clear others out of your territory.
disp_detail.4010433: If you want to thoroughly search an area, you'll need to eliminate any nearby threats. That's what the other operators do. Work together with your teammates, and use force to clear others out of your territory.
disp_detail.4010818: You'll need to be fully prepared in order to battle in the Dark Zone over a long time, and good armor is essential. Always ensure your own safety before thinking about other people.
disp_detail.4010845: You'll need to be fully prepared in order to battle in the Dark Zone over a long time, and good armor is essential. Always ensure your own safety before thinking about other people.
disp_detail.1010104: I know you've been to the Farm already, but you need to be familiar with every inch of it. Make sure you see the Open Storage, the Recycling Station, and the Dock at the Artificial Lake for yourself, and get to know every single car and every tree in the area. If you want to survive here, you'll have to know the lay of the land like the back of your hand.
disp_detail.4010504: You'll want to search for special containers to get the supplies you're looking for. For instance, if you desperately need tools, try checking toolboxes.
disp_detail.4010531: You'll want to search those special containers to get the supplies you're looking for. For instance, if you desperately need household goods, try checking gym bags.
disp_detail.4010522: You'll want to search those special containers to get the supplies you're looking for. For instance, if you desperately need computer parts, try checking computers.
disp_detail.4010513: You'll want to search those special containers to get the supplies you're looking for. For instance, if you desperately need medicine and medical supplies, try checking first-aid kits.
disp_detail.4010206: If you want to eliminate your target quickly, you've got to aim for their weakest part. This is especially true at mid-range, where firing aimlessly will get you nowhere.
disp_detail.4010208: It's difficult to get near the bosses in the Dark Zone. If the situation allows, try to take them out from afar with teammates. It won't be easy, though.
disp_detail.4010232: It's difficult to get near the bosses in the Dark Zone. If the situation allows, try to take them out from afar with teammates. It won't be easy, though.
disp_detail.5010503: A minuscule number of infected corpses produce a hard mass of tissue after they die. The tissue has a texture that's similar to cartilage. The client is paying top dollar for these things—the more intact, the better.
disp_detail.9241321: Thanks for seeing me safely back to the Farm so I can pay respects to my friends. I'm afraid my thanks are the only reward I have left to give you. You know, on the way here, I was mulling over exactly how I should make things up to my fallen comrades. I think I've finally thought of something. You'll probably say it's a way for me to shirk responsibility, and I won't argue with you... But I really have nothing else to lose at this point. I've been running so long, I don't have anyone left to run with me. So... I'm done running. I'm going to launch my own siege on the Armory! By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. Don't bother coming after me.
disp_detail.9041214: I don't want these prisoners to stay here for too long, so please deliver this letter as soon as possible. If they have any sense, they will know what to do.
disp_detail.4010134: I don't know what those guys were looking for in Northridge, but if you want enough supplies, you'll need to search every inch. With a little luck, you might even find some treasure.
disp_detail.4010222: Personally, I love the Mosin-Nagant. Others prefer sniping with semi-automatic firearms like the SKS, but they don't have the same power as the Mosin-Nagant. Make sure you use it with a suppressor, because it's noisy!
disp_detail.4010722: A bolt-action rifle is a personal favorite of mine. Retro, steady, reliable, and with a ferocity that would put a semi-automatic to shame. When using these rifles, remember to keep your distance, and to perform one-shot kills where possible.
disp_detail.5030301: I was almost killed in an ambush at Northridge Hotel, but I don't have any clues as to who did it. My men still need time to investigate.
disp_detail.5030311: I was almost killed in an ambush at Northridge Hotel, but I don't have any clues as to who did it. Looks like the investigation will take time.
disp_detail.5030321: I was almost killed in an ambush at Northridge Hotel, but I don't have any clues as to who did it. Looks like the investigation will take time.
disp_detail.5030331: I was almost killed in an ambush at Northridge Hotel, but I don't have any clues as to who did it. Looks like the investigation will take time.
disp_detail.9351401: I heard about you from Vladlen. To be honest, your reputation precedes you. If you can handle this commission cleanly, we should talk further. Now, on to the mission: The outer defenses of the guard battalion were recently breached. The Southern Army used this opportunity to launch a coordinated offensive and is now attacking the Farm from multiple directions. Your job is to cut in from the flank, provide cover for the guard battalion's line, and find an opportunity to eliminate the Southern Army officer leading the assault.
disp_detail.9341605: We were too late. The enemy assaulted the Airport early, planting doubt about the air transport plan among the high command, so they decided to opt for sea transport. The timing is just too perfect for my taste. It's like someone's secretly watching us and anticipating our every move. I don't want to believe it, but it seems that there's a traitor among us. I need you to stay at the Airport and keep an eye out for anything unusual. We need to grab this rat by the tail.
disp_detail.9261303: Well, we found nothing. The Valley Stronghold looks like it's been abandoned for a while now. Nothing left but a few scraggly militants. What's worse, we didn't find any traces of explosives there either. The Guard Corps is going to conduct a thorough search of Marulos, while Vinson and the family do the same in Floranpino. Onotos is the Forest Man's territory, so neither the Guard Corps nor the family can do much there. Word is you and the Forest Man get along okay, so we're sending you to Northridge instead. Pay careful attention to the area with the tall buildings to the west.
disp_detail.5070304: We've received a tip from an associate: There's a piece of unclaimed cargo, containing intel, inside the Freight Center. Please proceed to its location to confirm that and retrieve it.
disp_detail.9051101: We're here not only to carry out the plan to save the earth but also to bring peace and freedom to the people here. I asked an expert to take a look at the Sewage Plant and the Canal, but he left his report at the bus stop. Will you retrieve it for me? I'm in a bit of a hurry, so don't take too long!
disp_detail.9041210: We're having some problems with our supplies. There might be some usable supplies at the Farm. Go try your luck out there, soldier.
disp_detail.1010701: The expenses aren't a problem, but the chaos in the area has made it hard to import supplies. This makes it hard to focus on treating people. If you find any large supply caches, bring some back with you. It would help us tremendously.
disp_detail.9010103: I've analyzed the clues you brought back, and it looks like the people at the Colom Intelligence Bureau have gotten hold of the same intel as us, but we got to the TV Station first, so we've had the upper hand. Now that they've blown up the entrance, the White Wolf's supply line has been interrupted, so I need to set up a temporary supply line. Operator, I want you to take supplies to the second floor and put them in the Training Room and Reading Room. You won't be playing any official role in this operation, so remember to be careful when dropping off the supplies, as I don't want your name to end up on the White Wolf Squad's elimination report.
disp_detail.9341507: I just received an urgent message from Maxim. At the Farm, we found a cache of important supplies hidden by Team Annihilation—undoubtedly the core objective of the enemy's operation. We also got word from the Armory that a hostile commander, suspected to be the "Apostle," has led an elite squad in breaking through the Guard Corps' encirclement. Taken together, these unusual developments strongly suggest that this "Apostle" is the mastermind behind the entire series of attacks.
disp_detail.1050702: According to the intel you intercepted before, the northerners have planted eyes at the Construction Site to keep a watch over the TV Station, which puts them in complete control of our actions outside the TV Station. I tried to send some of my guys to get rid of these meddling spies, but they're vigilant and just get away every time. I'm hoping that you can help sort this. I'll recommend you to the people above me afterwards, as I just so happen to be helping them find suitable candidates. Just letting you know off the record, there are plenty of good jobs going at the headquarters.
disp_detail.5030302: I don't want anyone to know about my dealings with Fred. Help me take out the outsiders holed up in Northridge Hotel, friend.
disp_detail.4010461: I like to issue carbines to recruits as a primary weapon. The best tactic for such a weapon is to outflank the enemy, pick them off from afar or from the sides, and make your escape after a single strike. Carbines aren't hard to find in the Dark Zone. You can get them off militants.
disp_detail.9031313: I've got a friend up at the Northridge Hotel. We get along pretty well, even though he's not a local—kind of like me and you, actually. We've done some good work together in the past. From what he tells me, Onotos is having a hard time getting their hands on new supplies. I guess my buddy's got some ideas on that front, so he asked me for help. I agreed—doesn't seem like a difficult task, and I think it could help spur a bit of cooperation in the Dark Zone. Head to Northridge Hotel, old friend, and bring me back samples of his supplies.
disp_detail.9031209: I think I've figured out why our new guest is in Kamona. I've got a little surprise planned for her—but first, I need you to prep the Armory so the delivery goes off without a hitch.
disp_detail.4010168: I'm not interested in what those guys congregating in the Valley are up to. I just want to make use of the chaos to make Doss and his gang suffer. Are you and your squad ready? Remember to act fast and fight for the winning shot.
disp_detail.4010412: I suggest that you find a team to fight with. That way, you won't find yourself outnumbered when you encounter other operators. Even if you're more of a loner, you should try fighting alongside some teammates once in a while.
disp_detail.4010430: I suggest that you find a team to fight with. That way, you won't find yourself outnumbered when you encounter other operators. Even if you're more of a loner, you should try fighting alongside some teammates once in a while.
disp_detail.9031302: I'm very glad they're sensible enough to suggest leaving the Farm. Now, I can minimize the possibility of conflict occurring between both parties. I'll speak with Ajax later and strive to secure a safe evacuation route out of the Farm for them. They may not have the proudest past, and the puppets of the South may have been controlling them all this time, but I believe there is no North or South, and the day will come when Kamona stands united as one.
disp_detail.5020310: I just got my hands on some intel: A squad transporting resources will be making their way from the Beachhead Positions to the RV Camp.
disp_detail.3041428: I have to plant at night in order hide from those troublemakers. Bring me some kerosene lamps. Dim light sources get the job done, and they're much safer.
disp_detail.3041430: I have to patrol the small field every day, lest another cretin come and destroy the fruits of my labor. I need flashlights. Bring extras as spares!
disp_detail.3041415: If I want to move to Northridge Hotel, I have to establish a good relationship with everyone there. I need you to bring me some razors. They are very useful.
disp_detail.9021004: I think I'd better tell you the whole story before asking you for a favor. I've been searching for my father, who is a famous medical expert. Two years ago, he followed the Committee's research group to Kamona, but he was in his office at the Farm when the local forces attacked there a while back, and he disappeared. But the good thing is, he most likely wasn't in that motorcade. So... would you go to the Farm again for me? My informants left me an important clue in a house in the northeast area. The house is locked, but I know you can get in. Please.
disp_detail.1020202: I think I'd better tell you the whole story before asking you for a favor. I've been investigating my father, who is a famous medical expert. Two years ago, he followed the research group here, but he went missing a while back. An intelligence officer said he was being held at the Farm by militants, and the surgical kit that I asked you to retrieve last time was indeed his. Would you go there again for me? The officer left me an important clue in a house northeast of the Farm. The house is locked, but I know you can get in. Please.
disp_detail.3041409: I want to play my games on the TV, but a mouse chewed up my VGA cable. I need you to bring over some spare cables.
disp_detail.9041218: I need more information on the situation at these places in the Mine to facilitate future work, and I need you to deliver this letter to the road leading to the Mine. Just focus on finishing the mission as soon as possible.
disp_detail.9041206: I think the Valley should be safe now, and so I contacted Deke Vinson again. He said the intel was placed in a secret place, and I need you to go there.
disp_detail.3041420: I fixed the circuit, only to find out that the cables aren't supplying power. It seems you'll have to go to the Trading Post to borrow some. Bring me loads of wires. Loads!
disp_detail.1040701: I received intel on an unknown group of Southerners around Marulos, and I suspect they're up to something again. Operator, I need you to investigate around Floranpino, and immediately report back if you find anything suspicious. Timeliness is of the utmost priority in this mission.
disp_detail.9041111: I received intel on an unknown group of Southerners around Marulos. I need you to get this letter to the Valley. The White Wolves will take over the investigation from there.
disp_detail.5070305: We've located the Blackgold squad's observation post on the second floor of the Terminal. I need you to neutralize it and disrupt their transmission of information.
disp_detail.9061106: I'm Randall. I know that the superiors have their own plans, but I don't want my buddies who are buried in Kamona to be forgotten just like this. I believe everyone has to pay the price for their actions. Although I'm unable to take revenge personally, I can use other ways to attract more attention to this bounty. Please find more people to resolve this matter as soon as possible. Don't worry, the rewards will be impressive.
disp_detail.9061104: This is Randall. Some shady characters are going around looking for the Northridge surveillance tapes, and I don't have time to play spy with them. Your task is simple. Go to Northridge Camp Services and destroy the tapes. They can't fall into the wrong hands.
disp_detail.1060203: This is Randall. Some shady characters are going around looking for the Northridge surveillance tapes, and I don't have time to play games. Your task is simple. Go to Northridge Camp Services, floor three, and destroy the tapes. They can't fall into the wrong hands.
disp_detail.9061101: This is Randall. There are troublemakers in Northridge, and I need you to check out the Sewage Plant, Crash Site, and Testing Station. Find out what they're up to, and be prepared. You don't want this to be your last mission.
disp_detail.1060201: This is Randall. There are troublemakers in Northridge, and I need you to check out the Sewage Plant, Crash Site, and Testing Station. Find out what they're up to. And be prepared.
disp_detail.1060601: Randall here. There's something I need you to deal with. A Blackgold shipment will arrive at the Farm Loading Area soon. This shipment is critical to our next operation, and there is no room for error. But as you know, there are often troublemakers around there. Go help me clean up the area. I don't want this batch of goods to encounter any issues.
disp_detail.9061001: Randall here. There's something I need you to deal with. A Blackgold shipment will arrive at the Farm Loading Area soon. This shipment is critical to our next operation, and there is no room for error. But as you know, there are often troublemakers around there. Go help me clean up the area. I don't want this batch of goods to encounter any issues.
disp_detail.9241301: I'm the boss around here. Thanks for the supplies. You might be aware that we're all old Southern Army, but you probably don't know about our complicated relationship with the guard battalion. If you did, you might understand why it's not something likely to change. We're already being mistreated just because we're Southerners. If the truth about our past came to light, the guard battalion wouldn't let us leave here alive. That's why we're planning on bugging out ASAP. Protect us as we head for greener pastures—I'll handle your payment.
disp_detail.9031204: I'm finding it hard to keep up with my business lately, mainly because I'm lacking tools and raw materials. I don't want to give up on this big client, and so I've come to you to see if you can find suitable tools for me.
disp_detail.4010809: I've got a friend who's a real crack shot, especially when it comes to pistols. I'm not sure what business he's in. He just walks around all day in a suit and sunglasses, and seems to have an endless supply of ammo.
disp_detail.4010324: I've got a friend who's a real crackshot, especially when it comes to pistols. That said, he's no soldier, and he doesn't sell anything. He just walks around all day in a suit and sunglasses. He seems to have an endless supply of ammo.

disp_detail.5020409: My men jettisoned some guns while they were chasing Porrero. Go pick them up.
disp_detail.9051206: You've caught my colleague's attention—but you'll need to show what you're capable of before she agrees to meet.
disp_detail.9401506: Holy cow! This "cargo" is some truly "rare" stuff. I've heard the Warrant Officer mention something like this before, but it shouldn't be here. It's supposed to be underground at the TV Station. Anyway, never mind the details. The real problem is that it's here. I need to report this to the Warrant Officer immediately and request instructions. Friend, take your team and conduct another thorough sweep of the area. See if you can find any more "surprises" for us.
disp_detail.5020312: My guys have opened up a new path in the Valley, but they had to leave some stuff behind. I need you to retrieve it so that it remains a secret from the locals.
disp_detail.5020318: My guys have opened up a new path in the Valley, but they had to leave some stuff behind. I need you to retrieve it so that it remains a secret from the locals.

disp_detail.3041406: My radio is broken. Frankie usually helps me contact someone for repairs, but a few days ago he... Can I ask you to help?
disp_detail.1020105: Say, my friend, are you familiar with the Farm? Some newcomers don't know the place very well, and not knowing your way in the Dark Zone can be fatal. Why don't you scout some key areas of the Farm, too? Bring some good stuff back, because hard work is how you get rich!
disp_detail.1020101: My friend, you probably know by now that you can do a lot as an operator in the Dark Zone. Take advantage of the identity to explore more of the Farm and make yourself some money, yeah? Oh, and stay safe.
disp_detail.1030703: My friend, I'm sorry! The last mission has only just been completed and now there's a new one, but I still need your help clearing things up. The previous mission was a success and the Northridge Hotel was taken down. At the same time, another group from the Valley ambushed a convoy leaving from the back door of the hotel in the early hours of the morning, and captured several "experts" who had come from afar. Now they're gone, it's your mission to go to the scene and wrap things up, including dealing with any witnesses! Once you've completed your mission, collect your money and disappear for a while, otherwise someone will come knocking and make you disappear.
disp_detail.1020102: My friend, I sent a militant partner of mine to the Farm's Grain Trade Center to check things out there, but it's been a few days since we arranged to meet again and he still hasn't returned. I'm a little worried about him. Can you do me a favor? Could you search the Grain Trade Center and see if there's any sign of him?
disp_detail.1020705: A battle has broken out at the Hotel! My father could be in danger. Why did he have to go there?! I guess all I can do is notify the Northridge medical station to keep an eye out for him. Can you please place a note in the house with the gray roof in S. Village? I need to explain things to them clearly. Oh, right! Take a signal receiver and leave it for them with the note. That way I can keep in contact with them afterward.
disp_detail.9020203: My suspicions have been confirmed: those folk from Tevila are my old opponents. I reckon we must both be here for the same reason. It's a pity that I'm one step behind. I need you to slow their operation down for me. By the way, could you also help me confirm Doss' movements? So many people have come to the Valley from Tevila. He must be involved in one way or another.
disp_detail.3041417: My camera broke a while ago, and I don't know anything about repairing electronics. Bring me some glue so I can stick it back together for now.
disp_detail.9041108: My informants tell me that several Dark Zone bosses are planning a secret meeting at the Northridge Hotel. They're on high alert and will immediately recognize any of my people, so that's why I need you. Go to Northridge and visit the Observation Deck, Watchtower, and Sawmill. See if anything's changed. This is really important to me, so I'll reward you well for your efforts.
disp_detail.1040108: My informants tell me that several Dark Zone bosses are planning a secret meeting at the Northridge Hotel. They're on high alert and will immediately recognize any of my people, so that's why I need you. Go to Northridge and visit the Cable Car Station, the Watchtower, and the Sawmill. See if anything's changed. This is really important to me, so I'll reward you well for your efforts.
disp_detail.5040304: One of my sources left a message for me on the transceiver at the Gas Station. Bring it back to me. But be careful—lots of people have their sights set on that transceiver.
disp_detail.4010323: My sources tell me a group of unidentified men have gathered near the Sewage Plant in Northridge, but they don't know what they're planning. We've got enough trouble as it is, and we certainly don't need more from them. Head over there and pacify them.
disp_detail.4010347: My sources tell me a group of unidentified men have gathered near the Villa in the Valley, but they don't know what they're planning. We've got enough trouble as it is, and we certainly don't need more from them. Head over there and pacify them.
disp_detail.1030401: You've been here for a while, haven't you? How are things? Have you gotten friendly with the locals? Let's just say that if you want to make it big out here, use your head and think like a local! Bring back whatever goodies you can find in the Dark Zone, then sell them to become rich. But remember, don't make too many enemies or it'll come back to haunt you.
disp_detail.3041414: I'm running out of supplies. I've been able to find some things nearby, but not nearly enough. Could you please bring me some mango juice?
disp_detail.9011503: I trust your judgment. The problem is, the bizarre rumors about the Valley haven't died down—they're only increasing. They might sound like cheap thrillers, but they're not coming from nowhere. Operator, I'll have to ask you to head to the Valley again. This time, focus on investigating the specific locations mentioned in the rumors and see if anything unusual is happening.
disp_detail.4010201: I see you're good with weapons. That means you must be familiar with the M14, right? Many recruits only want automatic weapons, but I'm sure you understand that different situations call for different weapons.
disp_detail.4010704: I see you're good with weapons, and that means you must be familiar with the M16 as well. Many recruits only use automatics, but I'm sure you understand that different environments call for different weapons.
disp_detail.9241304: I've had enough. I was a decorated soldier, you know! And now I have to live alongside these vermin?! Forget it. I've found my own solution... Ah! When'd you get here, friend? Right, I wanted to ask you something. Did you know the family tried to pick a fight with us recently? They were obviously in the wrong, but that old fox keeps telling us to calm down. One thing's for certain—we can't stay here anymore. Our plan now is to try our luck in Northridge. Before that, though, could you help me deliver this letter to a friend here?
disp_detail.9251303: You're familiar with Northridge and on good terms with Vinson, so I'm sure you're aware of the deal the Guard Corps has reached with Northridge. It was going to be great for everyone, but some low-down militants just had to set their sights on our goods. Some people just don't value their own lives. Head down to Northridge and teach them a lesson. Maybe in their next lives they'll have more self-respect.
disp_detail.9241308: I know one of your number doesn't trust us, even leaked our position to that old fox. Whoever it was, I don't blame them—I get how operators think. It's all about profit, plain and simple. At the moment, we're fish in a net waiting to get reeled in. If you help us, you'll be in the same boat—but keep in mind, I take care of my people. It's like they say, risk and opportunity come hand in hand. You wanna get rich quick or walk away? The choice is yours.
disp_detail.1020706: I need to calm down. First, I need to find out if my father really stayed at Northridge Hotel. Could you fetch me the guest log from the Hotel reception? I'm sorry to trouble you, but there isn't anyone else I can ask.
disp_detail.3041403: I'm going to a friend's party and we're going to... play a friendly game. Deliver some playing cards so I can clean him out.
disp_detail.1020602: After studying the grain delivery truck schedule you brought me, I can say with near certainty that my father was planning to hitch a ride out of here on one of the trucks from the Grain Trade Center. Will you go down there and check the license plates on the trucks to see if you can find the one that left the Farm?
disp_detail.9021006: After studying the grain delivery truck schedule you brought me, I can say with near certainty that my father was planning to hitch a ride out of here on one of the trucks from the Grain Trade Center. disp_detail.4010219: One of the guys I know always talks about how good he is with a firearm, bragging about his ability to hit a coin from several hundred meters away. Real combat is different from firearm training; in real combat, the target isn't waiting around for you to hit them.
disp_detail.4060109: I've just received a bit of a tricky commission, but my men are all out on a mission. I need your help to complete it. Go to Northridge, eliminate the enemies there, and seize their weapons. After that, you can consider the job done. My people will take care of the rest.

disp_detail.4010346: I've got a customer who urgently needs SH18 military helmets. Apparently, any other kind just won't cut it. He doesn't want to tell me what he needs it for. The Dark Zone is full of guys like that, always shrouded in mystery. That said, the price he's offering isn't bad. Think about it.
disp_detail.4010322: One of my clients needs some standard SWAT armor. Apparently, any other kind just won't cut it. He doesn't want to tell me what he needs it for. The Dark Zone is full of guys like that, always shrouded in mystery. That said, the price he's offering isn't bad. Think about it.
disp_detail.4010342: I need some weapons for training new recruits. If you happen to have an extra carbine, bring it to me. I'll pay you well.
disp_detail.4010318: I need some weapons for training new recruits. If you happen to have an extra shotgun, bring it to me. I'll pay you well.
disp_detail.3041401: I need you to bring over several barrels of oil. Hear that clearly: Not only oil, but also barrels. I know they aren't readily available in the Dark Zone, but I'm sure you have your ways.
disp_detail.3041427: I need a lot of seeds. With what I learned last time, this crop will be successful. But this time, I have to hide them somewhere no one will find them.
disp_detail.1060401: Randall here. I need some dog tags. My people sometimes need false identities when they're on missions. I'm sure you know that some jobs are not so... honorable.
disp_detail.9061005: Randall here. I need some dog tags. My people sometimes need false identities when they're on missions. I'm sure you know that some jobs are not so... honorable.
disp_detail.9411502: They may see this as an undeserved calamity, but once they chose to become accomplices, they forfeited any claim to innocence. Their arrogance is a chain that will inevitably drag them to ruin. In that sense, you and I are much alike: even when trapped, we don't curse our fate—we keep going until we find a way out.
disp_detail.9010204: Soldier, you've shown yourself to be valuable in your previous missions, so I can reveal some intel to you. A "guest" was transferred to somewhere near the Farm. They'll arrive at the Farm sometime soon and I'll have my people take over. Ajax's people are ensuring the safety of the "guest" during this time. Speaking of missions, I need you to help me clean up the Farm. I can't have any mishaps during this mission.
disp_detail.9411609: You did well, soldier. The sabotage operation at the Airport was a success. In the short term, at most they'll only be able to repair a single transport runway. And the Crows have received new intel: a Task Force is departing from the wolves' den, preparing to reinforce the Airport's defenses. But by the time they arrive, all they'll find is a complete mess.
disp_detail.9411614: Prepare to fall back, soldier. We already achieved our objective, so no need to waste any more manpower here. The Crows will make an orderly withdrawal along their route. Don't worry about Blackgold; they chose this path, and they'll have to finish walking it themselves. Lead the remaining Task Forces and extract them out from the west side; I'll cover your rear from the north. Get moving; don't look back. I'll see you at the rendezvous point.
disp_detail.9010201: Soldier, there's trouble again. We've heard from our operation in Guoyapos that Northridge has transferred a group of experts there, but they all disappeared after the Northridge Assault and no one knows where they are now. These missing experts are valuable to me, so I'm planning on reopening my investigation into the attack.
disp_detail.9411611: Soldier, get to the combat position as quickly as possible. In this operation, Blackgold will attack from the east, and you'll lead your team in from the west. Meanwhile, the Crows will attack the Terminal from the north to draw out the White Wolves from the Control Tower. Your mission is to secure the outer corridors, cut off the ground connection between the Control Tower and the Terminal, and stop the White Wolves' reinforcements from getting through. As for Blackgold, they can fight their own battles. Just focus on your own mission.
disp_detail.9010205: Soldier, my guys are almost there. The operation will start as soon as they're on the Farm. Things are getting tense. I want you to gear up and go to the Farm, and check it out again. If you find anyone acting suspicious, don't hold back and get rid of them ASAP. The security of the "guest" handover area is the top priority. Once the operation is underway, my team will meet you at the designated spot on the Farm.
disp_detail.9411613: Keep your chin up, soldier. It wasn't your fault that the Control Tower op failed. The enemy is skilled and held the defensive advantage; getting out in one piece was already the best possible outcome. Anyway, right now I need you at the Terminal to cover the Crows' retreat. Blackgold's impact on the east side is fading, and the young wolves are turning their fire to wipe out the Crows. The goal of this Airport operation was never to take full control of it. We must save our strength for the battles to come.
disp_detail.9411501: Since you've navigated the mist and uncovered the truth I left behind, you now have the chance to work with me. Some time ago, a group of overconfident fools made a serious mistake, and those sent to clean up after them proved utterly incompetent, leaving a tangled mess. Our superiors are displeased, and the responsibility to fix it now falls squarely on our shoulders.
disp_detail.9411601: Come to Northridge, soldier. "The deadliest operator in the Dark Zone." Those were her words, not mine. I didn't accept the job in your place, but I also didn't think you'd want to pass this one up. I can't give you the details now. All I can say is that this psycho is formally my superior, and the commander of Team Annihilation's operations in the Kamona region.
disp_detail.9010207: Soldier, the Gresk Squad has received the target, and Ajax won't help us with our evacuation operation at the Farm anymore. The team from Blackgold are watching over the perimeter of the Farm, so there's no way of making a smooth escape. The target cannot be lost, so I'm going to order the White Wolf Squad to pretend to retreat from the side of the Farm to attract the Blackgold team's attention. Take advantage of this opportunity and take the target and leave the Farm in the other direction. I need you to clear any obstacles and get out of there quickly. My people will contact you afterwards to get the target.
disp_detail.9411605: A tactical loss doesn't mean strategic defeat. They've won this round, but don't lose heart. New orders: follow the highway to Floranpino. You're certainly familiar with Doss in the Valley. Ever since he switched factions, the White Wolves have kept him safe. Our target is not Doss himself, but rather the White Wolves protecting him, as well as the reinforcements that will surely follow. Hit them hard—so hard that they have no choice but to commit more personnel to the area. Once the enemy is mired in the wrong place, they'll be powerless to put up a fight where it really matters.
disp_detail.9231403: The White Wolf Squad was spotted from an observation post in the outdoor exhibition area. The situation escalated quickly and a Blackgold squad attacked them, successfully halting their recon mission. After a brief fight, the White Wolves disengaged and retreated north. Obol is leading a team to track them from the west. I need you to conduct a parallel search, moving north from the east. If this goes well, we should be able to pinpoint their temporary base and get a rough estimate of their numbers.
disp_detail.5020410: There's a suitcase in front of the cabin at the RV Camp. Search it for clues.
disp_detail.9051413: This is familiar. It looks like his handiwork... but I need more proof. I'll continue investigating the Team Annihilation people in Guoyapos. In the meantime, I need you to take a squad and sweep the Valley—see if you can find any clues they might have left behind.
disp_detail.5010507: Thomas' team is going to enter from the Small Hall. Someone needs to send them a signal from the Hall and hold out until they hear it.
disp_detail.5020427: Gather up some of the locals' supplies for me. I want to see what kinds of tricks they've got up their sleeves.
disp_detail.5010302: Eliminate the operators at the Motel. They've got something I want.
disp_detail.9271204: It seems Vladlen wasn't the only one who got the good stuff. Some guy called Thomas Edward was involved too. As usual, I wanna know who he is and what he's been up to lately.
disp_detail.9231409: Obol has confirmed that the White Wolves' forces fully withdrew from the Airport before dawn. The Blackgold squad is performing a final sweep of the Fuel Storage area to be completely sure. This mission was a resounding success. The Abyss Squad will leave for the next front immediately. And, operator—your performance was exceptional. I'd rate it an A, at least. Now you have two choices: One, stay at the Airport and help the Blackgold squad reinforce its defenses. Or two, return south with us—a new commission is already waiting for you there.
disp_detail.9261302: We've cleared out their Stronghold, but unfortunately, we were unable to find any traces of explosives. Still, we didn't come back completely empty-handed. We were able to make one of those worms tell us their background. I say worms, but pests might be a better word. They're the same pests I faced a few years back. Had us fighting like dogs at the Armory for three whole months—even had us on the ropes, at one point. Thankfully, the colonel showed up to break their blockade. Otherwise, the guard battalion and I would be nothing but dust and dog tags now. Anyway, next we're going to be looking for a Stronghold outside of Marulos. You operators are going to be taking the lead this time. The guard battalion will cover you.
disp_detail.4010416: I've heard some militants are hoarding flammables at the Farm. It's too dangerous to leave them in their hands. If you run into them, make sure to bring as many of the flammables back as you can. I don't know their exact location, but supposedly there are a bunch of flammables under the Motel.
disp_detail.4010463: I've heard some militants are hoarding flammables at the Farm. It's too dangerous to leave them in their hands. disp_detail.4010934: I've heard some militants are hoarding flammables at the Farm. Those things are dangerous! Let's help them "look after them". I don't know their exact location, but supposedly, there are a bunch of them under the Motel.
disp_detail.5020407: I've received a top-secret report. Search the safe under the Factory where Porrero once holed up. See if he left a case of gold bars there.
disp_detail.5020402: I just got word that Porrero's men are planning to attack the Supply Camp. Go stop them.
disp_detail.5020425: I just received a tip that they used to gather under the Factory. Go search the safe there, and report your findings back to me.
disp_detail.9341404: The Control Tower's core area shows clear signs of being redone for military purposes. The northern entrance on the perimeter is confirmed to be sealed. The ordnance specialist with the White Wolves is at the entrance, trying to figure out a way into the core area. You and the rest of the White Wolf Squad are to advance south along the main road. Continue your reconnaissance and assess the situation in the other areas of the Airport.
disp_detail.4010718: When you spot an enemy before they spot you, don't strike too soon. If you can hit your opponent's weak spot and take them out in one shot, then you'll give less away. Add a suppressor on top of that to cover your tracks even more.
disp_detail.9411522: Our showdown was interrupted, but the threads of fate will not be severed so easily. I'm certain a more fitting stage will present itself in time. For revenge, I can afford to be patient. I will lead my team south as quickly as possible to provide support. Your mission is to hold off the Guard Corps' pursuing forces from the rear. Don't let me down.

disp_detail.5010511: A troop went completely out of contact while they were extracting. I've marked their extraction route for you. Follow it and look for clues. Find out what happened.

disp_detail.9411526: I've received intel from the captain. The escort team is closing in on the TV Station. This is our last chance. I have to admit, that young wolf has grown faster than expected and is already showing signs of an alpha. The battle will be extremely dangerous. Whether you take part in this final gambit is up to you.
disp_detail.5020404: I just got word that Porrero may have stashed a case of gold bars in a toolbox at the Merchant's Wharf. Go check it out.
disp_detail.5020424: They need to pay for messing with me!
disp_detail.3041402: A few days ago, a few mice sneaked into the Port and started disturbing the peace. I hate this feeling. Think you could give me a hand?
disp_detail.3041426: You should be familiar with Vincent's Variety Store. My shop is located there. Please send over a batch of insecticide as soon as possible. I need it urgently.
disp_detail.5010312: The supplies at the Bridge Fracture have been taken. It seems like they're going to be transported from the Loading Area. Go eliminate the enemies there. You'll need to move fast.
disp_detail.1010806: Recruit, you're strong enough to take on any challenge now, so can you help me? The last time I went to the Dark Zone, I was on a reconnaissance mission. I went with my squad to the Motel to do some work for the committee. But just as we were finishing up, some coward ambushed us. I barely made it out of there, and my squad... I hope you can help me finish up that mission and teach that twerp a lesson.
disp_detail.1010801: Recruit, I believe that your basic skills are up to par, now that you're daring to come to the Dark Zone. However, this is no ordinary battlefield. There are all kinds of people here, and the relations between allies and enemies is chaotic, with danger coming from all directions. No matter what brings you here, you must keep in mind that there is only one thing between you and your objective: a successful extraction.

disp_detail.9051118: No matter who it is, they must be a fool to think these losers could ever stop our advance. I will dispatch some forces to the Armory, but they will need someone to lead the way. It's the perfect job for you. So, guide them around the place, and they'll take care of the rest.
disp_detail.1030503: Morning, friend. You did well last time, and there are far fewer troublemakers in the Valley now. Oh, another commission came, but it's in a folder in the Port Office. Will you bring it back to me? Make sure the folder does not fall into the wrong hands.
disp_detail.9031004: Morning, friend. You did well last time, and there are far fewer troublemakers in the Valley now. Oh, another commission came, but it's in a folder in the Port Office. Will you bring it back to me? Make sure the folder does not fall into the wrong hands.
disp_detail.9431602: A wise decision. Welcome aboard—I hope we'll be working together for a long time. Let's start things off with an appetizer. Expert, I need you to go to Northridge and teach Fred a lesson. Find their hidden stronghold and wipe out a Forest Man squad. What? You're asking if we have some sort of grudge? Of course not. But since we just arrived in Kamona, think of it as doing a small favor for that Viper.
disp_detail.4010804: The dangerous areas of the Dark Zone are teeming with militants. In Covert Ops, try to use the terrain to your advantage and pick them off one by one. As long as you keep your distance from other operators and militant bosses, you'll have a shot at victory.

disp_detail.9051415: Traces of Team Annihilation have been found all over the Dark Zone. The frightening thing is, it's almost as though they didn't exist before we started our investigation. According to the latest intel from Kayla, someone spotted a Crow Feather in the Onotos region. From this, we can infer that their next target is probably Northridge. This is going to be a long-term assignment. I need you to head to Northridge, my friend, and track down any leads on this Team Annihilation and uncover their true intentions. This is a highly sensitive matter. You'll be reporting directly to me, and me alone.
disp_detail.4010921: There are some air drop containers in the Dark Zone that are filled with supplies, and you can find some good equipment inside sometimes. If you don't know where they are, I've marked them on the map.
disp_detail.4010462: The Dark Zone is chock-full of supplies, but if you want to extract with a heavy load, you're going to need a bigger backpack. It's a good idea to prepare several. You should be able to find a few in Northridge. Remember to roll them up when you store them, so that they don't take up too much space.

disp_detail.4011047: Life is hard in the Dark Zone, but surprisingly, there are people who pay top dollar to collect papers. Who knows how much useful information they've dug up? I usually don't keep track of such things, but if you come across any, you could probably get a good price for them.
disp_detail.4010439: Life is hard in the Dark Zone, but surprisingly, there are people who pay top dollar for electronics. Doesn't make sense to me, though. I usually don't keep up with things like that, but if you come across any, you could probably get a good price for them.

disp_detail.4010929: In a place like the Dark Zone, quality electronics are few and far between, and not many people have such things. If you need some, you should try your luck in Northridge.

disp_detail.4010913: There are some safes in the Dark Zone, and you can occasionally find some valuable things inside. If you come across them, remember to take a look. You're sure to find something good. If you don't know where they are, check the map. I've marked them there.
disp_detail.4010926: There are some abandoned computers in the Dark Zone with accessories inside. You can usually sell them for a good price, so don't pass over them if you see them. If you don't know where they are, check the map. I've marked them there.
disp_detail.4010937: There are some document boxes in the Dark Zone. A lot of it is just useless information, but occasionally, you'll find some important data inside. If you don't know where they are, check the map. I've marked them there.
disp_detail.4010902: There are a lot of military supply crates in the Dark Zone with accessories and weapons inside. If you come across them, remember to take a look. You're sure to find something good. If you don't know where they are, I've marked them on the map.
disp_detail.4010221: Everyone is after the supplies in the Dark Zone. I'm thinking you definitely don't want anyone else getting their hands on the things you're after. You should give them a warning... a very clear one, if you know what I mean.
disp_detail.4010401: It can be a hassle to find useable computer parts in the Dark Zone. The Grain Trade Center and the Motel over in the Farm have some abandoned computers lying around. Bring back something useful.
disp_detail.4010905: It can be a hassle to find usable computer parts in the Dark Zone. The Northridge Hotel and Cable Car Station have plenty of abandoned computers lying around. Bring back something useful.
disp_detail.4011619: The Dark Zone may not be an oasis of calm, but it certainly isn't lacking in supplies. There's always loot somewhere if you're willing to look. But of course, you've got to extract with the loot for your efforts to count.
disp_detail.4011633: The Dark Zone may not be an oasis of calm, but it certainly isn't lacking in supplies. There's always loot somewhere if you're willing to look. But of course, you've got to extract with the loot for your efforts to count.
disp_detail.9251301: I've been told the Guard Corps regards you highly as a soldier, but me—I only believe what I see with my own two eyes. And I've got to say... You lived up to your reputation during the operation at the Armory. I'm Renoir. You can call me Colonel. I've just received intelligence that a group of Southerners, sponsored by the West, is looking to reignite our old conflict. From what we're seeing, they've slipped a few squads into Floranpino. These aren't the ragtag weaklings we've dealt with before—these are real Southern Army soldiers. Hunt them down and wipe them out.
disp_detail.3000515: The final entry has the girl claiming that the factory is the path forward for everyone. She hopes her parents will come to the Valley to visit it, assuring them that once they do, they will understand everything and leave all their worries and sorrows behind.
disp_detail.9421509: The latest intel shows we've successfully sent Team Annihilation down the wrong path. Our window of opportunity is now open. I need you to secretly go to Northridge for me and deliver the real message to Kurt's squad. The exact coordinates have been encrypted and sent to your terminal. Confirm the location as soon as possible and deliver the intel securely. They're counting on it.
disp_detail.9281208: Have you heard the rumors about the "door"? The clues I have point to Northridge Hotel. It's supposedly hidden behind a room's "door." But I don't know which one. I need you to investigate.
disp_detail.4010137: There's been a lot of activity in Northridge lately, and a lot of operators in the Hotel, especially. In a difficult indoor environment like that, I think a shotgun would be a safe bet. Remember that if you ever want to stir up trouble.
disp_detail.4010141: There's been a lot of activity in Northridge lately, and a lot of operators in the Hotel, especially. Instead of facing them head-on in a challenging indoor environment, you can also try hanging back and sniping careless opponents from the periphery.
disp_detail.9251304: A lot's been going on around here lately, and there are signs that most of it's being pushed by people behind the scenes. I think the Westerners aren't happy with how things are going in the Dark Zone currently—that is to say, they've got an issue with the Guard Corps' attitude. They used to use the Guard Corps as a pawn in their struggle against the North. Guess they never imagined their pawn might change places to adapt to the times. Nobody in the Guard Corps wants to end up puppets like those Southerners. Intel has it that the Westerners have sent a squad into the Valley to disrupt our trade. Head there yourself and make sure the deal goes through smoothly.
disp_detail.4010448: A lot of my equipment's been breaking lately, and I don't have any useable tools to repair it. In Covert Ops, remember to keep an eye out for the toolboxes that are littered around the area. Bring some tools back for me.
disp_detail.4010438: A lot of my equipment's been breaking lately, and I don't have any useable tools to repair it. When you're scouring for supplies, remember to keep an eye out for the toolboxes that are littered around the area. See if you can bring some tools back for me.
disp_detail.4010427: A lot of my equipment's been breaking lately, and I don't have any useable tools to repair it. If you're going to the Valley, remember to keep an eye out for the toolboxes that are littered around the area. See if you can't bring some tools back for me.
disp_detail.4010948: Lately, the number of operators competing for resources in the Valley has been on the rise, and the fighting has only grown more intense. If you want to obtain resources safely, you may have to use some heavy-handed methods. At times like these, work alongside your teammates. It's easier to extract with some friends at your back.
disp_detail.4010243: The number of operators competing for resources in the Valley has been on the rise lately. The fighting is only getting more intense. If you want to obtain resources safely, you may have to use some heavy-handed methods. In times like these, conduct operations with teammates. There is safety in numbers.
