disp_detail.4010955: A lot of my equipment's been ruined by the damp lately, and I don't have any usable tools to repair it. In Covert Ops, remember to keep an eye out for the toolboxes that are littered around the area and bring some tools back for me.
disp_detail.4010927: A lot of my equipment's been ruined by the damp lately, and I don't have any usable tools to repair it. If you're going to the Valley, remember to keep an eye out for the toolboxes that are littered around the area and bring some tools back for me.
disp_detail.1030802: How have you been doing? You know, business is getting harder and harder to conduct in this environment. My people are all out running errands for me to make every penny we can. After all, we've got a big family to support. Unfortunately, a shortsighted few have chosen to engage in embezzlement to satisfy their own personal interests. I need you to destroy the messages they've left behind and get rid of those parasites. Only those who follow the rules survive longer in the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.1020601: I've been poring over the videotape that you retrieved for me. I'm thinking it was taken in the Transport Parking Lot of the Grain Trade Center. My father was forced into a vehicle, but I can't make out the license plate. Could you go to the second floor of the Grain Trade Center and look for the delivery truck schedule, then bring it straight back to me? I need to know that license plate. Thank you so much.
disp_detail.9021005: I've been poring over the videotape that you retrieved for me. I'm thinking it was taken in the Transport Parking Lot of the Grain Trade Center. My father was forced into a vehicle, but I can't make out the license plate. Could you go to the second floor of the Grain Trade Center and look for the delivery truck schedule, then bring it straight back to me? I need to know that license plate. Thank you so much.
disp_detail.9041215: We've been keeping it on the down-low lately, and this is no exception. Clear out all suspicious individuals around the Farm's Artificial Lake. I'm sending a team there for reasons you don't need to know about.
disp_detail.3041411: I got my hands on a few good movies lately, but I'm using a really old monitor. If you have a way, please help me get a few intact monitors.
disp_detail.1990003: How was the recent harvest? Youngster, business is getting harder and harder to conduct in this environment. My people are all out running errands for me, so I've come to you with a little task. Doss and I often do a little seafood business in the Valley. We make a little money of course. After all, we've got a big family to support. But there are those who choose to go against me for their own self-interest. Go to the Valley Port, destroy the messages they've left, and get rid of those parasites. I like well-behaved kids like you. You know, only people that follow the rules will last in this place. I'll make sure you profit from my business in Guoyapos, don't worry.
disp_detail.1010203: How have the past few days been? I've got plenty of medicine if you're hurt, so make sure to patch yourself up before heading out again. Of course, supplies won't always be this plentiful. I'm sure by now you've learned the importance of stocking up, so see what else you can find when you go out today.
disp_detail.4010174: The atmosphere in the Dark Zone has been really strange lately. It hasn't been this lively in a long time. That said, I think it could be even livelier, don't you? If you're planning to come lend a hand, better to call your teammates and bring a full set of throwables with you.
disp_detail.4010175: The atmosphere in the Dark Zone has been really strange lately. It hasn't been this lively in a long time. That said, I still think it's missing some heat. Hey, you must still have a lot of throwables, right? Throw them all together and I'm sure it'll have an incredible impact!
disp_detail.4010125: There's a problem with the supplies in the Dark Zone. The convoy that carries the food has been temporarily reassigned to the Farm Lockdown Zone. We can't fight on an empty stomach. Go take a look and bring some supplies back with you. We need them.
disp_detail.4010121: There's a problem with the supplies in the Dark Zone. The convoy that carries food has been temporarily reassigned to the Valley Lockdown Zone, but we can't fight on an empty stomach. Go take a look and bring some much-needed supplies back with you.
disp_detail.4010182: Some snack crates have appeared in the Dark Zone recently. I've heard that there are some special foods among them. You can try your luck in the Lockdown Zone if you're interested. Just know that you may not be the only one after those supplies.
disp_detail.4010196: Some mysterious drinks have appeared in the Dark Zone recently. It's not clear where they came from, but they're pretty popular with some of the operators, and they've been amassing at the Port to enjoy them. Find a good spot to join in from afar. Relax, as long as your aim is good, I'm sure they won't mind you interrupting.
disp_detail.4010183: Some beverage supplies have appeared in the Dark Zone recently. While no one knows where they came from, that's not really a problem for most folks. You can try your luck in the Lockdown Zone if you're interested. Just know that you may not be the only one after those supplies.
disp_detail.4010195: There's been a lot of food in the Dark Zone recently. Some guys have even been having a picnic in the Northridge Lockdown Zone. Sounds fun! You should be able to join in from a distance, if you know what I mean. I'm sure they won't say no... Or should I say, I'm sure you won't take no for an answer.
disp_detail.4011501: Recently, a batch of food and drink was shipped to the Dark Zone, and apparently some people are particularly interested in the shipment. I want you to go and see what's special about it.
disp_detail.3041423: Someone ordered a large quantity of toothpaste recently, but I'm out of stock. Please help me.
disp_detail.4010186: Supplies have been airdropped at the Farm Lockdown Zone. Apparently, there are some rare things inside, so a lot of operators are interested. If you are too, better to check it out with your teammates. You're probably going to run into other operators along the way, so buckle up for some action. If you can, take them out with a single shot.
disp_detail.4010173: Supplies have been airdropped at the Armory. Apparently, there are some rare things inside, so a lot of operators are interested. If you are too, better to check it out with your teammates first. If you find any air drops, don't let anyone else get close.
disp_detail.4010188: Supplies have been airdropped at the Northridge Lockdown Zone. Apparently, there are some rare things inside, so a lot of operators are interested. This is a great opportunity to teach those greedy operators a lesson if you can find the right position. By the way, remember to bring along your teammates.
disp_detail.4010187: Supplies have been airdropped in the Valley Lockdown Zone. Apparently, there are some rare things inside, so a lot of operators are interested. If you are too, better to check it out with your teammates. You're probably going to run into other operators along the way, so buckle up for some action and take out any obstacles that stand in your way.
disp_detail.1010101: Do you have a moment? I've got a commission for you. It's pretty simple: Eliminate two militants and deliver some weapons as evidence. So, want to earn a little extra pocket change?
disp_detail.4010519: Due to a recent shortage of instruments, prices have really taken off, and I've seen lots of people collecting them. As you're scouring for resources, pay attention to where instruments are being stored.
disp_detail.4010321: Due to a recent shortage of military supplies, prices have really taken off. I've seen lots of people collecting them, so while you're in Covert Ops, pay attention to where military supplies are being stored.

disp_detail.4010123: The recent shortage has intensified competition for supplies in the Dark Zone, with some operators fighting tooth and nail over scraps of food in the Grain Trade Center. I need your squad to teach those miscreants a lesson, if you catch my drift.
disp_detail.4011043: I have a customer who is in urgent need of a large amount of flammables. I don't know what he plans to do with all of it, but if you've got any extras, consider selling them to him for a good price.

disp_detail.5020422: A handful of locals have defected to my side, and have hidden some intel in a toolbox at Merchant's Wharf. Go fetch it for me.
disp_detail.5030319: Some bastards stole from me while I was panicking. Luckily, I managed to find some clues. Locate them and retrieve the stolen goods.

disp_detail.9041410: Good news: Talia has voluntarily ended her leave and returned to train with the Flag Squad. I knew Edelweiss wouldn't be defeated so easily. To prepare for upcoming operations, soldier, I need you to head to the Valley and see if any unidentified ships have been docking near the Port lately. The Blackgold forces at the Airport couldn't have appeared from nowhere, and the Valley Port is an excellent transit point. If we can determine their fleet size and docking frequency, we can roughly estimate the enemy's troops at the Airport.
disp_detail.5010315: My client lost a pair of glasses in the Small Hall. The last thing he remembers is placing it on a red oil drum. Please find it for him.

disp_detail.4010730: Some missions require you to fire quickly, and conflicts are hard to avoid. Installing a suppressor on your weapon can help you keep a low profile when a firefight breaks out, giving you a bit more peace of mind during operations.
disp_detail.9051416: Sometimes, information can be deadlier than a bullet. Make sure it ends up in our hands.
disp_detail.9051417: Sometimes, information can be deadlier than a bullet. Make sure it ends up in our hands.
disp_detail.4010343: Some recruits only know how to rush into the heat of battle. They're just like a bunch of moving targets—they only manage to get shot at. I mean, when you've got a carbine in hand, isn't the best strategy to flank the target or launch an attack from behind? Go show them how it's done.
disp_detail.4010727: Some recruits get scared in combat. In head-on confrontations, they hold their breath and hide behind cover. At times like that, shouldn't you just pop out and blast your enemy to smithereens with a powerful weapon like a USAS-12? Go set an example for them.
disp_detail.4010319: Some recruits get scared in combat. When faced with a head-on confrontation, they hold their breath and hide behind cover. I mean, why not just pop out and blast the enemy with a shotgun? Go show them how it's done.
disp_detail.9051105: I haven't seen you in a while, friend. Back then, Kamona was just a step away from achieving freedom again when the Northerners started meddling. Now, that goal looks as far away as ever. If only Renoir had... Let's just hope we find a crack in their alliance. These days, the Dark Zone is full of people waiting for the right price, and we will give them a price that they can't refuse! Take this and put it on the second floor of the Farm Stables. Someone will come and take it for sure.
disp_detail.1050105: I haven't seen you in a while, friend. We were just a step away from achieving peace here when Vladlen's gang started meddling, and now that goal looks as far away as ever. If only Renoir had... Let's just hope we find a crack in their alliance. These days, the Dark Zone is full of people waiting for the right price, and we will give them a price that they can't refuse! Take this and put it on the second floor of the Farm Stables. Someone will come and take it for sure.
disp_detail.4010224: Some Dark Zone bosses hang out near open areas, and that makes it easier to fire on them from afar. In situations like these, I recommend using a weapon with great effective range like a bolt-action sniper rifle. They might not have the highest rate of fire, but they're extremely powerful.
disp_detail.9261305: We've got word the pests are about to act, probably within the next few days. I'd bet anything these idiots have no idea why they were left behind. Scumbags are the same the world over—doesn't matter which cardinal direction they hail from. They're all useless puppets that don't know—and don't need to know—what's going on around them. Get ready, operators. The colonel's already ordered the Guard Corps to set up defenses. Now, we wait for the pests to leave their hive.
disp_detail.4010194: Some special resources have been found in the Farm Lockdown Zone, and a lot of operators have taken notice. When you and your teammates head there, you'll need to find a good location. That's the only way you'll show those greedy operators who the real hunter is.
disp_detail.4010193: Some special resources have been found in the Valley Lockdown Zone, and a lot of operators have taken notice. If you're interested, best to scope it out from a distance first. After all, it's not every day you get to hit your targets from that far away.
disp_detail.1010401: Someone asked me to bring back some chopper parts from the crash site. This should be an easy job for you. By the way, there should be plenty of valuable stuff down there, so don't come back empty-handed!
disp_detail.9011002: Someone asked me to bring back some chopper parts from the crash site. This should be an easy job for you. By the way, there should be plenty of valuable stuff down there, so don't come back empty-handed!
disp_detail.5010506: The last place he was seen on the day of the outbreak was the Recycling Station. I want you to retrace the path he took in there—enter through the yard, stay in the hut for a while, and then leave through the sewer.
disp_detail.3041418: Can someone help me? I don't know what's wrong with my circuit, but there's no power! Bring me some fuses. This thing must be broken!
disp_detail.5020314: Some militants are stopping people from leaving the Factory. Can you help make an opening so they can escape?
disp_detail.5020320: Some militants are stopping people from leaving the Factory. Can you help make an opening so they can escape?

disp_detail.9261307: A few pests managed to worm their way out, but it's irrelevant—their plan is officially dead in the water. Good work out there, operator. I'll mention you to the colonel. Oh yeah, the colonel also asked me to find someone to take gifts to the Antonio Family to thank them for all their help. Might as well be you, since you're here. Take this stuff to the Valley. I'll send a few people from the guard battalion to back you up.
disp_detail.1010201: A client wants to find someone to maintain order. It's very simple—just eliminate some militants, in any location you choose. Doesn't matter where or how, just bring back a chest rig. Why? Don't waste time with whys, just go!
disp_detail.4011401: Sometimes Tevila has some trivial matter to deal with, and while it may not have a great impact, we still hope that there'll be someone to deal with it.

disp_detail.9051205: It's been some time since the Valley received any attention. Sneak around the Villa and record Doss' activities. Find out if he has made any new friends.
disp_detail.9011401: Long time no see. A client has requested you by name for a commission: to investigate a certain... thing at the TV Station. They were extremely well-prepared—provided a detailed action plan and even a duty roster for the White Wolves inside. The plan is meticulous, the intel is comprehensive... On the surface, it's a very attractive offer, but there's no telling what you'll be getting into. The final decision is yours.
disp_detail.9041221: We received intel that the Abyss entered Northridge Hotel. Head over there and find out if this terrible news is true.
disp_detail.9241310: You've done me a massive solid, friend. About our last conversation... let's just say the stress got to my head. Made me lose control of myself for a minute there. Hope you'll keep that between us. Back to the matter at hand, that old fox found himself a group of veteran operators—they're helping him close the net on us. With their skills, it won't be long before we lose people. In the interest of secrecy, I think it's best for us to leave in groups, spread out and lie low. We'll keep in contact, so wait for word from me. As for you, friend, you stay with me. You'll be in charge of keeping me safe.
disp_detail.9241317: Friend, I can't believe you actually pulled this off! I thought you'd also be... Well, no time for that now. We've got to get to the Valley. I've got an experienced old captain there waiting with a skiff to ferry us up the coast and out of the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.1050003: You did very well last time. The Northridge Sewage Plant really is troublesome. I asked an expert to take a look at the Sewage Plant and the Canal, but he left his report at the Bus Terminal. Will you retrieve it for me? I'm in a bit of a hurry, so don't take too long!
disp_detail.9051408: You've done well, my friend. Doss has temporarily called off his attacks on the supply lines. Now, we must strike while the iron is hot. I need you to return to the Valley and pass a message on to the Northern Front, posing as an informant from Tevila. The message is as follows: Doss's family has not been strictly following orders and they recently withdrew personnel from the front, unilaterally halting the raids. Upon receiving this news, the Northern Front is bound to send investigators. Your mission is to lie in wait outside Doss's stronghold and ambush them. The aim is to sever their lines of communication and sow more distrust among them.
disp_detail.9401607: You made it, pal! Things are a mess here. Team Annihilation has allied with Blackgold, and there's more troops here than ants at a picnic! When the Warrant Officer said you were bringing reinforcements, I nearly shed a tear! I can hold the Control Tower, but I've got zero intel on the perimeter. I need you to sweep the area and see what kind of formation they're setting up. Don't get too close—just take a peek and then retreat.
disp_detail.9051401: My friend, I'm sure you know that the Southern Army just wants to take back their homeland, but they're being blocked at every turn by the Guard Corps. Those profit-driven hyenas have accepted aid from the Northern Front, and they've become an obstacle to peace in the Dark Zone. We can't just stand by and do nothing. I need you to cause some chaos at the Farm by sabotaging the guard battalion's supply lines and thereby support the Southern Army's offensive.
disp_detail.1050104: You should know that even though we're working with those in the North, I don't want to let them know how our investigation is going. Even family members have secrets that they hide from one another, you know what I'm saying? Ajax down at the Farm doesn't know this too well, but it's not the right time to deal with him yet. Keep an eye on the Motel. I need to know everything that goes down in Arbor.
disp_detail.9051103: You should know that even though we're working with those in the North, I don't want to let them know how our investigation is going. Even family members have secrets that they hide from one another, you know what I'm saying? Ajax down at the Farm doesn't know this too well, but it's not the right time to deal with him yet. Keep an eye on the Motel. I need to know everything that goes down in Arbor.
disp_detail.9051404: You're an excellent guide, my friend, just as I thought you'd be. Thanks to you, Viper has located the hideout of a Forest Man squad. We should be able to pry more information from them soon. Viper's work is still ongoing. Next, I want you to go to the Northridge area and set up a few sentry posts for Abyss to use in the future. Stay hidden. If anyone sees you, take them out immediately. Leave no loose ends.
disp_detail.9401602: We've got a problem, pal. Team Annihilation ambushed our military supply convoy on the way to Renoir. Not only did we take casualties ourselves, but the Guard Corps unit in charge of receiving the cargo took heavy losses, too. Renoir's furious, and he's getting ready to mobilize the Guard Corps to lock down the Armory. Problem is, we've still got some cargo stuck inside, so we need to get our act together before that lockdown goes into full effect. You slip in there and activate the coordinate locators, then create a ruckus so my guys can move the rest of the cargo out while the guards are distracted.
disp_detail.9401609: Something's off, pal. The Major General's plane diverted to Kamona Capital Airport half an hour ago, but they only notified us just now. That means he never planned to land here, but they hid that fact until the last moment. I tried to contact the Warrant Officer, but our comms don't work. Interference, cutting in and out... That's not normal. Could Team Annihilation be jamming our comms? I'll try the TV Station again and see if they can pass a message to the Warrant Officer.
disp_detail.9051107: We've been working together for a while. I feel like I can trust you now. You know about the explosion on the Farm, right? Someone from somewhere attacked the Sumek Committee's fleet that was transporting generators, blowing one up and taking the other. My people in Marulos haven't found anything yet, but that might be because they're attracting too much attention. Go down to the explosion site to investigate. Help me find out the truth.
disp_detail.1050106: We've been working together for a while. I feel like I can trust you now. You know about the explosion on the Farm, right? Someone from somewhere attacked the fleet that was transporting generators, blowing one up and taking the other. My people nearby haven't found anything yet, but that might be because they're attracting too much attention. Go down to the explosion site to investigate. Help me find out the truth.
disp_detail.9241309: Give me a hand, friend! I got separated from the rest of the squad—can't find a way out of here. The old fox has got eyes everywhere. He's even got people searching the forests. No way I'm wandering around out there alone. You know, in the beginning, they just had us doing little things. But the further we got into it, the worse things got... I didn't want to do any of this! If at the start, they'd just... Sorry, lost control there for a second. Help me, friend. Trust me, you'll be well rewarded once we find the rest of the squad!
disp_detail.4050105: Friend, I think we're all well aware that sometimes we must resort to unconventional measures to ensure peace in the region. There's a small problem in the Valley. Should be easy enough to take care of. As always, remember to keep a low profile.

disp_detail.1020104: My friend, I need to send someone into the Dark Zone to stir up some trouble. Bring some souvenirs back, like a piece of body armor that has taken a shot or two... to help remind me that the battlefield is a dangerous place.
disp_detail.1050601: Friend, my informant told me that Renoir went to Northridge with Ajax for some conference. Something is bound to go down if they're making such an obvious movement. Since Renoir isn't at home, why don't you go down to the Armory and do something for me? We've dealt with him before, but ever since his leader became the Dark Zone boss, he's been hard to read. Go down to the Armory and bring back information. I want to know what Renoir is up to in there. Got it?
disp_detail.9051110: Friend, I know that you've gotten pretty good deals for the previous tasks. I still have some missions for you. I need you to go to the Armory and conduct a detailed investigation of their movements. When this is done, you'll be rewarded handsomely. However, keep in mind that you shouldn't be asking unnecessary questions. This is all for your own good.
disp_detail.1050107: I caught wind that Renoir left the Armory for the Farm. I'm not sure what he's planning with Ajax, but it's definitely something we don't want. Go down to the Farm and find out what they're up to. Based on your intel from before, I think you should focus on the Villa rear gate and the Cliff Road exit. Those are the most suspicious places.
disp_detail.9051108: I caught wind that Renoir left the Armory for the Farm. I'm not sure what he's planning with Ajax, but it's definitely something we don't want. Go down to the Farm and find out what they're up to. Based on your intel from before, I think you should focus on the Villa rear gate and the Cliff Road exit. Those are the most suspicious places.
disp_detail.5040307: I need to go to the Repair Facility to collect some information. Why don't you head in first and clear the way for me, friend?
disp_detail.9241311: Well, seeing as you've made up your mind, friend, I guess it's time you know about our past. We're some of the lucky few that made it through the siege on the Armory. We managed to scrape our way out, but it came at the cost of many of our comrades' lives. After our squad was wiped out by the northern counterattack, we had no choice but to slip into the Dark Zone. Ended up working as militants for that old fox. We spent our days going through the motions, trying to forget everything that'd happened. Unfortunately, our tolerance was taken as weakness, and we were bullied just for being from the South. All up until those people came looking for us in the Valley, offering us support—and a chance to redeem our honor.
disp_detail.1050701: Buddy, I haven't contacted you for several days now. Do you remember the Northridge issue I asked for your help with? Before the Northridge Assault, the CDIS issued me with an order to transport some medical experts. The route for this mission was completely different to the previous one, so to play it safe, I contacted Blackgold and entrusted them with the mission. So, Randall took his guys to Northridge and the poor devil ran into some problems and nearly folded, and the group of medical experts disappeared too. Recently, the clues to the medical experts have been traced back to Guoyapos again. I've found out that Vladlen has actually planted informants in the Port too. I want to intercept their messages. That's your mission.
disp_detail.9051409: I have an important new job for you, friend. Not long ago, during an operation in Guoyapos, Kayla discovered an abandoned, medium-sized civilian Airport in the south. A brief investigation confirmed it's the Guoyapos International Airport. During the North-South Conflict, the Airport changed hands between the two sides, and its core area was militarized. After the Dark Zone was formed, both sides withdrew their troops, and the Airport was abandoned. Currently, local militants control the Airport. I need you all to head to the Valley, assemble, and await further orders.
disp_detail.9401608: Team Annihilation has infiltrated the Control Tower. Not many, but they've got skills, pal. They must be planning to take out our command center. The battle is raging at the Terminal, but I can't spare any of my squad, so I need you to go there and wipe them out—every last one of 'em. I've got to keep the landing strip secure until the Major General's plane lands, so once you clear that squad out, hurry over and bolster the White Wolves' defenses at the Control Tower.
disp_detail.5010309: There's a group of elite militants at the Stables getting in the way of my work. Go deal with them.

disp_detail.5010336: There's a militant at the Stables getting in the way of my work. Go deal with him.
disp_detail.5010510: There's an Elite mutant at the Stables. I recognize that face... He used to be in my squad. Go deal with him.
disp_detail.4010164: The activities of an unknown force have thrown the Valley into chaos. Now's your chance to rattle Doss' faction. Rally your squad, it's time to put him in his place.
disp_detail.9341402: This operation will have three phases: investigation, occupation, and control. The White Wolf Squad will be responsible for the main objectives, except for the investigation phase. As a special operation team, you and the rest of the Task Force will provide support throughout. The Flag Squad has some things to take care of at the TV Station and won't take part in the Airport operation at this time. They may join the battle later as the situation develops.
disp_detail.9431611: Our window of opportunity has opened. The company has obtained accurate intel: a Tevila Major General will arrive at Guoyapos Airport on a special flight early the day after tomorrow to oversee the cargo transport. We need to strike the Airport first and stop the flight from landing. Talia will be forced to dispatch the White Wolves for backup. To guarantee success on both fronts, we need more manpower. Expert, I need you to contact Blackgold and hire a group of top-tier fighters for combat the day after tomorrow. Soon, I'll give Talia a taste of what it's like to be betrayed by those closest to her.
disp_detail.9341502: The situation at the Airport is grim. The commander there was killed in an ambush while leading a support team out to reinforce the outer strongholds. The remaining forces have fallen back to their strongholds to dig in. Right now, aside from the control tower area, the defensive line at the outer strongholds is on the brink of collapse. Under the emergency protocol, I've dispatched an Emergency Squad to reinforce the Airport. Before they arrive, I need you to determine the identity, strength, and intentions of these hostiles.
disp_detail.9041409: The failure of the Airport operation has thrown our strategic deployment into disarray. High command is now divided on how to proceed. There are two main groups: The radicals want to commit more personnel to retaking the Airport, and the conservatives propose abandoning the Airport and establishing a new stronghold at the TV Station. The two sides are at a stalemate, so a decision is unlikely to come in the near future. In the meantime, HQ has granted all frontline units permission to act at their own discretion based on the situation on the battlefield.
disp_detail.9421507: The Airport is the starting point of this false trail. It was recently taken over by the White Wolf Squad. This period of chaotic transition is the perfect cover for all sorts of traces to "logically" appear. I'll leave the rest to you. Use your judgment and create as many convincing "traces" as you see fit.
disp_detail.9231202: Forest Man has caused us some trouble, but the real issue is the people behind him. We need to drag out every last one of them and make them pay. Comb through the junk they left behind—when you find something, bring it to me, personally. This should be right up your alley.
disp_detail.5020408: There's a situation at the Abandoned Shack. Go check it out.
disp_detail.9241306: Well, just as I expected, everyone's in much better spirits since we got to Northridge. We didn't run into any problems on our way out of the Farm, thanks to you. I suppose you're probably still interested in our past with the guard battalion. Tell you what—help me find someone, and I'll tell you everything. The person you're looking for is an old senior officer of ours, used to be an expert in the Southern Army. After the Dark Zone was formed, he holed up somewhere in Northridge instead of heading back south. Help me deliver this message to him.
disp_detail.9431610: As expected, Talia didn't suspect there was another nail near her, and it was thanks to that we were able to learn the details of their next plan. Pier 7 is the final chosen transport dock; Pier 5 is just a decoy. But right now, we still don't have a good solution for our disadvantage in numbers. I'll report back to Toland to see if they can create an opportunity to divide the White Wolves' forces in Guoyapos.
disp_detail.3000516: One day, a newspaper agency received a pile of photos along with a cassette tape. From the recording, they identified the voice of their most confident—even arrogant—reporter. Rumors of troubling events had been spreading about the Valley, and sensing a major scoop, the reporter went there alone to investigate. This section is narrated in the third person by someone at the agency, recounting the reporter's past achievements, personality, and disappearance after venturing into the Valley.
disp_detail.3000527: One day, a newspaper agency received a pile of photos along with a cassette tape. From the recording, they identified the voice of their most confident—even arrogant—reporter. Rumors of troubling events had been spreading about the Valley, and sensing a major scoop, the reporter went there alone to investigate. This section is narrated in the third person by someone at the agency, recounting the reporter's past achievements, personality, and disappearance after venturing into the Valley.
disp_detail.3000511: One day, a family received the travel diary of their missing daughter. The diary recorded her journey, with the first entry describing her trip to Floranpino.
disp_detail.3000523: One day, a family received the travel diary of their missing daughter. The diary recorded her journey, with the first entry describing her trip to Floranpino.
disp_detail.9041606: Found it. A group did enter Kamona recently—guys with serious military backgrounds, mostly Colom or Ocean Alliance special ops. After arriving in Kamona, they quickly left the capital and went off-grid. I have reason to believe these guys make up most of Team Annihilation in Northridge. So we can pretty much confirm that Team Annihilation has a new commander, but I haven't uncovered who that is yet. One thing troubles me, though: these guys seem to know the White Wolves' conventional tactics inside out. I've got a bad feeling about this.
disp_detail.9341504: Based on the intel you provided, we discovered enemy signal relay devices in three key locations in the TV Station. It's clear that our comms channels have been monitored for a long time. After we removed the devices and completed a full internal security sweep, the enemy assault slowed down. The pressure on our front lines has eased significantly.
disp_detail.9231402: According to Obol's assessment of the intel you acquired, the Airport's military infrastructure is much more developed than expected. This is extremely advantageous for us. Once we clear out the militants holed up here, we can fortify the Airport more efficiently and cheaply. Once the fortification is complete, the Northern Front won't be able to spare enough troops to take it back, even if they notice. The Airport will become a strategic point between Marulos and Guoyapos, deterring the three factions in those regions. The Blackgold squad will hold the defensive positions. You are to continue scouting other areas with your team, operator.
disp_detail.5020315: According to our intel, a militant was spotted near the canyon. Subdue him at all costs. I need his radio!
disp_detail.5020321: According to our intel, a militant was spotted near the canyon. Subdue him at all costs. I need his radio!
disp_detail.5020327: According to our intel, a militant was spotted near the canyon. Subdue him at all costs. I need his radio!
disp_detail.9261304: From what our investigations turned up, we can say pretty confidently that the explosives have been moved out of Northridge through the Cable Car Station. We're not sure if the radio station you destroyed had anything to do with the Southerners, and we can't really waste any more time in Northridge finding out. I'm not putting my hopes in us being able to find the explosives before there's some kind of incident. To be honest, I'd rather just deal with the problem at its root. From what I've learned about these southern pests, their target is bound to be either me or our esteemed colonel, so we're going to shore up our defenses against a possible ambush.
disp_detail.9020206: Gresk's wolf cubs are powerful indeed, and Randall's Blackgold squad have failed to get the upper hand. Ajax has been putting a lot of pressure on them too. The Armory isn't too far away from the Farm, and things aren't going to be looking good if this stalemate continues. I need you to cut off Ajax's support and assist Randall's team in battle, but make sure the White Wolf Squad don't take any hostages.
disp_detail.9041408: The information from the Valley turned out to be false—a plot by the Westerners to sow discord. The intel team is tracking down the source in search of the leak. Doss is using this as an opportunity to pressure us for his own gain. A local thug thinks he's going to negotiate with us? These upstarts in the Dark Zone think they have power and strength, but they have no idea who laid the very foundation they're standing on. For the sake of Tevila's interests, we can support our collaborators—and for those same interests, we can also destroy them.
disp_detail.5070301: The White Wolf Squad experienced a partial communications blackout during their mission at the Airport. Your task is to locate and reboot the malfunctioning comms device to restore data transmission.
disp_detail.4010305: Weapons are the best way to guarantee your survival in the Dark Zone, so the more the merrier. Generally speaking, however, weapons are few and far between. You will often need to "borrow" them from militants and other operators. You know what I'm talking about.
disp_detail.4060105: People getting their hands on weapons creates instability. My employer isn't a fan of that. Go to the Valley, eliminate the enemies there, and seize their weapons. After that, you can consider the job done. My people will take care of the rest.

disp_detail.4010118: Every weapon has an advantage in a certain combat environment. The Northridge Lockdown Zone has a lot of places where a marksman rifle will yield excellent results. As a sniper, finding and using these locations effectively is an essential skill.
disp_detail.4010166: Every weapon has an advantage in a particular combat environment. For bolt-action rifles, it's important to find a safe location to snipe from. Fortunately, the Valley has a lot of places where a bolt-action rifle will yield excellent results. As a sniper, identifying these locations and using them effectively is an essential skill.

Fortunately, the Valley has a lot of places where a bolt-action rifle will yield excellent results. As a sniper, identifying these locations and using them effectively is an essential skill.
disp_detail.4010717: Every weapon has a terrain it's best suited for, and the Valley has a lot of places for a marksman rifle to shine. Equip a scope and find a suitable terrain, then wait for your prey to take the bait.
disp_detail.9041119: The Westerners are definitely using the evacuation as cover to hide something, but our superior does not approve of this opinion. They've let slip some traces, but I need more proof to support my opinion, and that's where you come in.
disp_detail.5010317: Enemies have amassed in the south of the Motel. Go bring a little law and order, and restore peace to the area.
disp_detail.5010323: Enemies have amassed in the south of the Motel. Go bring a little law and order, and restore peace to the area.

disp_detail.5010311: Enemies have amassed at the Motel. Go bring a little law and order, and restore peace to the area.
disp_detail.4010747: Not just anyone can handle a Desert Eagle. Compared with other pistols, there's a big trade-off in terms of flexibility, but when it comes to damage, there's no comparison. So long as you have the skill to tame this beast, it'll be a nightmare to all your enemies.
disp_detail.9041112: I didn't expect the Southerners to attack! The White Wolves were ambushed by an unknown squad of elites during their investigation and were forced to evacuate to the Farm's perimeter. Retrieve intel from the Farm at once. I need that intel as soon as possible.
disp_detail.9341607: I never thought it could be him... No wonder the intel leaks were so accurate! Anyway, this thread has come to its end, and Maxim will handle the traitor. With that threat eliminated, we can focus on the transport plan again. Piers 5 and 7 are the most logical loading points, so I've sent an elite squad of White Wolves to scout the area for security. I wouldn't think Team Annihilation would go so far, but just to be on the safe side, I want to set up Pier 5 as a decoy. I need you to gather some reliable operators from the Dark Zone, and when the time is right, they'll disguise themselves as White Wolves and guard Pier 5.
disp_detail.1040109: I didn't expect so many bosses to come, but in any case, whoever is supporting them didn't show up. Fred is the weakest of the bunch. The meeting is at the Northridge Hotel, that much we can guess. Most important are Renoir and Doss. Nothing good can come of those two being in the same place. It's dangerous, but you've got to infiltrate the hotel and find out what's going on.
disp_detail.9041109: I didn't expect so many bosses to come, but in any case, whoever was supporting them didn't show up. Fred is the weakest of the bunch. The meeting is at the Northridge Hotel, that much we can guess. What's most important are Renoir and Doss. Nothing good can come of those two being in the same place. It's dangerous, but you've got to infiltrate the hotel and find out what's going on.
disp_detail.9281210: Whoever's behind all of this, they almost tricked me too. The scientists are just a cover for what's truly important. Indeed, the "portal" is at the TV Station. I'm very sure of it.
disp_detail.1020712: I didn't expect to find anything useful. This is a miracle! From the torn papers, we now know that they moved the scientists through the rear gate. If we look for their extraction route, we might find something.
disp_detail.9261308: Can't believe all the happy little coincidences lately! Remember those southern pests that got away from us? The family just informed me they slipped into the Valley. The idiots apparently hired some smuggler to ferry them out of the Dark Zone, but the greedy coward sold them out the moment he heard the guard battalion had arrived in the Valley. Seeing as we know where they are now, take a team and squash those pests. Let's put an end to this farce.
disp_detail.9281207: I didn't expect it to be connected to Northridge Hotel. Those scientists are up to something again, aren't they? I need you to scout out the area, just to be safe.
disp_detail.9411506: I never thought we'd meet here. Oh, I don't mean you. I'm referring to an old acquaintance... or rather, an enemy with whom I share a tangled history. I need you to do me a favor. Take this symbol and place it at the main entrance of the TV Station. It's a declaration from the Crows, a sign heralding the Raven's homecoming.
disp_detail.9020105: There's no time to waste! We must deal with these wolf cubs quickly. Once they've cleared the ruins outside, my guys are gonna be faced with an attack from both sides. You should be very familiar with the situation at the TV Station by now, so head up to the second floor and weed out those cubs, then help my team complete their mission as quickly as possible.
disp_detail.1050803: There's no time for nonsense. The Northridge Hotel has been attacked and the situation is critical. Due to safety concerns, the escort convoy has had to extract in a different direction. They were going to leave from the back door of the Hotel and head out of the Northridge area to the southeast toward the Onotos Mountains. The plan is complete, but I've got a bad feeling about it. An attack on the Northridge Hotel at that moment was probably aimed at the convoy. Remember, prioritize protecting the convoy and hurry up and join Randall!
disp_detail.5020406: Make sure that you eliminate both of Porrero's men quickly. Don't give them a chance to fire back.
disp_detail.5020306: Pay attention. Your mission is to bring supplies back from the Village. The client didn't just come to us, so you have competition. If you want the reward, you'll have to move fast.
disp_detail.3000505: Eliminate all bosses in Boss Rally during the event.
disp_detail.3000504: Eliminate Renoir once in Boss Rally during the event.
disp_detail.3000502: Eliminate bosses in Boss Rally during the event.
disp_detail.3000501: Eliminate a cumulative number of bosses throughout the event.
disp_detail.3000503: Trigger a Boss Rally once during the event.
disp_detail.4010233: Suppressors are good at reducing the sound of gunfire, which makes it harder for your enemies to detect you. In areas with complex terrain like the Valley, suppressing your weapon allows you to hide your position, giving you an advantage in combat.
disp_detail.4010315: Suppressors are good at reducing the sound of gunfire, which makes it harder for your enemies to detect you. If you like fighting alone, I strongly recommend using one. You will be stealthier in combat, increasing your chances of extracting successfully.
disp_detail.9051411: Abyss has received new orders, so you'll have to split up for now. I need you to head to the Farm, friend. One of my old informants from the Southern Army has reported some disturbing information. His trail has been detected again. Given his past... this is not a good sign.
disp_detail.9421504: The chaos has drawn the guard battalion's attention. Things are developing exactly as we intended. Now, head to the Armory and add the next chapter to our "story." I need you to go deep into the Armory and plant new traces that align with the logic of our earlier actions. Keep the enemy's focus firmly fixed on this false trail.
disp_detail.9341407: This morning, a Blackgold squad approached the east side of the Fuel Storage and walked right into our ambush. They were routed by our White Wolf Squad holding the eastern position and they fled south. The White Wolves then sent a scout team to track them, but they suffered a counterattack and had to fall back to the Freight Center and request aid. I suspect this is a trap from Blackgold, so I've temporarily denied the White Wolves captain's request for backup. I need you to lead a team of elites, go to the Freight Center at once, and assess the situation.
disp_detail.4010434: The militants have been entrenched in Northridge for a while now, and have stocked up on military supplies that they've looted from different places. I'm sure you can find a lot of useful stuff there. When you head that way, remember to look around. If you find any military supplies, bring them back with you.
disp_detail.4010829: The abundance of supplies at Northridge has attracted a bunch of greedy fellas. If you want those resources, you're gonna have to get your hands dirty.
disp_detail.9020204: The folks from Tevila have left the Valley, and my sources are telling me that Doss and Tevila have reached a deal. That idiot Doss has broken his promise. We'll settle our score with him, but there are more pressing matters to deal with right now. Porrero has led a convoy to the Farm. The windows of the vehicles were all blacked out. Seems like the convoy had something to hide. I think what I want you to find is the convoy. Go to the Farm immediately to investigate any traces left behind by Porrero's convoy, then find out where they ended up.
disp_detail.4011301: Tevila will always find itself in some kind of trouble, and our friends who help us solve these troubles will also be appropriately compensated.

disp_detail.9020107: Operator, the wolf cubs launched a strong breakout, but my people blocked them at all costs. After they launched a few more assaults, my team determined they weren't really trying to make a breakout, but more likely searching for something in the blocked off areas. I reckon that violent breakout before was to bring out something important. That potentially important thing was dropped in a corridor on the second floor. I've had some of the Blackgold guys go and look for it several times, but they were all held back by the opposition's heavy fire. I need you to help me find that area and see if you can find anything valuable there. Then, use the computer outside the Manager's Office to upload the information. But be careful, you'll be within sight of those wolf cubs and they're extremely dangerous.
disp_detail.9020201: Operator, do you remember that group of medical experts from the Sumek Committee that were stationed in Northridge before the Northridge Assault? Yesterday, I intercepted a piece of secret intelligence from Guoyapos, which stated that these medical experts are linked to the incident there. Since the Northridge Hotel was attacked, the whereabouts of the medical experts has been unknown. I'm very interested in these missing experts, so I want you to go to Northridge and collect some clues for me.
disp_detail.9020202: Operator, according to some reliable information from my people, these medical experts have been transferred to Floranpino, which is Doss' territory. Recently, my spy in the Valley discovered some of our friends from Tevila near there. I want you to go to the Valley to investigate. I want to know who these people from Tevila are.
disp_detail.9020207: Operator, the wolf cubs are preparing to retreat following their fierce fight with us at the Farm, and I'm guessing our target has fallen into their hands. I've ordered Randall's squad to immediately guard the boundary of the Farm to prevent the wolf cubs from getting out. According to a map of the Farm, there's a hidden path nearby, which they might use to get people out. I need you to go over there and handle any wolf cubs that might appear, and if you happen to spot the target, bring him back alive.
disp_detail.9341601: Operator, good work on that last operation. You secured those key supplies and made Team Annihilation eat dirt! With your connections in the Dark Zone, you've probably already guessed how hot this "cargo" is. Thanks for the assist. We recently got orders to safely transport this cargo back to Tevila territory. I doubt Team Annihilation will let this go, so it's only going to get more dangerous from here. I need you on standby—expect a new commission soon.
disp_detail.9341405: Operator, an unexpected situation has come up! The White Wolf Squad was attacked by unidentified hostiles while investigating the Outdoor Exhibition Area. The enemy was well-equipped and highly skilled—definitely not the militants who took over the Airport. I need you to get to the battlefield ASAP, provide reinforcement, cover the White Wolf Squad's retreat, and identify the enemy and their gear.
disp_detail.9341413: Operator, thank you for accompanying me to the Valley. That trip reminded me of Yuri, and of my mission. I am Edelweiss, captain of the Flag Squad. I must carry this flag and be an example to those who follow me. In this operation, we will infiltrate the Airport from the northeast side, where we've discovered an old maintenance passage. Blackgold has focused its northern defenses on the Fuel Storage, leaving this path unguarded. We will exploit this deadly oversight and deal them a devastating blow from behind.
disp_detail.9341613: I've received word from the TV Station that the Airport fight is cooling down, but it seems too early to me. Team Annihilation would never back down so easily, so they must be up to something. I hope it's just my imagination, but to be on the safe side, I need you to head to Pier 7 now and prepare to provide backup around the perimeter. I hope we won't need you, but get there as fast as you can anyway.
disp_detail.9341508: Operator, I need you to work with the White Wolf Squad to intercept the Apostle Squad's retreat. Slow them down and buy more time for Maxim's next move.
disp_detail.9341503: Operator, the enemy has taken advantage of a gap in the TV Station's defenses to launch a fierce attack. The squad of White Wolves holding the perimeter has taken heavy casualties. I strongly suspect the enemy already knows the layout of our internal defenses. I'm adjusting our deployments now, but I need you to sweep all suspicious areas inside the TV Station and locate any unusual signal sources or communication devices.
disp_detail.9011501: Operator, there have been some strange rumors about the Valley circulating in the Dark Zone recently, saying that things have changed there. It probably isn't a big deal, but if you're in the area, you should check it out and see what's really going on.
disp_detail.9341614: I've gotta be straight with you, Operator. Before departing, Vladlen verified the cargo contents—and it's anything but conventional weaponry. It contains original samples and the "results" of human experiments Toland conducted at the TV Station. I didn't want to tell you so soon, but since you're already headed for Pier 7, you need to know what's at stake. If this cargo falls into the hands of Team Annihilation, Tevila's international standing will be highly compromised. Toland certainly wants the cargo back, too—because if the data goes public, their experiments in Kamona will be exposed. It seems that Vladlen and I both misjudged the importance of this cargo from the very start. And now... we've got to face the consequences.
disp_detail.9341501: Operator, we just received a transmission from the Airport. A group of unidentified hostiles has attacked our outer strongholds. Communications with the outer strongholds have been completely cut off, and we don't know the extent of our losses. Your mission is to head to the Airport immediately, assess the situation, and try to restore the White Wolf Squad's comms channel there.
disp_detail.9341612: Operator, you're doing well at the Airport. The convoy is ready, and I'll personally lead the Flag Squad to escort the cargo. The timing of the Airport attack was unusual, so as a precaution, I've deployed some empty vehicles to act as decoys within the convoy. Keep supporting Maxim at the Airport and await my orders.
disp_detail.9341611: I've reviewed the combat reports from the Airport, and you did well, Operator. However, the enemy commander seems very familiar with the tactics of the White Wolves, as Team Annihilation didn't operate as they usually do. Maybe I'm overthinking it, but our enemy might not even be the Apostles anymore. In any case, the convoy can't wait any longer. The transport fleet docks at dawn, and I've got to escort the cargo myself, so I'm leaving the Airport in your and Maxim's hands in the meantime. Contact me ASAP if the situation changes. I'll keep Vladlen up to date with my intel.
disp_detail.9341610: Change of plans, Operator. Something's gone wrong, and the Airport is under attack. The Team Annihilation forces are much larger than we expected, and Blackgold is involved as well. They're likely targeting the North Terminal, so let's scrap the decoy plan. I need you to hurry and lead your operators to rendezvous with my team of White Wolves. Once you've linked up, race to the Airport and support Maxim. We absolutely must hold the Control Tower and the Terminal. If we lose either one, the entire transport plan is kaput. This will be a tough fight, but I promise the pay will make it worth your while. I'm counting on you.
disp_detail.9341401: Operator, this mission's destination is Guoyapos Airport, south of the TV Station. It was once Guoyapos's largest civilian airport and the cornerstone of the region's tourism industry. During the early days of the North-South Conflict, the Airport was used to evacuate visitors from abroad. After the Dark Zone was formed, local militants took it over. With the Southern Army crossing the ceasefire line, the White Wolf Squad is in dire need of a frontline operating base, and the abandoned Guoyapos Airport is an excellent choice.
disp_detail.9061601: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9061602: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9061603: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9061604: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9061605: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9061606: Operator, Blackgold Universal has a clear strategic deployment in the Hostile Sector. I need you to go in and investigate the situation.
disp_detail.9341410: Quick, operator, report on the enemy's firing positions you discovered while breaking out of the last encirclement. Maxim, do a head count of all the combatants at the base and make formations in accordance with the rescue plan. The plan is unchanged: I'll lead the Flag Squad and break through somewhere in the northern encirclement to secure an escape route for you. Maxim will guide you in repelling the enemy outside the Freight Center and rescuing our brothers who are holding the line! Go all out!
disp_detail.9261301: Hey, operators. I'm Ajax. Colonel's put me in charge of the mission you accepted. Here's hoping you're just as capable as you said you were in your resumes. Rats from the South have holed up throughout the Dark Zone, hoping to weather the storm that's coming for them. Unfortunately for them, they've underestimated Vinson's web of spies. Worse yet, they've underestimated the Guard Corps' determination. Our objective is to root out those scumbags' hidden Stronghold at the Farm. Your job is to support the guard battalion in achieving that goal.
disp_detail.9291201: Operator, I need your eyes on this. Intel states the Barn at S. Wheatfield in the Farm has been converted into a temporary fortification. I need you to prove it's a trick set up by the Northern Front or a dereliction of duty by our intelligence officers.
disp_detail.9341411: Extract, operator... You've all done your best. The mission was a failure. We don't have the numbers to continue, and the wounded need to be escorted. We have completely failed to take the Airport. As the one in charge of this operation, I take full responsibility. A soldier's job is to obey orders, but there will be some who defy the command and fight for what they believe is right... It may be him, or me. We will never forget the price we paid today.
disp_detail.9341412: Have you had free time lately, operator? Vladlen gave me a few days off... I wanted to ask if you'd like to visit the Valley with me. The Flag Squad has a long history. We used to be under official Tevilan command, but now we're part of the White Wolves. The Flag Squad fought in Kamona during the North-South Conflict. Our captain back then led us on an impossible mission. We helped end the Conflict and became heroes, but the true hero never came back—he's buried forever in the south somewhere. Thanks for coming with me. As for what's next... I still need some time.
disp_detail.5070302: Operator, someone's repeatedly calling on the Airport's public channel. Something feels off. It's up to you whether we patch them in or not.
disp_detail.9231401: Welcome to Guoyapos, operator. We've met before, so let's skip the pleasantries. Our mission is clear: Seize control of the network in the Airport and fortify the core area's defenses before the White Wolves realize what's happening. Our temporary stronghold is in the residential block west of the Airport; we recently discovered a secret passage there leading to the Airport's southwest corner. A Blackgold squad has already moved through and is setting up defenses at the exit. I need you to lead a team of operators and scout the southern area of the Airport.
disp_detail.4010207: Snipers should always cover their tracks, keep their distance from the target, and strike first from far away. Even if your target fights back, it will be hard for them to land a hit on you. But talk is cheap. You'll learn this better from experiencing it in action.
disp_detail.9411517: Wolf cubs have appeared at the Armory and are surrounding the support squad we previously deployed. I need you to create enough chaos elsewhere to draw off the White Wolves' forces. As for the Armory itself... I will personally lead a squad to carve out an escape route for the Crows.
disp_detail.9231407: We've got the wolf cubs trapped in the Warehouse. It's only a matter of time before we take them down. But time is exactly what we don't have—the alpha almost definitely knows what's happening here. Reinforcements are surely on their way, and before they arrive, the remaining forces will likely dig in and defend their position. My order to you is to lead an elite squad, approach the Fuel Storage area under the cover of night, and scout out their stronghold. The moment you confirm the White Wolves reinforcements have arrived, you're to disengage immediately, return to base, and report.
disp_detail.9411513: The wolf cubs have left the den, attempting to retake the outer strongholds. Give them no quarter—break them completely. This isn't a fair fight; it is pure, unadulterated vengeance. Their alpha will surely learn of what happens here, and it will drive her to make a fatal miscalculation.
disp_detail.9411523: The wolf cubs attacked the stronghold. They've taken the "cargo." Intercepted intel shows they're transporting it to the TV Station. I can sense a trap—this mission will be extremely dangerous. But the orders are clear: no matter the cost, we must stop this transport. I hope you'll join the Crows for one more journey.
disp_detail.9411524: The Wolves are attempting to coordinate with the guard battalion to pick off the Crows. But how strong can the guard battalion be outside the safety of their Armory? I'll leave this area to you. I'll dispatch a squad to help you hold off a pincer attack from the flanks. As for me, I'll personally lead the Crows and tear this net apart from the front.
disp_detail.9411505: The Wolves have built a fortified den inside the TV Station. The Crows have launched several assaults, but have been unable to breach their defenses. I need an elite operative like you to infiltrate their position and find out the details of their defensive layout. Additionally, there's something off about the identity of their "alpha"—she gives me an inexplicable sense of familiarity. You are to investigate this as part of the mission.
disp_detail.9411515: The Wolves executed their tactics better than I expected and weathered the worst of it. Now, the Crows need to pull back temporarily and gather strength for the next hunt. Your mission is to recall the assault squads in the TV Station and Airport areas. Have them regroup on the perimeter and await orders.
disp_detail.9051116: A large part of the Farm is under our control, and we shall bring peace and stability to the people here. Recently, the locals have been acting up. In my opinion, if they can't use the eyes they were born with, they should just stop breathing too.
disp_detail.9021007: The problem now is, where did the truck carrying my father actually go? The schedule at the Grain Trade Center only shows what time delivery trucks should leave, but more investigation is required if we want to learn where they go.
disp_detail.9231210: It seems the Valley is secure for now, but I'm still uneasy about the situation in the north. I need you to make sure it's secure enough for my squad to slip in.
disp_detail.9411504: This phase of the cleanup is complete. The results align with expectations, and no unexpected incidents occurred. You've once again proven your capabilities. That said, the appetizers are over—the main course is about to be served. If you choose to continue working with us, the company will reward you accordingly. And I, for one, would be happy to share a few more "stories" with you.
disp_detail.9051414: The White Wolves have taken control of the TV tower in Guoyapos, and Derwin has locked down the Port. My team ran into a lot of resistance while investigating the north, so to avoid unnecessary losses, I've suspended their mission in Guoyapos. Friend, I know you have a way into the TV Station. I'm asking you to infiltrate it, take over the investigation, and find out what Team Annihilation was up to in there.
disp_detail.9010101: The TV Station was an overseas stronghold in the early years, but after the Sumek Crisis broke out, our team had to withdraw and the stronghold was abandoned. Not long ago, I sent a team into the TV Station to investigate what was going on, but now my contact with the team has been cut off. According to the intel from Vladlen's informant, it's a team from Blackgold that are blocking all comms from the TV Station. I need someone to go into the TV Station for me, investigate what's going on inside, and then bring that information back to me.
disp_detail.3000507: The man found a few more items, including a travel map, which he packaged and sent to the woman. In her reply, the woman explains that her husband had been carrying this postcard before he disappeared. He was supposed to go to the Valley on business but never returned. She hopes the man can search for more clues and also try to find the man in the photograph.
disp_detail.3000521: The man found a few more items, including a travel map, which he packaged and sent to the woman. In her reply, the woman explains that her husband had been carrying this postcard before he disappeared. He was supposed to go to the Valley on business but never returned. She hopes the man can search for more clues and also try to find the man in the photograph.
disp_detail.3000508: The man replies that he has found the man from the photograph—in a mirror. It turns out he is the woman's husband. Though he doesn't know why he lost his memory for several months, he has now awakened somewhere in the Valley and is gradually recalling parts of his past with the woman and his own identity. In the end, he says he hopes the woman will come to the Valley and take him away.
disp_detail.9020106: The White Wolves have been guarding that door on the second floor. You'll have seen just how determined they are. My team were close to breaking through their defenses, but fell short. However, we did find out what's behind the door: an elevator. This morning, my people intercepted some of their communications, and I'm guessing that their main force has reached the Basement of the TV Station using this elevator. I wouldn't be surprised if that's the source of all this secrecy. I need you to get rid of the enemies in the corridor, then let me know when you get to the elevator door. My team will take over the elevator area once the crisis has lifted, catching the easy prey trapped inside, and find out what secrets lie beneath the TV Station.
disp_detail.9411607: The White Wolves have gathered a squad of operators just as skilled as you to clear out our strongholds in Floranpino. Our tactical objectives have been achieved, so the Crows don't need to waste time here. Soldier, I need you to lead your squad to place some "smoke grenades" in the Valley. The Crows will slowly withdraw from Floranpino, and once your mission is complete, I'll see you in Guoyapos.
disp_detail.9010105: The people from the White Wolf Squad told me that Colom hired that group of militants who fumbled their way through the ruins at the entrance and appeared on the front line of the battlefield, putting extra pressure on them. I don't want these guys hindering my plan, so I need someone to get to the TV Station as quickly as possible and get rid of them. I have confidence in your abilities, so I'm trusting you with this mission, soldier.
disp_detail.9010107: The White Wolf Squad's vanguard found some clues earlier in the Basement, which are crucial for my investigation into the TV Station. I know you're doubtful, but to tell the truth, the Basement under the TV Station is no normal basement. My people found a load of lab equipment there, and many of the clues point towards the Toland Group. However the person delivering the clues to me was attacked and hid them in a document box on the second floor. Once you find them, upload them for me using the computer in the Recording Studio. Time's running out, get going!
disp_detail.9020104: Those cubs from the White Wolf Squad found a group of operators sneaking into the TV Station and attacked my guys. We cannot let them sabotage this operation! The backup I arranged is already on the way, but they still need some time, and the Blackgold team in there might not be able to wait that long. I didn't really want to entrust such an important mission to an operator I've only just met, but I don't have time to wait. I hope you won't let me down, operator. Get into the TV Station and get rid of those tough guys lurking behind the scenes.
disp_detail.4040105: The troublemakers entrenched in the Valley are getting more ambitious by the day. They're starting to make it difficult for my people to complete their missions. I need you to clear out the threat there, and show everyone that there are certain lines you do not cross. If you need to, take some teammates along.

disp_detail.1020708: It appears a pitched battle just took place in Building A of the Northridge Hotel. Could you go check it out? Pay special attention to the clothes and containers. I want to know who did this. I have no idea where my father went, and this is the only way I'm going to find out.
disp_detail.9031214: It seems that the war is entering a new state of balance, and everyone's attention is focused on the Farm. We now have an opportunity to seize at a place that was previously too dangerous. Just take a look at the current state of the TV Station.
disp_detail.9431604: It seems money has a far greater influence on that friend than loyalty to their country. With this intel, Talia won't be able to prepare her transport plan in peace. Expert, a highly skilled Task Force is about to arrive at the Airport. I need you to seize the opportunity and slow them down. Do your best—I want to see who has the better eye for talent, Talia or me.
disp_detail.1020714: Looks like the vehicle that transported them didn't stop here for no reason. They switched cars and disposed of evidence before leaving Northridge. They might have erased the whiteboard, but you can still see the word "Valley" on it. My squad is already down there, but I'll need you to take these communication devices to them. That way I can stay in contact with them.

That way I can stay in contact with them.
disp_detail.9051113: It doesn't seem like they've come to their senses. They seek to destroy this hard-earned peace and rule over the Farm again. I don't want that to happen, and I think neither do you. So, let's strike before they act.
disp_detail.4011640: We've got a sticky situation here, and I hope you can resolve it.

disp_detail.4010203: You only pull the trigger when you have a clear shot at your target's weak points... I thought everybody knew that! Ah, forget it. Show the recruits how it's done!
disp_detail.4010211: Using the scope is a lot more accurate than the iron sight, but I've come across really good marksmen who just use the latter. If you have a scope, don't be too proud to use it. The advantage may change the tide of the battle.
disp_detail.9041217: There are always some dubious people hiding in the villages in the Mine and Northridge. Go and get rid of them as soon as you can.
disp_detail.9231207: The raid on the Mine was a success, but there's still some unfinished business. Some of them escaped to Northridge and disappeared into the woods. That's why I need you to go there and take a look. Any traces or related intel you can bring back will be crucial to the success of my squad's next move.
disp_detail.9031211: The plan was going smoothly at the Mine, at least until that incident occurred. I need your help cleaning up and keeping any adverse effects from spreading throughout the Dark Zone.
disp_detail.9020205: It's been confirmed that the target has been transferred to the Farm. My team has arrived at the edge of the Farm and is ready to take action. The target can't fall into Tevila's hands this time. I need you to get prepared at the Farm. Operator, I trust your professionalism, but just to be on the safe side, I'll remind you anyway. You have no way of getting out of this situation. There's only one way you can go, so don't be a fool about it.
disp_detail.9031210: The gifts are almost ready. To ensure that everyone here is satisfied, we need to make sure that everything is perfect. You should be familiar with the TV Station, but I don't know if it's safe there.
disp_detail.4011516: Colom will provide you with considerable financial support and looks forward to your assistance in handling the tricky tasks that lie ahead.

disp_detail.9010206: Of course, Colom showed up in the end and were the biggest resistance to our operation at the Farm. According to our intel, there's a team commanded by Randall from Blackgold Universal, and this squad of Blackgold's elite is planning on getting in the way of our deal. I need you to join the battle immediately, destroy the Blackgold squad's formation, and take some of the pressure off the White Wolf Squad's ambush operation.
disp_detail.9010106: Colom's people continue to apply pressure and the White Wolves on the second floor are really feeling it—their defense is on the brink of collapse. Fortunately, the underground team has already started to retreat, and they're ready to break through. But they still need time and more preparations. In order for them to escape unscathed, I'm gonna need to do something here. I need your help to clear the area guarded by Blackgold on the second floor, and clear any obstructions along the extraction route.

disp_detail.4010710: Assault rifles have a good rate of fire and effective range. When you have a range advantage, keeping a distance while you fight is undoubtedly the smarter choice.
disp_detail.4010237: The assault rifle is a weapon with a wide range of applications. With the proper mods, it can be used in almost any combat environment. Fights at the Farm will take place at mid to close range, so a large magazine and a normal scope should be enough for any situation.
disp_detail.4010332: The assault rifle is a great all-around weapon suited for almost any environment once properly modified. However, if you want to unleash its full potential, you need to be familiar with how to use it in different situations. You won't get by just running in and firing.
disp_detail.9231406: Urgent update! A White Wolf Squad just broke our encirclement and is trying to meet up with the main force we lured out of the stronghold! If they succeed, this whole operation will have been a failure! You have to close that gap, operator! I don't care how you do it—intercept them before they join up at all costs!
disp_detail.5020420: Go to the Supply Camp immediately. Some locals are gathering there. Hold them off for me.
disp_detail.3000517: The first tape was recorded before the reporter reached the Valley. It showcases his confidence and explains his reason for going: he was seeking an exclusive story—a big scoop.
disp_detail.3000528: The first tape was recorded before the reporter reached the Valley. It showcases his confidence and explains his reason for going: he was seeking an exclusive story—a big scoop.
disp_detail.3000514: The third entry describes the girl arriving in the Valley. She follows a strange "guide" to a puppet factory, where they tour the facility's "state-of-the-art puppets" and even experience what it's like to work there. The girl discovers joy and fulfillment beyond imagination.

disp_detail.3000512: The second entry recounts how the girl saw a poster about the Valley and heard rumors of its "other side." She then set out with a few friends to explore it.
