disp_detail.9041411: Including the two waves of reinforcements, the Blackgold force garrisoned at the Airport is larger than we expected. We need to disperse their defensive troops before the battle begins. Soldier, go to the Armory and tell Renoir to have the Guard Corps stage a feint on the south side of the Airport. This will draw the attention of the main Blackgold force, baiting them into splitting their troops so they can defend the southwestern residential area. This will effectively weaken their defense in the Airport's core area. Don't worry, this is just a symbolic operation. We're paying back a favor without risking too much. Renoir has no reason to refuse.
disp_detail.9241318: Damn! We've got a situation. The guard battalion just arrived in the Valley. The captain thought the Guard Corps had caught up with us. Guess he figured the plan was off for the moment and holed up somewhere. I know his kind all too well—short-sighted, cowardly, and ignorant. Exactly the kind of person who unintentionally gets the people around them hurt. All it takes is a little excitement, a little danger, and they turn into puppets on a string. For now, the captain's just scared and hiding. But wait a bit, and I think there's a good chance he'll sell us out if the price is right. We need to find him, and fast.
disp_detail.1050801: Urgent commission! I remember you being a straight to the point kinda person. The specific mission is to go to Northridge and get rid of all the dangerous elements there. You must be quick and ruthless though! No matter where the trash comes from, that places needs to be emptied out now. I must remind you that while Northridge is still pretty safe despite the Committee gang being stationed there, you must work carefully. This mission is not as simple as it may seem.
disp_detail.2990201: Bring out the target's worth in loot.
disp_detail.2990202: Bring out the target's worth in loot.
disp_detail.4990103: Bring out the target's worth in loot.
disp_detail.4990803: Bring out the target's worth in loot.
disp_detail.9051406: The intel has been confirmed as genuine, which is a pleasant surprise. I will honor my promise and arrange for him to leave the Dark Zone. The handover is set for noon tomorrow on the east side of the Farm. He will be hiding among the militants, waiting for his contact. I need you to go there tomorrow, friend, and eliminate every single militant in the area. Leave no one alive. We must completely erase all traces of the guard battalion's intelligence leak.
disp_detail.9231404: Based on your intel and that from Abyss, we've basically confirmed it: The White Wolves' stronghold is in the industrial area northwest of the Fuel Storage. Their troops appear to be comparable to ours, but we can't rule out hidden units or backup positions. We only used a small team in our first engagement, so the White Wolves shouldn't have an accurate read on our numbers. I plan to use this fact to set a trap and lure their main force out of their stronghold. Operator, take a few good men, follow Abyss, and get into position for the upcoming operation.
disp_detail.9401505: Combining your intel with what I uncovered at the Farm, it's clear they've stashed some "goodies" there. Honestly, I have no idea what it is, but if it's important to them, we need to find out. Friend, bring your team to the Farm and rendezvous with me. We'll search the entire area and get to the bottom of this.
disp_detail.9241319: It's all over. The guard battalion found our Stronghold. We held them off for a while, but we were helpless in the end. Just like back then, I crawled my way out over the bodies of my fallen comrades. Is this just guilt that I'm destined to carry? Again, I'm the only one of my brothers left standing. You know, from the first time I laid eyes on that smuggler, I knew he was just like me—cowardly and greedy. I knew he would sell us out the second there was a whiff of danger, but I just couldn't bring myself to warn my friends... Let's go. There's a dinghy hidden beneath the Radio Station. Should let us put some distance between us and the guard battalion.
disp_detail.3041405: Send me two wristwatches. I don't mind what style, as long as there's no visible damage. I'm looking forward to seeing what you get me.
disp_detail.4010209: Equip your weapon with a suppressor to reduce the sound it makes when firing. This will make it harder for the enemy to spot you. Submachine guns already tend to be quiet, but they're even more so when equipped with a suppressor.
disp_detail.4010705: Equip your weapon with a suppressor to reduce the sound it makes when firing. This will make it harder for the enemy to spot you. Submachine guns already tend to be quiet, but they're even more so when equipped with a suppressor.
disp_detail.4010310: A weapon equipped with a laser sight will have high precision, even when you fire it from the hip. With a large enough magazine, you can lay suppressing fire on a target, even at medium distances. Pick a suitable weapon and give it a try.

disp_detail.5040305: There are some supplies in the Repair Facility that have been captured by elite militants. Go eliminate them.
disp_detail.9411516: Feathers report that the investigation at the Armory isn't going well. The Guard Corps has begun hunting down the Crows. Brady is a formidable officer among the opportunists of the old era. Revan once spoke of his 4th Armored Brigade. I need you to help the Crows get away. Attack the Guard Corps' deployed scout squads, draw their attention, and cover our personnel's withdrawal. I'm also dispatching an elite squad to take direct command of the follow-up operations at the Armory.
disp_detail.1030803: My friend, this isn't your first time helping me, so I'm sure you know how much I hate loose ends. But accidents happen, and I'm having a little problem with something I got my guys to handle. Now, I've got to clean up his mess. The problem is I have an important shipment that requires immediate distribution, so I'm absolutely swamped and could really use your help.
disp_detail.3041419: Damn, how can a simple circuit be so difficult to repair? Please bring me a toolbox. I can't do this without tools.
disp_detail.9031312: Old friend, you're making quite a name for yourself in the Dark Zone. Now that I've flattered you, I'd like to ask you for a hand. Since my buddies returned to the Valley, the Antonio Family has resolidified their hold over Floranpino. However, seems like the West and North are both working in the shadows to take control of the family, and by extension Floranpino. Long story short, they've planted a few hooks in spots around the Valley, and I'd like you to pull them out for me.
disp_detail.1030601: My old friend! I've had a lot going on over the past few days, so I haven't had time to check in with you. I'm delighted to see you thriving in the Dark Zone, though. Things have been slowly changing there during this time, and some factions have started to forget about operators and just get directly to it. I'll give you all the details later when I have time, but in short, the waters in the Dark Zone are getting ever murkier, so remember to keep your eyes open. Every decision is important. By the way, I recently intercepted some intel about the TV Station in Kamona, so I plan to go over that and then I'll need your help to check it all out.
disp_detail.1030801: I've got an errand for you, my friend. You know I have a lot of business dealings in the Dark Zone, and Rodriguez from Guoyapos is an old friend and business partner of mine. We often engage in business cooperations with each other, but he's currently busy dealing with an issue at the Port, and it's even affecting our business transactions. So, I'm forced to deal with some transactions on my own. I'll be needing your help during this period too.
disp_detail.9241303: So, that old fox is sending us into the family's territory? I should've guessed it, given his background. Back in the day, Floranpino was a prime target for us. On the surface, it was Kamona's top tourist destination, a center of thriving commerce. In reality, corruption had seeped into every industry, with the Family orchestrating it all. That's why we decided to destroy them, for the good of Floranpino. And now, here we are, begging them for a room at the inn... What a joke.

disp_detail.9010202: The location of the research group has been uncovered, and they've been sent to the Valley, so I suspect that Doss must know something. I need you to deliver a letter to the Villa for me and leave some eye-catching "traces" around the village nearby. I'm confident Doss will understand the importance of this letter.
disp_detail.9031306: It's impossible to survive in the Dark Zone without having some sense in you. Something feels off about how those Southerners provoked the family. Maybe it's just my paranoia acting up, but I'd prefer if you could check it out for me. Start by asking the militants at the Valley about the situation back then, then conduct a detailed investigation at the location of the conflict and do your best to recreate the situation at the time. I need to figure out who started it.
disp_detail.4010452: Energy is a basic necessity for survival. This is especially true in the Dark Zone, where it is nearly impossible to get around without it. Northridge is relatively rich in energy items, so you could save yourself a lot of time and effort by looking there.
disp_detail.1050401: The Farm hasn't been the same since the Northridge Summit. Many agents have come to the Farm from the Armory, including Renoir, and the whole place is locked down too tight for my men to enter. I need you to infiltrate the Farm and see what they're up to. The Motel and Villa should be pretty crowded, so clean out anyone you find there. I want to let them know it's not safe to enter my territory.
disp_detail.9051109: The Farm hasn't been the same since the Northridge Summit. Many agents have come to the Farm from the Armory, including Renoir, and the whole place is locked down too tight for my men to enter. I need you to infiltrate the Farm and see what they're up to. The Motel and Villa should be pretty crowded, so clean out anyone you find there. I want to let them know it's not safe to enter my territory.
disp_detail.1030804: Since the trade at the Valley, the Dark Zone has welcomed an unprecedented period of stability. However, some are against this. Outsiders have been pouring into the Dark Zone lately, including operators who are in close contact with the Westerners. A while ago, I lost a shipment in the Valley, and I was lucky that my guys in charge of the delivery didn't suffer any casualties. But that shipment is connected to an important transaction, so I can't afford to lose it. There is a rumor that Northridge and the Armory have their eyes on the shipment. My friend, I need you to verify this information as soon as possible.
disp_detail.1990006: Since that deal between Derwin and Doss, the Naval Port isn't as quiet as it used to be. More and more outsiders are arriving. Operators who used to hide in smelly ditches have been flocking there, muddying the once-clean waters and making my business more difficult. Recently, a batch of my goods got held up at the Naval Port. My brothers who delivered them were attacked by these operators. I need you to help me collect this batch of goods. They are very important to me. Get rid of some of those flies while you're at it. I don't want the beautiful port stained by their presence.
disp_detail.9031212: Since the incident at the Mine, I seem to have lost track of Vladlen. I don't want this to lead to uncontrollable consequences. Go to the Armory and maybe you can get some information.
disp_detail.4010915: Since this place became the Dark Zone, it's become increasingly difficult to use high-tech gadgets. I need some computer parts. If you see any in Northridge, remember to bring them back.
disp_detail.4010420: Since this place became the Dark Zone, it's become increasingly difficult to use high-tech gadgets. My old computer broke, and I can't even find the parts that I need to repair it. If you see any computer parts, remember to bring them back with you. When supplies are short, even if you've got the cash, you won't be able to find any.
disp_detail.9231208: Ever since that last operation, Ajax and his goons have seriously stepped up their firepower. I need you to handle those trigger-happy fools—don't let them gain ground while my attention is elsewhere.
disp_detail.4010225: When automatic weapons became popular, semi-automatic weapons fell by the wayside. However, this is the Dark Zone. It isn't so easy to get your hands on weapons here, so it's absolutely essential to become proficient with all kinds of firearms. For instance, here in Northridge, I think fighting with a carbine is a wise decision.
disp_detail.1000002: Rookie, this mission has been entrusted to us by Dr. Evita. I have already investigated the mission objectives. We just need to sneak in and get hold of the target. You can also consider this a training exercise. Get your stuff packed and let's go.
disp_detail.5000004: Rookie, this mission has been entrusted to us by Dr. Evita. I have already investigated the mission objectives. We just need to sneak in and get hold of the target. You can also consider this a training exercise. Get your stuff packed and let's go.
disp_detail.9031203: Though it may not be the first time, it's still embarrassing to say that I was robbed. My men went to see Captain Derwin with a contract and a shipment of goods, but due to special circumstances, they couldn't reveal my name to anyone. Sure enough, they were robbed by the local tyrant over there. Obviously, you're the only one I can rely on now.
disp_detail.9020101: Thomas may hold you in high regard, but at this point you don't have my trust yet, so I will only contact you in this way. I know how operators like you operate; it's about money, not people. So, let's play by the rules, then: I pay, you do the work, capiche? I believe you have some insight into the situation at the TV Station—that's why I've come to you. I need you to go to the Central Control Area on the first floor and carry out a full investigation of the area. Also, get a sitrep from the squad there. They're being led by a man named Kurt. Watch out and don't get hurt accidentally, as they won't know you're there.
disp_detail.4010320: You won't get to use your melee weapon in combat often, but if you do find yourself in a situation where ammo is running thin, pulling it out can be a way to get the upper hand on your enemy. Having said that, you'd have to be crazy to try it.
disp_detail.4010344: You won't get to use your melee weapon in combat often, but if you do find yourself in a situation where ammo is running thin, pulling it out can be a way to get the upper hand on your enemy. Having said that, you'd have to be crazy to try it.
disp_detail.4010731: There are many marksmen capable of accurately hitting their target using only front and rear sights. That said, I still recommend equipping your weapon with a scope. Here's a tip: They're highly suited for fighting in places like the Farm.
disp_detail.4010339: There are many marksmen capable of accurately hitting their target using only front and rear sights. That said, I still recommend equipping your weapon with a scope. Even a normal one is better than nothing.

disp_detail.4010143: Suppressing the enemy with firepower is a crucial and effective tool in difficult indoor environments, but if you want to finish up a battle as quickly as possible, you'll need to hit your opponent's weak spot as well. The more dangerous the moment, the more important it is that you make careful judgments, keep a cool head, and don't miss.

disp_detail.4010746: Although the Mosin isn't designed for close combat, it can be adapted for such uses by shortening the chassis and barrel. This does reduce its effective range, so it depends on your personal preferences.
disp_detail.9411606: The op was a success. The White Wolves have reinforcements en route, so the next objective is clear: that squad must not be allowed to arrive safely. It's not just about thinning their numbers—it's about breaking their rhythm. Head-on fighting is no problem for a disciplined crew, but an endless string of contingencies will cause them to crumble. The Crows will support you, soldier. Do all you can to inflict pain on those reinforcements. I want to give them a wound they can't ignore.
disp_detail.4010124: The supply shortage is causing the militants held up in the Valley to become restless. Some guys joined them recently. We don't know who they are, but they've been stirring up trouble, so I need you to take a marksman rifle to the Lockdown Zone in the Valley. Eliminating this threat is our number one priority.
disp_detail.9251305: The Westerners are gradually losing influence in the Dark Zone. On the surface, at least, the Guard Corps has stopped working with Blackgold. I guess Doss caught wind of what was up, and he's planning on betting on both sides. He sent people to meet with that special commissioner from up north. He really thinks too much of himself—the family is nothing compared to the Guard Corps. They tell me now the Westerners have put out a bounty on Doss. Seems like they want to make an example out of him. The Guard Corps needs the family to be stable, for now. Go throw a wrench in their plan for me. And put some fear into their operators.
disp_detail.9421505: The Armory is Guard Corps territory, and Renoir—the one in control there—is not someone to be underestimated. The southern front is currently deadlocked in Marulos, which means the Armory's defenses are on high alert. Even Team Annihilation would face heavy resistance if they tried to investigate. Needless to say, it will be just as dangerous for you. Exercise extreme caution during this mission.
disp_detail.9041224: Things at the Armory are settling down, but the Farm is now the new cause of concern. Ever since the arrival of Hecate and her Abyss, Ajax has been struggling. Go and help them out.
disp_detail.5040309: People in the Armory are moving a batch of supplies. Help me find the key to the Warehouse, and my men will take the supplies.
disp_detail.5040310: The garrison outside the Armory is changing guard. Go to where they're stationed and look for intel before the new one arrives!
disp_detail.9241313: Damn! How could this have happened? The radio station we'd set up at the Communication Station was destroyed not long ago—it's only a matter of time before they find this Stronghold. Seems like we can't hang around Northridge. Thankfully, we already got the most important explosives out via the Cable Car Station—they should be at the Armory by now. Friend, I need you to take our operation plans and get out of here. Bring them to our Stronghold near the Armory. I've got some things I need to handle alone.
disp_detail.5020305: Survive for 3min in the Cable Car Station.
disp_detail.9011609: The threat level in the Hostile Sector is rising, and conventional reconnaissance isn't cutting it anymore. I need you to head in and apply some pressure. Let's see where this area's bottom line is.

disp_detail.5010338: The situation in the Hostile Sector must be reported, which means we need to establish auxiliary comms first. Keep the device safe, too—some will attempt to stop us at all costs!
disp_detail.5030342: The situation in the Hostile Sector must be reported, which means we need to establish auxiliary comms first. Keep the device safe, too—some will attempt to stop us at all costs!
disp_detail.9421502: The plan is simple. Fake an escape trail in Marulos. Make it obvious. Let Team Annihilation think they've found a lead, when in fact you're leading them astray. This will both disrupt their judgment and buy Kurt the time and space he needs to move.
disp_detail.9231405: The plan worked. The wolf cubs are out of their den, and the main Blackgold force is currently holding them in the Freight Center. Now, we move along the northern wall of the Control Tower and execute a pincer movement on the White Wolf Squad. Once we're in position, I'll take half of the Abyss team and go block reinforcements from their stronghold. You'll need to take the rest of the team and attack the wolf cubs on their flank and rear. Drive them all the way into the Freight Center.
disp_detail.9241315: Our plan is moving forward smoothly—we've barely run up against any blockers, actually. Hard to believe not long ago the Guard Corps was shoring up the Armory's defenses. It almost feels like a trap, to be honest. But, strictly speaking, no one but you and I knows enough of the plan to let anything slip. I originally thought that we'd run into issues and I'd have an excuse to just call the whole thing off, get everyone out of the Armory. But with things going as they are... I think we're just going to have to buckle down and see this through. Friend, I'm going to need you to switch up tasks for the moment. No need to go to the Armory for now—head to the Valley first and help me deliver this message.
disp_detail.9421503: Remember, the art of deception lies in restraint. Sometimes, one or two "accidental" flaws can make the whole performance seem more real. Go to the Farm, create some controlled chaos, and leave behind the "necessary" traces before you extract.
disp_detail.3000520: The reporter sounds weak and exhausted, yet his mind has been completely corrupted. He begins to abandon all personal desires, obsessively making devotions to the Devotion Statue with no thought of reward.

disp_detail.4010422: It's been a while since I've seen anything new around these parts, besides recruits. When something breaks from overuse, you'll need tools to patch it up. The Valley's got lots of toolboxes, so try rummaging through the area to see if you can find anything useful.
disp_detail.4010946: It's been a while since I've seen anything new around these parts, besides recruits. When something breaks from overuse, you'll need tools to patch it up. The Valley's got lots of toolboxes. Try rummaging through them if you're ever short on tools.

disp_detail.4011515: Who'd have thought that one day there would be weapons all over the Dark Zone that you can pick up. It's almost like some kind of training... Ahem...
disp_detail.1020903: Investigate the site of the attack at the Farm, interact with the wreckage, and verify the convoy belongs to the Sumek Committee. Survivors are unlikely.
disp_detail.9031213: Thanks for the intel. I think Vladlen is busy with his weaponry at the Armory again, and there may be some good stuff there. This is an opportunity for us to do business!
disp_detail.5010512: There are some records that are very important to me on the Grain Trade Center's second floor. But after the outbreak, the Center became a hotbed for those disgusting things. Go up there and clean out the inside.
disp_detail.9401603: The cargo's safe, so now it's time to make Team Annihilation pay. I've got skilled trackers tailing the squad that hit our convoy, and right now, they're holed up in a secret stronghold waiting for their next job. They must think they're nice and safe, eh? Well, get ready to move, pal. We're gonna show 'em what a real ambush looks like. Tooth for a tooth, right?
disp_detail.5020311: Intel shows that several of Doss's squads have left the Valley recently. Go to where they were recuperating and see what you can find.
disp_detail.5020313: Intel shows that several of Doss's squads have left the Valley recently. Go to where they were recuperating and see what you can find.

disp_detail.5010308: Get to the Sentry Tower at the Recycling Station and bring back the supplies that have been dropped off there before the militants make off with them. Hurry!

disp_detail.9431608: While the White Wolves have all their attention focused on that idiot, I need you to make a trip to the TV Station. An old colleague of mine bribed a mole inside. I want to use them to monitor Talia's next moves. Before that, though, I need you to gauge this person's attitude—see if they have any inclination for a double-cross. Because there's nothing I hate more than being betrayed.
disp_detail.5010513: There's a portable recorder inside the roadside hut. The last time it was used was on the day of the outbreak. Thomas wants to know what the homeowner heard during those hours. Bring the entire machine back—and don't listen to it while you're inside the hut.
disp_detail.5020426: Go scout out the Abandoned Shack and see what the locals are plotting.
disp_detail.1010804: In the past, the Farm was on fertile ground, with its crops of wheat shining in the golden sun and its ripe harvest exuding a delightful aroma. But the North-South Conflict destroyed all that, and the Farm is now inhabited by dangerous militants. Someone wants to change that though, so he's issued a commission looking for someone to go to the Stables and maintain order at the Grain Trade Center. I'm not gonna say whether I think it's a naive plan or not, it's up to you should you wish to accept it.
disp_detail.9031303: The guard battalion holds a deep-seated grudge toward the Southerners, so they're actually holding back right now. Fortunately, they promptly evacuated from the Farm before their identities as former members of the Southern Army were revealed. Otherwise, the conflict would have escalated. I'm well aware this doesn't bode well for the Southerners, so I intend to compensate them in the near future. And it just so happens that I have friends in the Valley, so I can ask them to provide a suitable place for the Southerners to stay.
disp_detail.9051402: The guard battalion is the Guard Corps's elite force—a small incident like this wouldn't shake their defenses. The Southern Army launched several attacks, but aside from increasing the number of casualties, they haven't made any real progress. Oh, friend, don't blame yourself. This was all expected. All we can do now is increase the Southern Army's chances of winning. They have to do the fighting themselves. Next, I need you to deliver a message for me to the Farm. It seems like the bait we put out there is finally getting attention.
disp_detail.9411525: The guard battalion was as weak as I predicted, but the Wolves' bite was fiercer than anticipated. The "cargo" has now been moved near the Armory. There's a key stronghold controlled by the Guard Corps there, and Brady's Armory Bodyguards will be our primary opposition. The division of labor remains the same: I'll break through the escort team, and you'll deal with the flank support.
disp_detail.9241302: The guard battalion isn't letting up on us. They really haven't changed! I don't know what kind of deal that old fox is trying to work out, but I'm sure it won't be in our favor. We'll still be driven out of here like dogs! If they'd dared to treat us like this back then... Forget it, all I want now is to get out of here. Before we leave the Farm, could you help us get something from the Villa? It's a token of our past.
disp_detail.3041408: I'm planning on going to the repair shop soon to have them look at my game console. It keeps on breaking. Please bring me some spare circuit boards.
disp_detail.9041212: Recently, there have been rumors of unusual trade logistics in the Dark Zone, especially at Porrero's shithole. Something must be going on. Deliver this letter to him and keep an eye out for anything unusual.
disp_detail.4010140: A shotgun can easily hit an enemy at close range, even without aiming precisely, making it the ideal weapon for mobile combat in difficult indoor environments. When surrounded, you can use a shotgun to quickly clear a gap and move to safety. I hope you'll keep that in mind the next time you go to Northridge Hotel.
disp_detail.4010425: A submachine gun can be your best friend in a close quarters fight. While you won't loot anything outstanding from militants, you can find stuff that will suit your purposes well enough. If you find them in the Dark Zone, they're worth picking up.
disp_detail.4010712: It's not easy to hit your opponent's weak spot when spraying at close range. Equip your weapon with a laser sight to make this much easier. Of course, you have to be careful as well. Don't let it reveal your location.
disp_detail.9021010: Do you remember the place where you left the disinfectants? That's a critical intersection on the path from the Farm to Northridge. The militants there have started acting up again for the past few days. Right now, my informants are having trouble getting supplies—we need your help, soldier.
disp_detail.1020801: Remember when I asked you before to help me get to the Valley to support my team there? Well, they found out some news when they were rescuing locals at the Floranpino aid station. A local told them that a car with the Sumek Committee logo was seen in the Valley not long ago. I worked out the dates and it happened to be around the time of the Northridge Hotel attack. My sixth sense is telling me that my father has been taken to the Valley. I might not know much about the factions in the Dark Zone, but I do know that Doss runs the Valley. No matter whether Doss did it or not, I don't think he'd have the gall to be holding someone at his Villa. People are trying to find these people, after all. There aren't many places left where they could be hidden. Doss' Small Factory has a complicated layout and is heavily guarded, so it would be a good place to hide someone. Could you help me clear the surrounding area before my people go in and have a look? I hope we can find my father this time.
disp_detail.9041216: These warlords have gone too far, and they are asking me for more things. Although I know they will never be satisfied, sometimes they need to be given some sugar. I'll leave these things to you.
disp_detail.9281205: These new toys are absolutely enthralling. They may come from a more technologically advanced place. I've got to send them somewhere to be studied, and I'll need a distraction to keep them from drawing too much attention.
disp_detail.1040201: With all the bosses gathering in the area, Northridge is crazy dangerous right now. I've pulled my people out. But the defenses at the Armory might be lacking somewhat, and this is a good time to finish what others started before. Go down there and search the Repair Facility, the Shooting Range, and the Radar Station. Bring information back, so I can see what that person did at the Armory behind my back.
disp_detail.5020423: Has the gang been wiped out or not? Go visit the RV Camp. Now.
disp_detail.9411608: The non-stop fighting has run the White Wolves ragged, and we've found a hole in the Airport's defenses. It's time. Soldier, I need you to cut the power to the facilities around the Airport to distract the guards around the perimeter. Once the wolf cubs have left their den, the Crows will storm the Terminal and destroy the landing strip.
disp_detail.9031304: Have those Southerners gone mad? How dare a bunch of newcomers provoke the Antonio Family? The family wants them gone, so tell them to make it quick. The Antonio Family has promised me they'll be granted safe passage. However, I've just been notified that some young thugs of the family are planning to target them. As a fellow resident of Kamona, I can only tolerate them one last time. I'll need you to scare some sense into those troublemakers.
disp_detail.9261306: Time's up for the southern pests. They're about to taste the pain of being sold out and abandoned, just like the guard battalion did back then. And at the Armory too, no less. But the roles are reversed this time, and it's not going to be a stalemate—it'll be a bloodbath. The Guard Corps will clean up the front. You operators catch any fish that happen to slip through the net.
disp_detail.9061002: Randall here. I hate to admit it, but there are a lot of idiots at the Farm at the moment. I hate those tricky types the most. Take your squad to the Farm and break their legs. Fear is the only way to keep them in line. Sort this out for me and I'll give you access to some really good stuff.
disp_detail.1060602: Randall here. I hate to admit it, but there are a lot of idiots at the Farm at the moment. I hate those tricky types the most. Take your squad to the Farm and get rid of those treacherous fools. Don't let them spoil our reputation as foreigners here. Sort this out for me and I'll give you access to some really good stuff.
disp_detail.5030320: The terrain here is extremely complicated, so I need someone to map out the area for me. I've prepared the tools, so find it and complete the mission.
disp_detail.5030330: The terrain here is extremely complicated, so I need someone to map out the area for me. I've prepared the tools, so find it and complete the mission.
disp_detail.5030340: The terrain here is extremely complicated, so I need someone to map out the area for me. I've prepared the tools, so find it and complete the mission.
disp_detail.4010116: After entering Northridge, quickly eliminate nearby enemies and occupy favorable terrain to gain a considerable advantage over other operators. This preemptive tactic is highly recommended, but beware of enemies who think like you.

disp_detail.9041204: Deke Vinson contacted me. No idea how he got this line, but he's looking to sell some critical intel. We've agreed to make the exchange in the Valley. So, I need you to head there first and clear the area of any outsiders. I want to keep this low-key.
disp_detail.9411508: The trail suggests they've already left the Farm, but my intuition is warning me—this escape route is too "perfect," and that makes me uneasy. I need you to return to Marulos and conduct a thorough recheck. Gather enough intel to either confirm or disprove my hunch.
disp_detail.1020906: According to the interaction on the path to Northridge (place supplies), someone has gone to investigate in Northridge and requires the provision of supplies.
disp_detail.1020905: The letter on the path to Northridge indicates their father was taken to Northridge.
disp_detail.1020904: Though the delivery truck schedule reveals that no trucks left during that period, there are signs of a fight. Let's continue investigating from here (Grain + Path to Northridge).
disp_detail.3041404: Heyo, it's my favorite delivery guy! Can I get some fresh beans? Of the coffee variety, of course. I'm preparing a brunch, and I want to give the big guys a taste.
disp_detail.3041424: Courier, please bring us a batch of enamel mugs. We are used to them, and now we feel uncomfortable without them.
disp_detail.9231206: The man confessed, but his clothes and gear can still be used. Put these in Northridge. If Fred has nothing to do with the people from the Port as it has always been, these things will definitely cause trouble.
disp_detail.9401605: The traitor seems to know he's being followed, since he's been pulling lots of stunts on the road. But he's no professional, so his tricks won't fool us. I'd wager that he thinks he'll soon be safe and sound—so he'll relax and lead us to his next stop.
disp_detail.9231205: The intel from that merchant is very interesting. It seems that these rats are planning to unite. However, we still need to verify the credibility of this intel. I plan to capture a northerner for questioning. Go to the Armory and make some noise to make it easier for my people to take action.
disp_detail.9431607: That idiot made it out. And just as I expected, they didn't even notice that they were being tailed. It looks like the team tracking them is being led by that gamer kid. Expert, I need you to go to the Airport and pretend to protect that idiot. Lead them on a wild goose chase around the Farm a couple of times, and then head to the Northridge meeting. After the meeting, those people will definitely send someone to track you as well. I trust your skills—handle it cleanly, and don't leave a trail.
disp_detail.9431609: That idiot finally reached Northridge, but they still haven't realized that they're being followed. Expert, their fate is in your hands. I'll sync the location of the Viper's stronghold to you. Leave markings along the way for that idiot and lure them there. Finally, make sure to finish them off before that gamer kid catches them.
disp_detail.4010740: People usually keep their distance from heavily armed enemies. Fortunately, no matter how thick your opponent's body armor or how sturdy their helmet, their legs will always be exposed. When you come up against them, you shouldn't need telling what to do.
disp_detail.5030316: Those outsiders are always stirring up trouble. Well, if trouble's what they want, trouble's what we'll give them. Help me find a few guys, they have some good stuff on them.

disp_detail.9281202: Whatever it is, its ability to make people go insane is horrifying! I don't know how it got into Kamona! Take a look around the Farm, maybe you'll chance upon its source.
disp_detail.9021009: The group of people who gave you that package ran into some trouble: Some of them were hurt. None of their injuries are life-threatening, but they need some disinfectants to prevent their wounds from getting infected. Can you bring the disinfectants to the sentry tower next to the path to Northridge? They'll come pick it up themselves.
disp_detail.9031311: Those Southerners have really crossed the line now. I won't let those puppets shatter the peace in Kamona for their hollow ambitions! Regrettably, a group of operators fell for their lies. They're getting paid by the Westerners to back the Southerners up. The rewards they offer always look so enticing at first glance, but the juice is never worth the squeeze. Go let the Guard Corps know what's going on—they know better than most how to deal with these Westerners.
disp_detail.5020419: Those locals have taken our supplies at the Port again. Stop them, and be quick about it.
disp_detail.9271203: According to someone at the lounge, Night City weaponry has fallen into the hands of someone known as Vladlen. Have you heard of him? I have a clue. Could you please find out what he's been up to lately?
disp_detail.5030308: Those bastards at the Hotel are always stirring up trouble. Well, if trouble's what they want, trouble's what we'll give them. Help me deliver a warning.
disp_detail.9261309: Now that we've finally wrapped up that hullabaloo, let me tell you what happened back then. When the Conflict first broke out, the Southern Army carved through key positions like a hot knife through butter. The corrupt and incompetent leadership left the frontlines with their most loyal troops in tow. Hoping to spur us rank-and-file soldiers to fight to the last, they put us completely under the command of the frontline officers. At the same time, they fed us purposefully erroneous intel to make us believe we were doing better than we actually were. Naturally, that led to the low-ranking officers in command issuing a score of terrible orders, which sped the frontline along to its inevitable defeat. And that's how the guard battalion was abandoned. The only difference between us and the rest of the soldiers was the colonel coming to save us before we bit the dirt.
disp_detail.5040302: Eliminate 3 militants and extract within 5 minutes while on a team.
disp_detail.4010724: It's really difficult to find armor that's both protective and light-weight. As a sniper, you need good mobility, so you'll usually need to give up body armor that's too heavy. Here's my recommendation that balances mobility with decent protection.
disp_detail.9051106: Ajax used to be a guard at the Armory. He became Renoir's subordinate following a certain incident and was later sent to the Farm. I know him personally, but I don't want anyone else to know about that. There are also things about me I don't want him to know. There was an explosion on Arbor Farm recently. It severely impacted our plans. Go down there and investigate the site for me. Do something on the freeway near the explosion site to attract everyone's attention, then look for paper products nearby. I think I remember seeing a lot of those in the Barn, so look through them for clues.
disp_detail.1050103: Ajax used to be a guard at the Armory. He became Renoir's subordinate following a certain incident, and was later sent to the Farm. I know him personally, but I don't want anyone else to know about that. There are also things about me I don't want him to know. There was an explosion on the Farm recently. It severely impacted our plans. Go down there and investigate the site for me. Do something on the freeway near the explosion site to attract everyone's attention, then look for paper products nearby. I think I remember seeing a lot of those in the Barn, so look through them for clues.
disp_detail.9031215: Ajax and his new rival are in intense conflict at the Farm. This benefits no one, not even Kamona. Sometimes, it only takes a nudge to break the fragile balance, and you're perfect to be that nudge.
disp_detail.9291202: Ajax's people are using rubble to obstruct our lifeline. I need to ensure the road to Northridge from the Motel remains unobstructed in order to obtain sufficient supplies.
disp_detail.9241316: It was a trap! The Guard Corps has been preparing for us all along. They lured us out near the Armory and ambushed us from all sides. The entirety of our main squad was wiped out, and our recon troops are running for their lives. I just got a last transmission from them. Seems like the Guard Corps has them surrounded, and they're closing in on them. They begged me to send support. Friend, I can't tell you what exactly is happening over there. I'm not even sure if our soldiers can still be saved... I guess I'm asking you to make another choice. Will you take this mission?
disp_detail.9341408: It's a trap! The Freight Center is a trap! Just now, a squad captain disobeyed a direct order and left the stronghold with the White Wolf Squad to rescue a recon team. Damn it, how could this happen?! Are we cursed? ... There's no time to think about that. Our priority is to stop the White Wolf Squad from walking into that trap. I need you to move out now, operator. You have to intercept them before they're attacked!
disp_detail.3000510: As his memories returned, the man briefly regained clarity and begged his wife not to come to the Valley, calling it hell. He explained that he had been caught in a time bubble, suspended between life and death, and that a mysterious force was using him to draw others in. By the end of the postcard, his sanity had completely vanished. He pleaded for her to come, addressing her as "darling" and vowing to receive her personally.
disp_detail.3000522: As his memories returned, the man briefly regained clarity and begged his wife not to come to the Valley, calling it hell. He explained that he had been caught in a time bubble, suspended between life and death, and that a mysterious force was using him to draw others in. By the end of the postcard, his sanity had completely vanished. He pleaded for her to come, addressing her as "darling" and vowing to receive her personally.
disp_detail.9031206: As my business grew, I started having the thought that it wouldn't be such a bad idea for someone to come along and stabilize the area. Help me deliver this letter to the observation tower in Northridge. I'd like to discuss some ideas with my friends in the north.
disp_detail.5040306: Focus. This mission is extremely dangerous. Take the mission items before the garrison finds them!
disp_detail.9041103: Operator, you've done a good job on the last mission. Looks like you're a trustworthy person. There's nothing I hate more than traitors, and those fellas in the Valley have no integrity at all. This is especially so for their boss, Doss. Visit the Wooden Bridge in the Valley and the top floor of the Supply Camp Outpost. Someone left me two document boxes that I need you to bring me. We'll chat more about the Valley another time.
disp_detail.9041106: Operator, you're pretty familiar with the Farm, right? I heard that those guys have been visiting it frequently. Not much has happened since the explosion, but I think the disappearance of the Gungnir generator has some relation to them. Go create a distraction at the destroyed convoy, then investigate each of the Farm's intersections. I want to know where the generator went!
disp_detail.9041102: Operator, my people traveled to the location you scouted. But another group suddenly showed up and started causing trouble. I'm furious! To ensure that the gear can be collected smoothly, I need you to go back to the Valley and teach them a lesson on my behalf. Act fast and strike hard!
disp_detail.9351404: Renoir is a cunning strategist who knows how to bide his time to achieve his goals. We made the first move, and his lack of extreme reaction is exactly what makes him so dangerous and difficult to deal with. Out of respect, we've prepared "compensation." Find an opportunity to deliver this intel into the Armory soon. We trust that a man of Renoir's intellect will know how to make the most of it once he sees it.
disp_detail.9041223: Renoir has received my supplies, and it's time for him to show his determination and abilities. Go to the Armory to check out the battlefield and see if there is sufficient ammo.
disp_detail.4010711: Shotguns aren't as accurate as other weapons, so if you want to show just how ferocious they can be, you'll need to be close enough to your target.
disp_detail.4010443: In close combat, a shotgun can put just as much pressure on your enemy as a submachine gun, though its usefulness decreases the further away you are. Anyway, they're relatively common. Many militants use them, so they should be easy to find.
disp_detail.4010205: Shotguns are less accurate than other weapons. However, when they're used in the proper environment, they can be extremely powerful. Try to get as close to the target as possible.
disp_detail.5010502: The Open Storage has become a home for the infected. When the wind blows, the stench fills up half of the Farm. I don't want the rot to spread any further. Clean the area out—don't leave a single one alive.
disp_detail.4010220: It's dangerous to go near the bosses in the Dark Zone. However, because they often appear in complex indoor environments, it can be difficult to avoid close-range firefights with them. I highly suggest going in with teammates to increase your odds of survival.
disp_detail.4010244: It's dangerous to go near the bosses in the Dark Zone. However, because they often appear in complex indoor environments, it can be difficult to avoid close-range firefights with them. I highly suggest going in with teammates to increase your odds of survival.
disp_detail.4010407: There is a limit to what a pistol can accomplish against a heavily-armored opponent, though I've got a friend who believes otherwise. In times of need, such as when you don't have time to reload your primary weapon, having a pistol handy might save your life.
disp_detail.9341602: That cargo Maxim had you move was just the tip of the iceberg. More of it is still hidden across Marulos. Team Annihilation are unusually well-informed, which makes me suspect someone in the White Wolves is being paid off. To prevent further leaks, the Flag Squad can't show their faces directly. I need you, working as an operator, to head to these stash locations and activate the coordinate locators Maxim set up. Once activated, Maxim will handle the rest of the transport. While you do that, I'll have the White Wolf squads sweep the outskirts of Marulos and take out the Team Annihilation stronghold to cause a distraction. Their eyes will be on me—that's your best window.
disp_detail.9341506: Maxim sent word. They've reached the Airport safely and have taken control. The enemy isn't completely eliminated, but they no longer pose a serious threat to the Airport. The ball's in our court now. It's time to switch from defense to offense.
disp_detail.9341505: You should be familiar with Maxim. During the last operation at the Airport, he was the one who lifted the lockdown on the Control Area for us from the inside. I'm sending him to the Airport to take command and help ease the situation there. Operator, I need you to pose as a support squad that failed to break through. Draw the enemy scouts' attention and mislead them so that Maxim's squad can move unseen.
disp_detail.9341509: Maxim always has a plan. He intends to set bait to force Team Annihilation into our pre-set ambush. Even if they realize it's a trap, they'll have no other choice. Operator, you have two options: join my ambush team for a direct assault, or work with Maxim's transport team to covertly move and hide the remaining cargo.
disp_detail.5010514: A dried flower bookmark was left by the bed in the hut west of the Stables. The client wants it brought back.
disp_detail.9041110: Someone from Marulos had come to me. They've noticed that the Southern fellas are up to something. Due to past events, they're worried that the Southern Army's next target is Marulos. Hence, they've approached us again for help. This situation is definitely in our favor, and so I'll need you to go to the Armory and deliver a batch of supplies.
disp_detail.9041113: The situation in Marulos is worse than I expected. The Southerners have breached the ceasefire line and most of the South has fallen to them. Our superiors need more time to assess the impact of the situation, so I need you to get to the Farm and set up hidden observation points, just in case.
disp_detail.9041118: It's a battle of attrition in Marulos now. I'm afraid both sides won't be able to make major progress in the short term. The North intends to seize this opportunity and increase its support to Renoir to cope with the South's growing aerial forces. I need you at the Armory to verify the transportation route's safety.
disp_detail.9411603: Message from the Nest: The convoy's course has not changed. Personnel count matches the pre-departure intel, so stick to the plan. You're responsible for leading the Crows' attack on the Guard Corps squad to sever the link between the two sides. I'll deal with those annoying little wolf cubs escorting the cargo.
disp_detail.9411518: The Crows' main force managed to extract, but the White Wolves captured the lead Crow. His expertise wasn't enough to see him through. The Farm's secrets have been leaked, and we were a step too slow. We must return to the Farm at once and assess the situation.
disp_detail.9411510: The Crows will continue tracking their trail. Meanwhile, I need you to put the investigation mission on hold, gear up, and proceed to the Farm to carry out a covert operation. An elite squad will rendezvous with you there. Your objective is to establish a completely secure zone in the Farm area to provide cover for the upcoming transfer operation.
disp_detail.9411511: The Crows have come under attack from the guard battalion on the east side of the Farm, where the Crows are conducting a search. This isn't the Crows' home turf, and they lack the means to mount an effective counterattack. I'll direct them to create a suitable "hunting ground" for you. Get your squad in position and be ready to deal a crippling blow to the guard battalion when the time is right.
disp_detail.5010508: The Wheatfield Hut was where the last squad that could still shoot was, after the outbreak. They didn't extract, and all died inside. Bring back the pocket watch on the captain's body—the client is his wife. She only wants the watch, nothing else.
disp_detail.9051115: Trouble just keeps popping up. I need your help, my friend. Those guys at Northridge are acting up again. But no matter what they're planning, we can't let them affect our plans. I need you to go there and teach them a lesson so that they'll stop.
disp_detail.1050903: There's no end to my troubles, and the road to peace is never-ending. Those guys who sought to destroy the peace are back again. Based on multiple reports, we've determined that they're planning something big in Marulos and Floranpino. So, we've got to head over there and deal with it. Always catch a snake by the head, we're going for their boss!

disp_detail.9271207: Blackgold Universal wants a piece of Night City. The new "door" may appear in Northridge Hotel. Its power is far beyond your wildest dreams, so let's stop them before it's too late.
disp_detail.9341414: Blackgold detected movement from us, but it was too late. Our troops completely annihilated their main squad at the Fuel Storage and dismantled their northern stronghold. Having lost their advantage there, Blackgold has been forced into a hasty retreat, and all of their forces have converged on the Control Tower's core area. In the rush, they temporarily unsealed the entrance on the outside to the core area for their retreating units. This is our chance. We can create a diversion out front, have our people slip inside, and stop them from resealing the entrance.

FrontEnd.PlayerViewLastUnbanTooltip: All forms of bans are included (e.g., forced offline by the game due to network or environment anomalies, which usually counts as a 10+ seconds ban in the backend, typically 18 seconds).
FrontEnd.GameInfo_BlockDamageFactor_Tooltip: Bullets that fail to penetrate armor and helmet masks will still cause a certain amount of blunt trauma damage.
FrontEnd.GameInfo_BodyHitThroughProbability_Toolt: If the bullet trajectory includes both primary and secondary hit zones, this probability determines if both take damage.
FrontEnd.GameInfo_BodyHitThroughDamageFactor_Tool: When 'secondary penetration' is triggered, the secondary zone takes full damage, and the primary zone takes this percentage of damage.
FrontEnd.GameInfo_RicochetAngleTooltip: When a bullet hits armor, the system checks the angle between the bullet's trajectory and the surface normal. A steeper angle increases the chance of a ricochet.
FrontEnd.GameInfo_ArmorDestructibility_Tooltip: Durability deducted on hit = Bullet Armor Damage * This Coefficient
FrontEnd.GameInfo_AdapterAdjustDamage_Tooltip: This modifier directly adds to the bullet's base damage
FrontEnd.GameInfo_AdsMoa_Tooltip: Even in ADS mode, bullets may still deviate slightly. The higher this value, the smaller the deviation.
